## 1. Goal, success criteria and scope

### 1.1 Goal

Make Verevon Space the hybrid room for people and agents:

- **People get Teams-class groups and teams and Slack-class rooms.** Roles and a directory, direct messages, human posts and thread replies that do not invoke a model, live push, identity-bound mentions, reactions, edit and delete, attachments, search and permalinks, attention across rooms.
- **Agents get Grok-Bot-style colleague behaviour.** Personal agents with an owner-controlled access list and audience-safe memory, work the whole room can watch and stop, approvals that really resume, a computer with resource caps, and a browser the room can see and take over.
- **All of it inside Verevon's authority model.** Control Plane signs short-lived, audience-bound decisions; Space access never widens an owner-plane ACL; ZDR fails closed with typed refusals in every plane that persists or pushes content; the Model proposes and Quarry executes browser actions; no direct database crossing between planes.

Starting point (audit 1.2 and 1.3, code-verified): an authority-first agent cockpit on a conversation model that is still an AI prompt box. Every room post is a model turn; there is no room push (6 s poll); only the sender sees an agent work; governance cannot be administered (no effect-policy UI, SCIM stub answers success, any org member can read all org audit events); approvals resume for three action kinds only; agent memory is not Space-aware; DMs, reactions, edit and delete, attachments and search do not exist; the agent sandbox is confined but uncapped.

### 1.2 Success criteria

Sixteen criteria. Each is checked on a rebuilt local stack (images rebuilt, stack running, flow verified end to end: the repo rule for every deployment claim), by a person other than the slice author (verification protocol 6.4). "B" is a second member of the same room. Numbers marked (proposal) are acceptance targets to be calibrated on the baseline run in M1 week 1 and then frozen (budget = measured baseline x 2 unless stated); unmarked numbers come from the designs or the audit. Scenario ids are those of section 6. Baseline = audit 1.3 finding number.

| # | Criterion and number | How measured | Proven by (milestone, scenario) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **A human post is not a model turn.** 0 `runs` rows from a post or a member reply; the agent context read of that thread contains 0 posts; `agent_memory` and thread columns unchanged. Same `client_send_id` replayed gives 1 row (`deduplicated:true`), changed content 409; viewer and non-member get 403 with 0 rows. Server acceptance p95 under 400 ms including the Control mint; optimistic row under 100 ms (both proposal). Baseline: 1.3 #1 | SQL on `messages` (`post_kind`, `author_subject_id`) and `runs`, HAR of POSTs, context read, `cargo test` and `go test` for the append gate | M1, M1-S1 |
| 2 | **Live delivery without a model.** B sees A's post or run-state change p95 under 1.5 s (p50 under 500 ms, proposal) via a pushed frame, with no 6 s `/threads` timer in the HAR (one `GET /events` per tab). Stream down: B converges within 6 s plus jitter by polling, degraded indicator within 35 s. 500 users x 3 tabs reconnecting after a gateway restart all resume by `Last-Event-ID` within 60 s. Baseline: 1.3 #2 | B's refetch time minus `space_event_log.created_at`; HAR; stop and start session-core; `space-stream-storm.mjs` | M1, M1-S2 and 6.5 budgets |
| 3 | **Revocation closes the stream.** A removed member's Space stream and run stream close p95 within 15 s of the membership event, hard bound 130 s if the event is dropped; the member's next call fails closed with 0 content bytes; a read token on the stream RPC and a stream token on `ListThreads` are both denied | Timing table (`space_revocation_close_seconds`), `space_membership_revocations` row, close frame, grpc-level cross-use test | M1, M1-S3; M2-S2 (mid-run) |
| 4 | **Zero message bodies on any push wire or notification payload.** A unique canary string posted in a room appears 0 times in the raw SSE capture, `space_event_log`, `session_audit_outbox` payloads, Convex attention rows (no text field), `notification_requests` payloads (refs only), metrics labels and logs; the X3 canary script (`scripts/tests/space-content-free-canary.sh`, run at every milestone gate; nightly only once the self-hosted runner of E8 exists) finds 0 hits | Canary scan over wire captures, DB rows and logs; grep of gateway and model-gateway logs | every milestone; M1-S2, M2-S4 |
| 5 | **Every new write path refuses typed for a ZDR caller or a Space whose decision carries `zero_data_retention=true`.** 100 percent of new durable routes (post, thread create, mention wake, grant create, attachment, canvas write, browser run) return the refusal-catalogue code or `poll_only`/refs-only, with 0 rows created in `messages`, `space_event_log`, notification tables and Convex, and 0 Control calls for refused requests (the agent registry, access list and personal-agent admission are configuration, ids only, and stay allowed under ZDR: the route-class registry of WS06-S4 classes them as config, not durable write; the Control entitlement and the room's own ZDR refusal still apply, K4-14); the SPA shows the catalogue text. Baseline: 1.3 #8 | Route-class registry inventory test (WS06-S4, fails on an unclassified route), `SELECT count(*)` before and after, user-core log, `zdr-contract-sync.test.sh` | ZDR tour at M1-M3 (M1-S4, M3-S8) |
| 6 | **Governance is usable and the security holes are closed.** An org admin applies a preset in the effect-policy console and a member's read flips from the typed `space_policy_not_provisioned` denial to success; the change leaves 1 policy event row and 1 audit-outbox row (`published_at` set) and reaches audit-core within 10 s; a member calling the admin route gets 403 with 0 Control calls; stale revision 409; same key replays `replayed:true`; a typed 403 never shows "log in again". `GET /api/v1/audit` as a member returns own rows only and 403 `audit_scope_denied` for another user, a forged `X-User-Role` gets 403; `POST /api/v1/scim/v2/Users` returns 501 with a SCIM error body, 0 store writes, 0 NATS events; an OIDC `jobTitle=Director` no longer yields an admin role. Baseline: 1.3 #7 | HAR for admin and member calls, SQL on `space_effect_policy_events`, `user_audit_outbox`, `member`; `curl -i` for SCIM | M1, M1-S5, M1-S8 (SCIM and container limits) |
| 7 | **Enterprise identity is real.** SCIM PATCH `active:false` removes the person's org membership, sessions and Space access; the replay is a no-op; the last owner is refused; Space decisions for that user are refused within the 30 s bound of `scripts/verify-deprovision.sh`; SSO `enforce` returns `sso_required` and a break-glass owner still signs in (password plus 2FA) | `verify-deprovision.sh` propagation table, IdP log (real IdP: UNVERIFIED until run), SQL on `organization_scim_users`, `member`, `user_org_memberships` | M2.3, M2-S2 |

Applies to every criterion:

- **Kill-switch drill.** Each flag in the delivering design is flipped off once on the rebuilt stack; the feature returns to the legacy path with no data change.
- **Strengths do not regress** (audit section 8): signed effect-bound decisions, deny-by-default effect policies, no widening of owner-plane ACLs, fail-closed ZDR, agents as Control service subjects, gateway binding policy, durable approvals, per-fire re-authorisation, honest-state `unavailable[]` UX. Section 6.1 maps every strength to its guard test; WS06, WS16, WS17 and WS20 also list them in the design; a PR that weakens one is rejected.
- **Client baseline** (WS07, WS16, in M1 and M2.3; scenarios M1-S7, M2-S8): a swapped build shows the new-version banner with no lost draft, a chunk-load failure reloads exactly once then shows a card, a room without `thread_read_entitled` shows 1 restricted notice with 0 `/transcript` requests, a `javascript:` link renders as text, an agent artifact is visible to B in the Artifacts tab, a preference set in browser A is present in a cleared browser B.
- **Pass rule** (section 6): positive path green; each negative refused with the typed code and no side effect; canary scan clean; baseline diff shows no new failing test; evidence bundle attached to the PR with a dated note beside `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/docs/SPACE_*`.
- **ZDR** is stated and tested per slice as typed refusal, refs-only, or local-only; the UI says what is unavailable rather than failing silently.

## 2. Decisions first (Space hybrid build plan, section 2)

State as of 2026-10-18. English, no emojis. Slice ids are the designs' (`WSnn-Sk`); the Model Plane plan's workstreams are written `mp-WSnn` and its decisions `DEC-nn`; the Quarry plan's are `q-WSn.X`, `ADR-n`, `OQ-n`, `X-n`. Space decisions get ids `SD-nn` (SD-00 = Decision 0, SD-01..SD-10 = audit ADR 1..10, SD-11 and up = additional) so they never collide with the siblings' ADR-0003/0005/0007/0008/0011 series.

### 2.0 Reading guide and the eight decisions that gate most work

**Deciders.** USER = the product/system owner must answer (recommendation given, "ok" accepts it). PLAN = this plan resolves it by default; the user may veto, cost of reversal stated. SIBLING = already decided in a sibling plan; Space adopts and amends its designs (listed in 2.3.2). Where only a sibling DRAFT exists it is marked.

**Gate codes** (sequencing is section 4; the gates are stated against slice order and the audit waves):
G0 before the first Space code PR that is not a List-A slice; G1 before the first merge of any slice that edits `session-core` (`grpc.rs`, `auth.rs`), a `.proto` or adds a migration; G2 before WS01-S3 (member append) and WS02-S3 (stream frames) start; G3 W1 exit / first staging enablement in a real org; G4 W2 start (WS08-WS15 main slices); G5 W2 flag-on in an org; G6 W3 start (WS17-WS20); EPIC = a later epic (E01-E12 in section 3.Z).

### 2.1 (A) Decision 0 (SD-00): product stance

**Question.** `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/docs/space-defenition.md` (COMMITTED, last commit `aae03af5`) says in its non-goals (L349-L356) "No auto-responding agents in rooms by default" and "No chat-feature parity race with Slack or Teams (presence, emoji, huddles, notification polish)", and its acceptance criteria (L363) "Agents answer only when explicitly invoked". The brief for this plan is a Teams + Slack + Grok Bot hybrid. Which wins?

**What actually conflicts.** Most of the brief does not.

| Brief element | Doc lines in tension | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Human posts, replies, DMs, edit/delete, attachments, search, read state | L24-L27 ("not building a better Slack or Teams"), L52-L54 ("not chat parity"), L352-L353 | Conflicts with the strategy text; not named as non-goals except emoji and notification polish |
| Addressed agent wake-up, several agents per message | none: L162-L164 "A mention invokes; it never grants", L363 | Consistent. Note L294 ("A mention is a signal, not a trigger") contradicts L163 inside the doc; L294 is about gated actions |
| Ambient agent participation (answers unaddressed) | L349, L159 ("No passive or unsolicited responses"), L161 | Conflicts |
| Calls and huddles | L25, L45, L352-L353 | Conflicts (audit ADR 7) |
| Personal agents with own PC and browser | L350 "no global agent available everywhere", L360 binding rule | Consistent if every presence in a room is an explicit binding |
| Delegation re-resolves authority per hop, initiating human recorded | L365-L368 | Already decided by the doc: this settles most of ADR 5 (SD-05) |

**Options.**

| Option | What it is | Unlocks | Blocks / costs |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0-A Hold the line | Keep the non-goals verbatim; build only agent-in-room depth | Smallest scope; WS03, WS05, WS06, WS07, WS09, WS10, WS17-S1/S2, WS18-WS20 proceed | The brief is not met: no human-only posts (WS01-S3..S6), no WS12 (DMs, reactions, edits), WS13 search UI, WS14 files, WS15 composer/timeline, WS16 sidebar, WS11 attention; the room stays an AI prompt box (audit 1.3 #1) |
| 0-B Brief overrides everything | Chat parity, ambient agents default on, calls now | Full parity story | Reverses the doc's safety posture; ambient default multiplies paid turns (audit risk 6; cost caps E01-S1/S3 do not exist yet); E05 calls cost 43-72 engineer-weeks and need ADR 7, an SFU purchase and a Control shared-room import decision first |
| 0-C Hybrid (recommended) | Accept chat parity for the Space chat core (posts, replies, DMs, edit/delete, reactions, attachments, search, read state, notifications); addressed wake-up is the default agent behaviour; ambient participation is a per-binding opt-in, default off, built only after cost caps and the approval gate (E01, WS10-S3); calls and huddles deferred behind ADR 7 with the upload-based meeting MVP (F-t1-050 minimal) as the fallback | All of WS01-WS16 and WS17-WS20; keeps every security principle of the doc (L268-L334 unchanged) | Ambient wake (WS08-S9 outline, E01) and E05 stay parked; "no chat parity race" is rewritten, not deleted |

**Recommendation: 0-C.** Why: the doc's own acceptance criteria (agents answer only when invoked, delegation per hop, no client-authored authority) are untouched by chat basics; the competitive claim ("agent in the room") survives; and without human posts the Slack-class half of the brief cannot exist. Ambient default-off keeps the one real safety line.

**Exact lines to amend in `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/docs/space-defenition.md`** (owner: the doc owner; amend in the first Space PR):

| Line(s) | Today | Amend to (gist) |
|---|---|---|
| 24-27 | "We are **not** building a better Slack or Microsoft Teams ... Fighting there is unwinnable" | "A room must be a real multi-person room (people post and reply without invoking a model; DMs; reactions; search); we still compete on the agent in the room, not on chat polish." |
| 52-54 | "Build that depth, not chat parity." | "Build that depth first; chat basics ship because a room without them is not a room." |
| 159, 161 | "No passive or unsolicited responses." / "No always-on presence by default." | Keep; add "(agent presence; a binding may opt in to ambient participation, default off)" |
| 294 | "A mention is a signal, not a trigger." | Add "for anything gated (approvals, moderation); an @mention of a bound agent is an explicit invocation (L163)" |
| 349 | "No auto-responding agents in rooms by default." | Keep; append "Ambient participation exists only as a per-binding opt-in, default off, rate-limited and cost-capped." |
| 352-353 | "No chat-feature parity race ... (presence, emoji, huddles, notification polish)" | "No chat-parity race beyond the Space chat core (posts, replies, DMs, edit/delete, reactions, attachments, search, read state, notifications). Calls and huddles are not planned until ADR 7 is accepted." |
| 363 | "Agents answer only when explicitly invoked." | "...invoked (an @mention or an Ask control used by a person with wake rights), or when the binding's ambient policy is on (default off). Human-only posts never invoke an agent." |
| 365-368 | delegation and initiating-human criteria | Unchanged; cite as the accepted answer to ADR 5 |
| 376+ (Open questions) | personal-Space agent question "still open as of 2026-09-07" | Re-date after WS17-S4 decision |

**Sibling status.** Not addressed by either sibling. Quarry plan Q7 (approved) already states "Space members cannot view or drive another member's browser"; Model plan DEC-26 keeps `@` for Space agents. Neither conflicts with 0-C.
**Decider:** USER. **Latest step:** G0 (before WS01-S3 and any W2 chat-basics slice). **Meanwhile:** WS01-S1, WS01-S7a, WS02-S1/S2, WS03, WS04-S1..S3, WS05-S1..S3, WS06, WS07 proceed under any option.

### 2.2 (B) ADR 1 to ADR 10 (SD-01..SD-10)

#### SD-01 / ADR 1: ownership of human room messages and shared-thread append authority
- **Question.** Which plane holds human posts, and who may append to a shared thread?
- **Options.** A: Session Core stays the single transcript owner; reuse the member-capable Control `thread:append` decision (`apps/Control Plane/user-core/internal/spaces/personal_thread_decision.go`); add `post_kind` and DM kinds. B: human posts in an Application store (two write paths on one transcript).
- **Recommendation: A.** Why: `AppendMessage` already carries the Space decision fields; the owner-only check is at `session-core/src/grpc.rs:4504`; ZDR callers are already refused durable writes; Model plan section 5.1 row 1 names Session Core "the single conversation writer; Convex has no message table".
- **Two amendments forced by the siblings.** (1) Space adds only `post_kind`; it does not add a `turn_origin` to the append (DEC-17, SD-15). (2) Send dedupe is not built by WS01: mp-WS04-S6 already plans `AppendMessageRequest.client_message_id = 18`, `AppendMessageResponse.message_id = 2`, `deduplicated = 3` and a unique `(thread_id, client_message_id)` index. WS01-S1's `client_message_key = 19` and `message_send_dedupe` table are dropped; `post_kind` takes the next free tag (19 provisional).
- **Gates.** WS01-S2, WS01-S3 (should wait for acceptance); WS08-S2; WS10-S6, S7; WS12-S4..S7; WS13-S10, S11; WS15-S9.
- **Can proceed without.** WS01-S1 (as amended), WS01-S7a, WS01-S8; WS02-S1..S5 (written for A); WS10-S1..S5; WS12-S1..S3.
- **Sibling status.** Consistent with Model plan 5.1 row 1; the "first to land owns `append_message_in_tx`" rule (2.6 row 12) applies to WS01-S3, mp-WS04-S6, mp-WS17-S8.
- **Decider:** USER (accept). Latest G2.

#### SD-02 / ADR 2: realtime delivery tier under ZDR and Space authority
- **Options.** A: frames carry content, authority checked at subscribe only. B: frames carry ids and kinds only; authority checked at subscribe and at every delivery; push is a content-free wake; ZDR orgs get no content cache.
- **Recommendation: B.** Why: matches WS02 (Session Core log, gRPC tail, new Control audience `model-plane-space-stream`), WS09 (per-viewer re-authorised stream) and Quarry plan ADR-8 (replay ring live-only, nothing published for ZDR runs). Verified in the audit: current Control audiences are closed to Session Core, so a new audience is needed (WS02-S2).
- **Amendments.** Run-state kinds in frames come from mp-WS15/WS16's closed enum through one mapping function (C17, DEC-11), not a Space-private vocabulary; the per-user attention hub is Model's (DEC-38, SD-17).
- **Gates.** WS02-S3..S5, WS09-S4, WS10-S6 (live updates), WS11-S5.., WS20-S6; epics E08 (push), F-t1-080.
- **Can proceed without.** WS02-S1, S2; WS09-S1..S3, S7; WS11-S1..S4; all slices poll at 6 s until S4.
- **Hard prerequisite outside Space for WS02-S7 and WS11-S5 only.** mp-WS01 S2 (audit outbox publisher fix, deployed; Model 2.6 row 20; only `VEREVON_AUDIT` and `mp.v1.run.%.event` subjects are admitted by the outbox today). WS02-S1..S5 do not use the outbox (gRPC tail with Postgres NOTIFY, no NATS publication).
- **Decider:** USER (accept). Latest G2.

#### SD-03 / ADR 3: agent memory ownership, audience labels, declassification
- **Options.** A: Model Plane (session-core) owns learned memory and the resolver, Data v2 only authored documents; label at write, fold at read, Letta gets the same filter. B: exclude personal memory from shared rooms until labels exist.
- **Recommendation: A, with B as the interim.** Containment first (WS17-S1, S2 in W1, overriding the audit's W3 placement per cross-audit O3), then labels (S3).
- **Why.** Verified leak vector today: a Space message becomes the thread owner's user-level memory with no Space tag.
- **Sibling status: decided by the Model plan.** DEC-06 (memory skipped on Space-scoped Do runs, `SKIPPED_BY_POLICY(space_scope)`); Model 2.6 row 13: one migration `(scope_kind, scope_id)` plus audience predicate `(audience_hash, audience_revision, source_label)`, owner session-core, WS17-S1 = F-t3-060 step 1, `mp-WS07` ships the shared helper first, Space applies it to Dreaming and the Letta bridge. WS17-S3's label schema must adopt `(scope_kind, scope_id)` (C12, C13, C23).
- **Gates.** WS17-S3 (waits for acceptance); WS07-D2 and WS09-D1 (how much step detail non-owners see); WS13 D-2 (index assistant text until labels exist); E02.
- **Can proceed without.** WS17-S1, S2.
- **Decider:** USER (ratify the sibling's answer). Latest G6 for S3; S1/S2 need nothing.

#### SD-04 / ADR 4: personal agents as service subjects
- **Options.** A: owner-derived admission, the agent-to-owner link recorded as a Control fact, cascade on ban/suspension. B: Application-only add policy (advisory).
- **Recommendation: A.** Why: every cascade (ban, SCIM suspension, WS05-S9 probe) needs the Control link; B would be advisory.
- **Sibling status.** None. Model DEC-28 (Spaces as chat project) does not touch it.
- **Gates.** WS17-S4, S5, S6; the agent half of WS05-S9; E06 moderation.
- **Can proceed without.** WS17-S1..S3; all of WS05 except the agent cascade.
- **Decider:** USER (ratify). Latest G6.

#### SD-05 / ADR 5: delegation and whose authority an agent acts under
- **Already decided in the doc:** L365-L368 (delegate only inside one Space, each hop re-resolves its own authority, initiating human recorded, approvals belong to that person). Recommendation: re-resolve per hop, record the initiating human; formalise, do not reopen.
- **The open half (new, decide now).** A non-owner member who replies in someone else's thread cannot run an agent there: the run belongs to the thread starter (WS08-D-1, WS09-D4). Slack-class rooms normally allow it.
  - Option 1 (assumed, WS08): only the thread owner's own post wakes; members "ask in your own post". Honest UI copy required.
  - Option 2 (WS08-S10, WS09-S9): member-invoked runs owned by the invoking member in the same thread; needs a Session Core member start gate, owner-bound read changes, quarantine (WS10-S8) and the Control run-steer decision.
- **Recommendation:** Option 1 for W2, fund Option 2 after W2 exit (it is the largest single UX gap left in a "multi-person room").
- **Sibling status.** Model DEC-07: member steering waits for a Control "run steer" decision (WS09-S7 is exactly that deliverable); mp-WS04 bus will accept an `authorized_actor`. Model DEC-16 covers unattended runs only.
- **Gates.** WS08-S10; WS09-S9; WS10-S6, S7; WS18 D-4 (pin meaning); E01 multi-agent.
- **Can proceed without.** WS08-S1..S6, S8 (Option 1), WS09-S1..S8, WS10-S1..S5.
- **Decider:** USER (fund Option 2 or not). Latest G4 for the statement; G5 for funding.

#### SD-06 / ADR 6: agent computer network boundary, persistence, local execution
- **Options.** 1: keep "Model proposes, Quarry executes" and define an equivalent policy point for any new executor class. 2: sandboxes reach the network directly.
- **Recommendation: 1; park enforcement.** Verified: no Space agent path has network today; gaps are resource caps (WS06-S7..S10, no decision needed), a Quarry egress route (WS06-S11, XL, parked) and ZDR handling in sandbox-manager.
- **Sibling status: partly decided.** DEC-22: sandbox only, Endpoint Plane stays out (F-t1-096 stays parked, C20), SandboxBackend trait only with a second backend; mp-WS22-S1 already adds `AcquireLeaseRequest.zdr = 8` and sandbox-manager migration 0005, so WS06-S6b merges into mp-WS22-S1. Enforcement point (C8: Quarry tunnel vs netns/firewall in execution-core) is open in all three plans.
- **Gates.** WS06-S11; E02.
- **Can proceed without.** WS06-S1..S10 (S5 closed egress vocabulary lands in Control claims in lockstep, schema `space-capability-profile-v2`).
- **Decider:** PLAN (defer); USER only when a feature needs network. Latest EPIC.

#### SD-07 / ADR 7: calls and meetings
- **Options.** Bought SFU with Control-authorised join and an Application call record keyed by `spaceRef`; child Space kind (amends ADR-0001); keep the non-goal and build the upload-based meeting MVP only.
- **Recommendation:** follows SD-00. Under 0-C: defer all of it, keep the upload-based MVP as fallback; if later wanted: sub-resource plus bought SFU, and the shared-room import decision first (verified critical path, not ASR).
- **Gates.** No WS01-WS20 slice. E05 only (43-72 engineer-weeks).
- **Sibling status.** None.
- **Decider:** PLAN under 0-C; USER if 0-B. Latest EPIC.

#### SD-08 / ADR 8: retention, legal hold, ZDR precedence
- **Options.** A: hold over retention over ZDR refusals unchanged, each owner plane runs its own sweeper with honest receipts. B: a central sweeper (needs cross-plane DB access, rejected by plane rules).
- **Recommendation: A**, Session Core's TTL sweeper first.
- **Sibling status: open in both.** Model 5.1 row "Audit, cost, retention" and S-C8: retention value in `space_effect_policies` vs org-core `DataRetentionDays` open; "OWNER to rule precedence" once for all three plans. Quarry ADR-4 matrix keeps every refusal.
- **Gates.** WS19 production for regulated orgs (D-6; canvas pilot-only until answered), WS02-D2 replay window, WS12 D-WS12-2 (original text on edit/delete), E07.
- **Can proceed without.** Everything builds with phase-1 defaults (keep versions, purge on Space deletion and org erasure).
- **Decider:** USER with counsel. Latest G5 (before any regulated org is onboarded).

#### SD-09 / ADR 9: message search index placement
- **Options.** A: Session Core expression index, excluding ZDR and waived-run threads, per-hit re-authorisation. B: copy in Data v2 or Convex (second durable store).
- **Recommendation: A.** Why: identical to Model DEC-29 (expression GIN on `messages` in session-core, FTS `simple`, RPC `SearchMessages`); plane rules forbid B.
- **Sibling status: decided.** Residual conflict D-1 (O10): two indexes on the same table. Rule: WS13-S1 uses disjoint partial indexes (`space_id IS NOT NULL`), shares `build_tsquery` with mp-WS17-S3, whichever lands second rebases (also skips revised-away originals, 2.6 row 12). Migration numbers per 2.3.1.
- **Gates.** WS13-S1 (restart if B). **Can proceed without.** WS13-S4a (S5..S7 wait for SD-00 at G0).
- **Decider:** PLAN (accept; zero cost). Latest before WS13-S1 starts (G4).

#### SD-10 / ADR 10: external surfaces and guests
- **Options.** Guests as a distinct subject type in auth-core with the S5.1 link graph; or guests as plain org members.
- **Recommendation:** distinct subject type, later. **v1 constraint (decide now):** rooms are single-organisation; designs assume it (WS06 egress intersection, WS04 audience, WS14 grants).
- **Sibling status.** Model DEC-40 parks the Channel Plane (docs-only per CLAUDE.md); Quarry ADR-7 defers external MCP. Both consistent.
- **Gates.** E06, F-t1-075/093 only. **Decider:** PLAN. Latest EPIC.

#### 2.3.6 What Space owes the siblings (their typed refusals lift only when these ship)

Model plan DEC-06 refuses Space-scoped paths until Space delivers: (1) `space_scope_for_thread(thread_id)` BFF helper and the "Visible to N members" confirmation semantics (mp-WS18; WS01-S5 gateway module); (2) owner-only grant semantics and the Control standing-rule record `{subject, space_ref, agent_ref, action_hash, scope, expiry, revoked}` (WS10-S2); (3) the shared-Space capability decision family (SD-28); (4) the audience predicate `(audience_hash, audience_revision, source_label)` (WS17-S3); (5) the Control run-steer decision so the bus can accept `authorized_actor` (WS09-S7); (6) per-member `thread:append` decisions and `history_from` on member add (WS01-S2, WS04-S11); (7) the `GET /v1/audit` role-gate fix and admin view (WS05-S1, S4); (8) a Space decision on `@` (kept for agents; mp-WS23 uses chips first). Toward Quarry: `space_ref` as run-start attribution only, never in a grant (C1), and a decision on a masked frame stream (SD-23).

## 3. Workstreams

Section 3 holds one subsection per workstream (WS01 to WS20, 3.A to 3.E) in build-wave order, then the epics for later waves (3.Z). Each workstream subsection lists: the audit items it resolves, owner plane and service, lane and milestone, dependencies and decisions, the verified starting point, slices (id, size, engineer-weeks, plane, flag, dependency), the file-level change list with path tags, API/proto/data-model/migration changes with the final numbers from section 4.6, flags and rollout, tests with commands, definition of done and evidence, risks, cross-session touchpoints and open questions. Slice ids (`WSnn-Sk`) are the ones used in sections 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7. Where a workstream text and a section-2/4/5 table disagree, sections 2, 4 and 5 decide (they were written after the designs and re-verified the sibling branches on 2026-10-20).

| Part | Workstreams | Theme |
|---|---|---|
| 3.A | WS01 to WS04 | Human posts and reliable send, realtime substrate, governance admin, room administration |
| 3.B | WS05, WS06, WS07, WS16 | Security fixes and enterprise identity, Model Plane safety, frontend quick wins and artifacts, UI baseline and sidebar |
| 3.C | WS08 to WS11 | Addressed wake-up and mentions, agent work visible to the room, approvals, notifications and attention |
| 3.D | WS12 to WS15 | DMs and message lifecycle, search and navigation, attachments and sharing, composer and timeline |
| 3.E | WS17 to WS20 | Personal agents and memory, agent self-API, room canvas, room-scoped agent browser |
| 3.Z | E01 to E12 | Later waves as epics (W3 recommended, W4, W5) with the index of all 96 audit items |


### 3.A: Wave 1 foundations: human posts, realtime substrate, governance admin, room administration

- Delivers four W1 workstreams that make the room a place people can use together: people post and reply without waking a model (WS01), every member sees changes within about a second on one resumable stream (WS02), org admins govern Space effects with typed, honest denials (WS03), and rooms get a real roster, rename, archive, directory and audience (WS04).
- Order: WS03-S1/S2, WS04-S1/S2/S3, WS01-S7a and WS02-S1/S2 start at once (no shared prerequisite beyond `M0-BASE` and the seams); then the G2 train (WS01-S2, WS04-S4, WS01-S3, WS02-S3), then gateway (WS01-S5, WS02-S4, WS03-S4/S5, WS04-S5/S6), then SPA; WS04-S8..S12 follow in M2.2. `WS09-S1` (run guard) must be ON before `space_human_posts_core` is ON anywhere.
- Evidence rule for every slice: rebuilt local images, a running stack, the named end-to-end flow verified by someone who did not write the slice (`06` scenarios M1-S1 to M1-S4, M1-S5, M1-S6).

#### WS01 Human posts, reliable send, thread pane

- **Resolves**: F-t1-001 Human-first room conversation (Priority, Partial, L, W1); F-t1-033 Reliable send (Recommended, Partial, M, W1). **Owner plane and service**: Model Plane (session-core, model-gateway) for the write, Control (user-core) for the signed `thread:append` v2 decision, Frontend (gateway BFF + SPA) for routes and UI. **Lane and milestone**: L1 (S1, S3, S4), L4 (S2), L7 (S5), L8 (S6, S7a, S7b, S8); M1. **Depends on**: `P-SC1`, `P-GW1`, `P-UC1`, `P-SPA1`, `P-SPA2`; SD-11/G1 before S1 merges; SD-01 (ADR 1) accepted (G2) before S2/S3 merge, S1, S7a, S8 can start without it; SD-12/G3 before any enforcement flip; SD-16 (default Send) only sets a prop default, both modes ship; `WS09-S1` ON before `space_human_posts_core` (R4); (b)'s `client_message_id` (mp-WS04.S6) for S1/S8, or Space lands that half under (b)'s name and number (04 4.10 #6; otherwise S1 and S8 wait); WS04-S5 (c) before the second-member DoD flow and before staging (a shared-Space decision needs the caller in Control's recipient-audience snapshot; nothing registers one today, see WS04 verified starting points); until then `M0-T0` seeds the audience with `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/recipient-audiences` (principal `application-space-lifecycle`) (K2-03).

**Verified starting point**
- The room composer always streams a model turn: `submitMessage` calls `streamChat`, no idempotency key, no `resumeStream` (`apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceRoomComposer.tsx:376-402,746,769` [M], one ZDR line at :465).
- The BFF cannot reach Session Core (`session_core_url` is Control's, `apps/gateway/src/config.rs:30,55,171` [C]); model-gateway has only `GET /v1/threads/:thread_id/messages` (`apps/Model Plane/rust/services/model-gateway/src/http_routes.rs:177` [M]; route table :144-181). The audit's "gateway no-invoke routes" therefore need a new model-gateway route (audit missed).
- Two owner-only refusals in `apps/Model Plane/rust/services/session-core/src/grpc.rs` [M]: the handler `append_message` (:4495) calls `authorize_thread_owner(.., OwnerIntent::Mutate)` at :4504 (fn :294); the signed decision subject must equal the owner (`verify_append_space_decision_with_key` :2014, wrapper :2102, digest `thread_append_payload_digest` :1631, owner row passed in `append_message_in_tx` :2432). Audit cited :2432-2530 for the verifier; it is :2014-2100. `AppendMessage` itself has no uncommitted hunk (file has 817 changed lines elsewhere).
- Containment vectors the audit did not list: a user message becomes the owner's memory in the append transaction (`extract_memory_candidates` :2633, `persist_candidates` :2642), Dreaming reads every user/assistant row by thread owner (`dreaming.rs:1263` `load_pending_messages`, :1311 `load_preceding_context` [M]), context assembly `load_thread_messages` (:4048), model-gateway history `sse.rs:5350-5433` [M], and the model-callable `reattach_context` tool (`tool_loop.rs:3237`, owner-bound `ListConversation`; contained only because the posts filter is the default of the request, K2-01). Thread columns are rewritten on every scoped append (:2500 `UPDATE threads SET space_decision_ref`), message INSERT copies them (:2571).
- Control already mints a member-capable decision: `apps/Control Plane/user-core/internal/spaces/personal_thread_decision.go:313-380` [C] (schema const `sha256:thread-append-v1` :20, lifetime 2 min :21), http `internal/http/spaces.go:571` [C]; it does not check the thread belongs to the Space (Session Core does).
- "Dedupe run start" already exists (`managed_start_key.rs` [C], `UNIQUE (org_id,user_id,start_key)`), but the user message is appended before `start_managed_run` (`session_flow.rs:484-507` vs :523 [M]), so a retry duplicates the message. Ruling (02 SD-01 amendment 2): the append dedupe is (b)'s `client_message_id`, not a Space table.
- `?thread_id=` is emitted at `activity-grammar.ts:200,326` and read by nothing; `SpacePage.tsx` has no `useSearchParams` and no pane; the unread rule skips threads the viewer owns (`apps/Application Plane/convex-core/convex/spaceReadMarkers.ts:50-67`, mirror `src/features/spaces/lib/space-unread.ts:23-43`), so a reply in my own thread would never badge.
- Live-tree-only files this slice depends on: `zdr_refusal.rs` [U], `zdr-posture-matrix.json` [U], SPA `src/shared/api/zdr-refusals.ts` [U] and `contracts/` [U dir], `chat-client.ts` [M], `errors.ts` [M]; all committed on `model-plane`. The 2-line `SpaceRoomComposer.tsx` change must be landed or discarded by the owner before `P-SPA2` (04 4.1.2).

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- Migration 0071 only (see 3.A.0). No Convex table, no user-core migration (next free stays 053 overall).
- `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/threads` body `{content (1..8000 chars, no NUL), client_send_id (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$)}` -> 201 `{data:{space_ref,thread_id,message_id,sequence,deduplicated}}` (200 when deduplicated). `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/threads/{thread_id}/messages` same body -> 201 `{data:{thread_id,message_id,sequence,deduplicated}}`. Errors (typed envelope): 400 `invalid_post` (`details.max_chars`), 400 `invalid_client_send_id`, 403 `active_membership_required`, 403 `space_post_not_authorized` (Control gives no reason; WS03 fills `details.reason`), 404 `space_not_found`, 404 `thread_not_found`, 404 `space_human_posts_disabled`, 409 `idempotency_key_conflict`, 409 `space_authority_stale` (BFF re-mints once), 409 `thread_state_conflict`, 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden` (typed, before any Control call), 503 `zdr_decision_unavailable` (typed, org-core failure), 503 `space_lifecycle_unavailable`, `space_decision_unavailable`, `delegated_auth_unavailable`, `session_unavailable`, 502 `post_not_stored` (create ok, append failed; retry with same keys).
- `GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/context` adds `data.features{human_posts,thread_pane,send_idempotency,connectivity_banner}` and `data.limits{post_max_chars:8000}`; list threads adds `reply_count`, `last_author_subject_id`; transcript turns add `post_kind`.
- model-gateway: `POST /v1/threads` `{space_context, session_key, first_message:{content,post_kind:"post",client_message_id}}` (Space threads only), `POST /v1/threads/:thread_id/messages` `{content,post_kind:"post",client_message_id,space_append_context}`; typed structs `deny_unknown_fields`; `role` fixed to `user`; org from claims. gRPC map: PermissionDenied -> 403 `space_post_not_authorized`, NotFound -> 404, AlreadyExists -> 409 `idempotency_key_conflict`, Aborted -> 409 `space_authority_stale`, InvalidArgument -> 400, FailedPrecondition with ZDR trailer -> typed 412 (`Refusal::from_status`) else 409, other 503.
- Session Core `AppendMessage` (no new RPC): member gate allowed only when all hold: flag on, human caller, org equal, `role=='user'`, `post_kind=='post'`, complete decision envelope with the v2 schema, thread Space equals request Space, owner not a system owner, no `space_membership_revocations` row (migration 0032) for (space, caller), 1..32768 bytes. Member decision subject is the caller; reject `Status::aborted("space_authority_stale")` when `req.recipient_audience_revision < threads.recipient_audience_revision`; no thread-column UPDATE; stamp the message from the verified request; ignore client `metadata`.
- Control: `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/thread-append-decision` +optional `post_kind` (`""`/`turn` keeps v1); `post` keeps each Space kind's floor (editor/manager/owner, `thread_create_entitled`, active recipient); no new entitlement bit.
- Event `MESSAGE_APPENDED` payload gains `post_kind`, `author_subject_id` (ids and kinds only; whether the outbox publishes it is WS02's, UNVERIFIED).
- Action registry: `spaces.create_post`, `spaces.reply_in_thread` (ownerPlane `model`, risk low, no approval, `reversible:false`); human-only (negative assertion in `catalog-manifest.test.ts`).

**Definition of done and evidence** (`06` M1-S1, M1-S3, M1-S4)
1. Rebuild: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `cd "apps/Model Plane" && SPACE_HUMAN_POSTS_CORE=1 SPACE_HUMAN_POSTS_API=1 ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway`; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway`; second Vite server (`:5173` is the main checkout's container). Prove up with `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3185/health` and `psql` (`\d messages` shows `post_kind`); session-core `/healthz` proves nothing.
2. Flow: A posts in a room where B is editor (policy row seeded by `apps/Control Plane/scripts/set-space-effect-policy.sh` or WS03-S1; precondition: B is in Control's recipient-audience snapshot, via WS04-S5 (c) or the `M0-T0` seed `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/recipient-audiences`, otherwise B's `thread-append-decision` is refused): one `messages` row (`post_kind='post'`, author A), zero `runs` rows; B opens `/spaces/<ref>?thread_id=<id>#chat` within 6 s and replies; thread columns and `agent_memory` unchanged; A sees reply, count and unread badge; A asks the agent: `GET /v1/threads/<id>/context` has no post; same `client_send_id` replay -> `deduplicated:true`, changed text -> 409; response dropped mid-send -> one row after retry.
3. Negative: viewer and non-member 403 with no row; remove B then B's next post refused; stale decision -> `space_authority_stale` once then success; ZDR org -> typed 412 with no user-core call (check logs).
4. Capture: SQL per step, HAR of both POSTs, screenshots (pane, restricted state, banner), content-free log excerpts, Playwright trace, `cargo test`, `go test`, `vitest` summaries; dated note beside `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/docs/SPACE_*`.

**Risks and mitigations**: two write paths drift -> single `AppendMessage`, one gate, path-matrix test (owner turn, owner post, member post, assistant); member text enters owner memory or context -> filters always on and inverted by default (`include_human_posts` false for every `ListConversation` caller, including `reattach_context`), DB negative tests, WS08 owns fenced inclusion; `grpc.rs` conflicts (817 changed lines, `sse.rs` +6,305 on `model-plane`) -> new logic in `src/space/*`, `sse.rs` literal fixes only; stale decision after removal (2-minute life) -> revocation row + stale-revision check; thread-receipt gap (a waived `AppendMessage` is not checked against its thread's posture, `live-tree-delta.md` item 10) -> refuse at BFF and model-gateway, DoD includes a ZDR org check; owner deletes a thread holding others' posts -> no author-level erase built; post flood -> 8,000-char cap and fleet limiter (moderation is F-t1-043); Solid 2 reactivity traps -> two-phase `createEffect` pattern of `SpacePage.tsx:145-190`.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- Member append gate, `post_kind`, `append_message_in_tx_as` (X01): Space owns; (b) rebases receipts and tree slices on it.
- Send receipts / `client_message_id`, `deduplicated` (X02): **b** owns; question to (b): unique key includes author, and may Space land mp-WS04.S6 under (b)'s name and number.

#### WS02 Space realtime substrate

- **Resolves**: F-t1-003 Space realtime substrate (Priority, Absent, XL, W1; verdict: Session Core, not the Application Plane, is the first emitter). **Owner plane and service**: Model Plane (session-core log and `SpaceEvents` gRPC, model-gateway SSE route), Control (user-core audience), Frontend (gateway relay, SPA controller). **Lane and milestone**: L2 (S1, S3), L4 (S2), L7 (S4), L8 (S5); M1; S6 and S7 conditional. **Depends on**: `P-SC1`, `P-UC1`, `P-GW1`, `P-SPA1`; base must contain migrations 0044/0045 (`runs.retention_class`, committed on `model-plane`); G2 (SD-01 and SD-02 accepted) before S3 merges, S1 and S2 can start without it; SD-25 defaults (gRPC tail, 14-day replay, ~10 s revocation SLO, personal Spaces in) are plan-decided.

**Verified starting point**
- Poll is the only mechanism, and it carries more than the listing: presence beats ride the listing effect (`SpacePage.tsx:196-240`), `markSpaceRead` fires on each visible listing (:183-190), the 30 s authority recheck refetches threads (:317-338); `PRESENCE_TTL_MS = 30_000` (`apps/Application Plane/convex-core/convex/spacePresence.ts:42`, verified). Slowing the poll naively breaks presence and typing, so S5 decouples the beat. Files [C].
- The audit's "no thread-appended event exists" is wrong: Session Core already writes `THREAD_CREATED`, `MESSAGE_APPENDED` (~:2604-2630), presentation, archive and run events in the writer's own transaction (`grpc.rs` [M]); what is missing is a per-Space sequence and a serving path. Run state comes from the `runs` table, not `mp.v1.run.*.event`, whose envelope has no Space ids (`apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-events/src/envelope.rs` [C]) and whose outbox admits only audit and `mp.v1.run.<id>.event` (`audit_publisher.rs`, CHECK in migration 0016).
- Control's thread-read audience map has exactly two entries, `ThreadReadAudienceSessionCore` and `ThreadReadAudienceSandboxManager = "model-plane-sandbox-manager"` (`apps/Control Plane/user-core/internal/spaces/shared_thread_read_decision.go:41-52`, verified); decisions live 2 min (`personal_thread_decision.go:21`); the Session Core verifier keeps only the revision and discards expiry, issue time and the `zero_data_retention` claim (`grpc.rs` ~:631-662, :1803-1808).
- Revocation reaches Session Core through `space_membership_revocations` (migration 0032) written by a plain-NATS consumer (`space_membership_nats.rs`); no Application-side projection exists for events (`convex/schema.ts` has no per-Space event table) and the gateway has no Model Plane NATS identity.
- Gateway SSE relay is a byte passthrough with a 15 s comment ticker (`apps/gateway/src/upstream.rs:1698-1866`, `src/domains/chat/streams.rs:134-214`) and validates nothing; SPA `readSseStream` (`src/shared/api/sse.ts:29`, `lastEventId` supported) [M].
- Erasure: `gdpr.rs:97-110` acts only on organization erase; thread erasure is `delete_space_threads` (`grpc.rs:6058`). `HEALTH_SERVICE_NAMES` (`grpc.rs:48`) has 8 entries (becomes 9). Space ZDR is "not applied in v1" (`zdr_posture.rs` [U]).

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- Migration 0072 (above). Proto: new file `space_events.proto` (no tag collision with `sessions.proto`; one proto-bearing PR at a time, R2): `StreamSpaceEventsRequest{org_id=1,user_id=2,space_id=3,decision_ref=4,decision_token=5,resume=6,generation=7,after_seq=8}`; `SpaceEventFrame` oneof `connected=1,event=2,heartbeat=3,cursor_too_old=4,closing=5`; `SpaceEventRecord` fields 1-17 (seq, generation, kind, at, actor_type, actor_id, thread_id, run_id, message_id, message_sequence, role, agent_id, state, prev_state, origin, fields, parent_run_id).
- Wire (SSE, ids and kinds only, ADR 2 option B): events `connected{v,space_id,generation,head,resumed,lease_seconds,heartbeat_seconds,mode:live|poll_only}`, `space_event{v,source:"session",space_id,generation,seq,kind,at,actor{type,id?},refs}`, `heartbeat{head,generation}` every 10 s, `cursor_too_old{reason:retention|generation_changed|ahead_of_head}`, `closing{code,reconnect,retry_after_ms}`, `error{error:{code,message,details}}`; SSE `id` = `<generation>.<seq>`; seq strictly contiguous per generation (`hidden` stubs for rows the subscriber may not see, `redacted` for erased rows). Closed kinds v1: `thread.created`, `message.appended`, `thread.updated`, `thread.archived`, `thread.deleted`, `run.state_changed` (state in queued, running, awaiting_approval, completed, failed, cancelled, other, through one function `space_events::run_state` so (b)'s enum change (C17) edits one place), `hidden`, `redacted`; later WS add triggers, never replace shared ones. Closing codes: `lease_expired`, `reauthorize`, `slow_consumer`, `server_draining` (S6), `upstream_unavailable`, `membership_revoked`, `zdr_poll_only`, `invalid_frame`.
- Gate per row and per heartbeat (pure, unit-tested): `now >= lease_until` (min(decision expiry minus 10 s, 85-100 s jittered)) closes `lease_expired`; revocation row `revoked_at >= decision.issued_at - 5 s` closes `membership_revoked` (2 s shared cache); `row.audience_revision` above the decision ceiling closes `reauthorize`; unknown `scope` stubs `hidden`; caller ZDR or decision `zero_data_retention` gives `poll_only` with no rows. Visibility equals the listing rule (`t.recipient_audience_revision <= decision revision`).
- Errors: model-gateway maps `UNAUTHENTICATED` 401 `unauthorized`, `PERMISSION_DENIED` 403 `space_stream_forbidden`, `INVALID_ARGUMENT` 400 `invalid_request`, `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` 503 `space_stream_capacity` (Retry-After), else 503 `space_stream_unavailable`. BFF: 404 `space_stream_disabled`, 403 `active_membership_required`, 400 `invalid_space`/`invalid_cursor`, 429 `rate_limited`/`space_stream_capacity`, 502 `invalid_space_decision`/`invalid_model_gateway_response`; org ZDR answers 200 `connected{mode:"poll_only"}` then `closing{zdr_poll_only,reconnect:false}`. Not ZDR refusals, so no catalogue entry.
- Decision mint: BFF posts to `.../spaces/thread-read-decision` with `service_audience:"model-plane-space-stream"` (new key `space-stream-<nanos>`), headers `x-space-decision-ref/-token` (not query) to model-gateway; decision never reaches the browser; no frame buffer or Dragonfly copy.
- No action-registry entry (subscribing is a transport, nothing model-eligible); no Convex table; no NATS publication in S1-S5.

**Flags and rollout**

| Flag | Owner and default | Kill switch | ZDR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `space_realtime_emit` (`SPACE_REALTIME_EMIT`) | session-core, written to `space_event_settings` at boot; false in release artifacts, compose dev true | set false + restart; off-to-on bumps `generation` (clients resnapshot via `cursor_too_old{generation_changed}`) | no rows for ZDR runs (CHECK and trigger) |
| `space_realtime_stream` (`SPACE_REALTIME_STREAM`) | gateway, `SpaceFeatureFlags` via `env_bool(key, dev_flags_allowed(APP_ENV))`; off in production | false + gateway restart: SPA gets 404 and stays on the 6 s poll | org ZDR gets `poll_only` even when on |

Order: S1 and S2 everywhere (emit off in production) -> S3, S4, S5 to dev with both flags on and the evidence flow -> emit on in staging, wait one sweeper cycle (15 min) -> stream on in staging -> production emit then stream for one org (G2, G3). Deploy order in a release: session-core, model-gateway, user-core, gateway, SPA. Flags never carry authority.

**Definition of done and evidence** (`06` M1-S2, M1-S3, M1-S4)
1. Rebuild and start: `cd "apps/Model Plane" && ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway`; `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway frontend`, restart the frontend container and hard-reload. Capture `docker compose ps`, image ids, migrations-applied and listener-subscribed log lines; `\d space_event_log`, `SELECT enabled FROM space_event_settings`.
2. Flow: two tabs (A, B) in one shared room: one `GET /api/v1/spaces/{ref}/events` per tab and no 6 s `/threads` timer; A sends, B updates within 1.5 s p95 via frame-triggered refetch; raw SSE capture contains no message text; `space_event_log` rows show ids and kinds only; three leases (about 5 min) with no gap or flicker, about one decision mint per tab per 90 s.
3. Degrade and recover: stop session-core, B shows the degraded indicator within 35 s and polls every 6 s; restart, resume by `Last-Event-ID` with no gap. Revocation: remove B, stream closes `membership_revoked` within 15 s p95 (130 s hard), a new `/events` is 403; cross-use of tokens denied at gRPC level. ZDR org: `connected.mode=poll_only`, zero rows. Erasure: owner deletes a thread, other tab gets `thread.deleted`, earlier rows read `redacted`. Kill-switch drill for both flags.
4. Capture: recording, HAR, SQL, container logs, metrics `mp_session_space_stream_active`, opened/closed by reason, frames by kind, emit errors (closed-word labels only).

**Risks and mitigations**: trigger defect or hot-path overhead -> fail-open with `space_event_errors`, `WHEN` clauses keep non-Space writes out, emit flag; head-row lock contention in a busy Space -> lock taken last at commit, only run state and posts emit, measure in S6; lock-order inversion by a future path -> documented rule, deferred firing; NOTIFY loss -> 30 s floor poll and wake-all after reconnect (correctness comes from the table); stream reads starving the 20-connection pool -> dedicated pool (`SPACE_STREAM_DB_POOL` 8) and `SPACE_STREAM_MAX_STREAMS` 5000; refetch herd -> client coalescing (300 ms + jitter, min 1.5 s) and WS15 windows later; HTTP/1.1 six-connection limit -> at most two long-lived streams per tab (X35), confirm HTTP/2 at the edge, else S6 leader tab; revocation latency up to the decision life -> lease expiry is the hard bound; clock skew -> 5 s tolerance in the fail-closed direction; uncommitted base -> state it in the PR, S1 cannot merge before 0044 is committed on `space`.

**Cross-session touchpoints**: `messages`/`runs`/`threads` write paths (X01, X04): b owns the tables, WS02 owns the triggers (a non-visible-version change edits only the messages trigger `WHEN`); run-state vocabulary (X12, X13): b owns the enum, Space owns `ROOM_EVENT_POLICY` (default deny for new `ChatEvent`s) and the single mapper; outbox and NATS (X31): b owns `classify_outbox_subject`, WS02-S7 would add `mp.v1.space.*.event` through the `P-CFG` train; two-streams-per-tab cap (X35, with WS11); `runs.retention_class` (X10, WS06); telemetry labels (X11); `ROOM_EVENT_POLICY` and WS09 reuse the gate for run-read authority; no change to `model_plane.v1.Event` (a F-t2-014).

**Open questions (blocking only)**: SD-02 acceptance (G2) before S3; WS02-D2 tombstone ids kept for the 14-day window (default stands); whether Postgres LISTEN works behind any pooler in a deployed stack (compose connects direct, `deploy/docker-compose.yml:723`, deployed topology UNVERIFIED).

#### WS03 Space governance admin, phase 1 (effect-policy admin and typed denials)

- **Resolves**: F-t1-006 Space governance admin (Priority, Partial, XL; phase 1 alone is L; W1). Phases 2 (posting rules, agent and model allowlist, locked switches, autonomy posture) and 3 (Spaces registry, rollout flags) are epic E01, not sliced here. **Owner plane and service**: Control (user-core) for rows, role check, audit, denial vocabulary; Frontend (gateway admin routes and mapping, SPA console and presenter). **Lane and milestone**: L4 (S1, S2, S3), L7 (S4, S5), L9 (S6, S7); M1; S1 is PR-2 of the first three PRs (04 4.8). **Depends on**: `M0-BASE` only for S1 and S2; S3 needs S1 and `P-UC1`; S4/S5 need `P-GW1`; S6/S7 need `P-SPA1`; S7 also needs the committed ZDR frontend set (`http.ts`, `sse.ts`, `chat-client.ts`, `errors.ts`, `SpaceRoomComposer.tsx` [M], on `model-plane`). No ADR gates phase 1 (ADR 2 governs transport: typed denials travel in-band on the refused request, never on a push frame). Ordering rule (04 D4/R3): WS03-S1 merges before any entitlement-column migration (WS09-S7, WS10-S2, WS12-S5, WS17-S4, WS19-S2, WS20-S1). Write enablement waits on the attestation answer SD-18 and decision D2 (write switch off in production meanwhile).

**Verified starting point**
- One row per org, deny when absent: PK `org_id`, nine privacy fields, eight entitlement booleans (migrations 018 `thread_create`, 019 `retrieval_read`, 020 `import_write`, 021 `schedule_fire`, 024 `agent_action`, 026 `thread_read`, 027 `sandbox_capability`, 028 `process_registry`), `policy_revision`, `entitlement_revision`; `var ErrNoOrgEffectPolicy` is `apps/Control Plane/user-core/internal/spaces/repository.go:19` (verified) [C].
- The only writer is `PUT /api/v1/internal/spaces/effect-policy` (`internal/http/server.go:354`, principal `control-space-policy`, scope `spaces:policy:write`); handler `upsertSpaceEffectPolicy` is `internal/http/spaces.go:1359` (audit cited :85-115, which are two guards); `UpsertEffectPolicy` (`repository.go:1229`, verified) rewrites all 18 columns with no actor, no audit row, no event [C].
- The operator script is stale and destructive (verified): `apps/Control Plane/scripts/set-space-effect-policy.sh` exposes six entitlement flags (:34-36, :57-62), never sends `sandbox_capability_entitled` or `process_registry_entitled`, so a re-run resets them to false; its default `USER_CORE_URL` `http://localhost:3021` (:44) is published by no compose file, and user-core itself listens on 3012 (`internal/config/config.go:94`, `HTTP_PORT` default) with `apps/Control Plane/docker-compose.yml:450` only `expose`-ing it (no host mapping), so no `localhost:<port>` works from the host [C].
- Denials are fixed English strings without a code: the shared evidence resolvers INNER JOIN registration, membership, audience snapshot, policy row and org membership, so "no policy row", "not a member" and "not in audience" all collapse to `ErrNoCurrentMembership` -> 403; the gateway turns thread-read and retrieval declines into `Ok(None)` and invents `space_read_not_authorized`; the SPA turns every non-ZDR 403 on the chat stream into "log in again" (`src/shared/api/chat-client.ts:1795-1800` [M]).
- Control cannot take a role from the gateway: the user-core v1 delegation carries user id, org id, email and name only (`internal/http/service_delegation.go:19-38`); the canonical-role call that exists is `resolveMembershipFromAuthCore` (`internal/http/handlers.go:68`, verified); local `user_org_memberships.role` is only a projection. The audit's "role in the signed delegation" holds for org-core's v3 delegation, not here.
- A reusable audit outbox exists and is unused for Spaces: `user_audit_outbox` (migration `014_gdpr_audit_outbox.up.sql`, subject CHECK `verevon.audit.v2.control.user-core.%`, `nats.conf:31` already allows that prefix).

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- Migration `033_space_effect_policy_events.up.sql` (above). No proto, no Convex table, no Model Plane change.
- Control routes (principal `verevon-gateway`, signed v1 delegation, canonical role owner or admin from auth-core, typed envelope `{error:{code,message,details}}`): `GET /api/v1/internal/spaces/org-policy` (scope `spaces:policy:admin:read`); `PUT /api/v1/internal/spaces/org-policy/entitlements` body `{idempotency_key (8..128), expected_entitlement_revision, preset_id | entitlements{all eight keys}}`; `GET .../org-policy/events?limit=&cursor=` (limit max 100, newest first). `GET` shape: `state` (`not_provisioned` shows `attestation:null`, all `enabled:false`, `capabilities.write:false`), `capabilities`, `revisions{policy,entitlement}`, `attestation{...}`, `entitlements[{key,enabled,effective,zdr,decisions}]`, `presets[]`, `matches_preset`, `active_spaces`, `last_change`. `PUT` 200: `{data:{changed,replayed,spaces_fenced,policy}}`. No org, actor or role field is accepted in any body.
- Error codes: `space_policy_invalid_request` 400, `space_org_admin_required` 403, `space_org_membership_required` 403, `space_policy_admin_writes_disabled` 403, `space_policy_not_provisioned` 409, `space_policy_revision_conflict` 409 (`details.current_entitlement_revision`), `space_policy_idempotency_conflict` 409, `space_policy_zdr_conflict` 422 (`details.keys`, `details.reason` in `zdr_inert`, `zdr_unproven`), `space_policy_unknown_preset` 422, `space_policy_membership_authority_unavailable` 503 (auth-core down fails closed, no fallback to the local projection), `space_policy_unavailable` 503.
- `ApplyOrgEntitlements` is one transaction: lock row, replay check, revision check, validate, `UPDATE` the eight columns plus `entitlement_revision + 1` (privacy columns and `policy_revision` untouched), fence active Spaces (`authority_revision` and `entitlement_revision`), insert event, insert `user_audit_outbox` row with subject `verevon.audit.v2.control.user-core.space_effect_policy_updated` (booleans and key names only; `event_id = 'space-effect-policy:<event_id>'`). A denied write also enqueues `space_effect_policy_write_denied` (outcome denied, no body). Phase 1 never writes the attestation and never creates a row.
- ZDR binding per key (test ties the column to the real `Issue*` function): `import_write`, `agent_action`, `schedule_fire` refused under Space ZDR (`zdr_inert`); `sandbox_capability`, `process_registry` blocked by phase-1 rule (`zdr_unproven`) until WS06 proves sandbox-manager handling (D3). Presets (cumulative, entitlements only): `locked`, `conversation` (+`thread_create`,`thread_read`), `conversation_knowledge` (+`retrieval_read`), `agent_work` (+`import_write`,`agent_action`,`schedule_fire`), `agent_computer` (+`sandbox_capability`,`process_registry`).
- Typed denial vocabulary (HTTP 403 unless stated; `resolvable_by`): `space_membership_required` (none; non-member, unknown Space and non-active org member are indistinguishable by construction), `space_not_active` (`space_manager`, `state`), `space_kind_unsupported` (none, `kind`), `space_policy_not_provisioned` (`org_admin`), `space_entitlement_off` (`org_admin`, `entitlement`), `space_role_below_floor` (`space_manager`, `required_roles`), `space_zdr_forbids_effect` (none, `effect`), `space_audience_not_current` (`retry`), `space_authority_incomplete` (`operator`), `space_authority_unavailable` 503 (`retry`). Scope: the ten gateway-called issuers (`personal-thread`, `thread`, `thread-append`, `thread-read`, `personal-retrieval`, `retrieval`, `personal-import`, `schedule-create`, `watch-create`, `owner-grant`) and `resolveCurrentSpaceMembership`; service-to-service routes keep plain bodies. Gateway body: `{error:{code:<operation code>,message,details:{reason,resolvable_by,...allowlisted}}}`; allowlisted detail keys `entitlement`, `required_roles`, `state`, `kind`, `effect`; operation codes `space_thread_not_authorized`, `space_post_not_authorized` (supplied to WS01), `space_retrieval_not_authorized`, `space_import_not_authorized`, `space_schedule_not_authorized`, `space_owner_grant_not_authorized`, `space_read_not_authorized`.
- Gateway admin routes: `GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}/space-policy`, `PUT /api/v1/orgs/{id}/space-policy/entitlements`, `GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}/space-policy/events`; order: flag (404 `space_policy_admin_disabled`), `require_org_admin`, shape check (exactly one of `preset_id` or `entitlements`, at most 32 keys `^[a-z_]{1,48}$`, `idempotency_key` required and never auto-generated), `proxy_json` with the actor.

**Definition of done and evidence** (`06` M1-S5)
1. Rebuild: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core` (scope change needs a recreate); `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway frontend`; SPA on a second Vite server. `psql` shows `schema_migrations` row 033 and `\d space_effect_policy_events` (UPDATE and DELETE rejected).
2. Flow with the dev org, an admin and a room member: baseline `GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}/space-policy` shows `not_provisioned` and the member sees typed `space_policy_not_provisioned` copy, not "log in again"; seed the attestation with the corrected script run inside the Control network (`docker compose run --rm ...` or `docker exec` into a Control container with curl; the default `http://user-core:3012` then resolves); admin applies `conversation`: 200, `spaces_fenced`, one event row, `user_audit_outbox.published_at` set, event at audit-core (container log or store row; read gating is WS05); member can now read; admin turns `thread_read` off and the member sees `space_entitlement_off` copy with no admin link (decision issued earlier expires within 2 minutes); replay with the same key returns `replayed:true`; a stale revision returns 409; member on the admin route gets 403 with no Control call; a forged delegation straight at user-core gets 403; an org with Space ZDR: `agent_work` disabled in the UI and 422 from the API.
3. Capture: HAR of the flow, screenshots of console and both denial copies, SQL of events and outbox, Playwright report, kill-switch drill for the three flags; ledger row for user-core 033 appended by L0.

**Risks and mitigations**: wire additions break a strict service decoder -> S2 touches only the ten gateway-called routes, greps each caller's decode before merging, statuses and strings byte-stable (test); role drift between session and auth-core -> Control re-resolves the canonical role every call and fails closed; replay of a v1 delegation within 30 s -> unique idempotency key, request digest, revision check; hot-file conflicts (`repository.go`, `service_auth.go`, `spaces.go`, `docker-compose.yml:426`) -> S1 first, one catalogue row per later entitlement, scopes through `P-CFG`; immutable events keep the acting admin's user id after erasure -> treat as security audit evidence or pseudonymise via the erasure fan-out (question 6); an admin switches everything off -> arm-in-place confirmation, revision history, reversible `locked` preset, honest fence copy; the Docker network name for the operator script is UNVERIFIED.

**Cross-session touchpoints**: policy registry of record (C5, X22): phase 1 extends the user-core row, no new registry; Space owns the tighten-only ceiling, (b) owns who-may-use in org-core and tool behaviour in capability-core; `space_effect_policies` schema (X34): Space owns, (b)'s user-core 031/032 are dropped, WS03-S1's catalogue is how WS09/WS10/WS12/WS17/WS19/WS20 add bits; model/agent allowlist (b F-t3-023): Control owns `allowed_models`, WS03 builds no allowlist UI; ZDR (X10, WS06): `zdr_unproven` bits relax only when WS06 shows sandbox-manager handling, no new free-text refusals; typed denial consumers WS01, WS07, WS09 take `details.reason` from the golden; Control principals/scopes (X29): `spaces:policy:admin:*` via the `P-CFG` train; audit (X21): events carry the Space event kinds, WS05 owns read gating and the admin audit view.

**Open questions (blocking only)**: SD-18 / question 1: who attests for self-serve orgs (phase 1 assumes operator-only), gates turning the write switch on; question 8 / D2: ship writes behind the Control switch or read-only until C5 (plan default: writes behind the switch, off in production); question 2: owner or admin may write (design follows the gateway's owner-or-admin rule).

#### WS04 Room administration, membership writer and directory

- **Resolves**: F-t1-022 Room administration basics (Priority, Partial, L, W1); F-t1-048 Room visibility, directory, self-join (Recommended, Absent, L, W2); F-t1-049 People and agent directory (Recommended, Partial, M, W2). **Owner plane and service**: Control (user-core `internal/spaces`) owns role, source, roster mode, visibility, join role, history mode, archive state, directory policy and the membership ledger; Application (convex-core) owns room name/topic labels, derives and registers the recipient audience, and reads org-core for the organization room; Frontend (gateway BFF + SPA) composes and proxies. No messages, reactions or documents move. **Lane and milestone**: L6 (S1, S2, S5, S12), L4 (S3, S4, S7, S8, S10, S11), L7 (S6, S9), SPA legs in L8/L9; **M1 = S1-S7, M2.2 = S8-S12** (04 D1). Slices that span planes (S2, S3, S6, and the others the design calls multi-plane) ship as one PR per lane with `-a`/`-b` suffixes merged contract-first (04 4.3.2 rule 2). **Depends on**: `P-UC1` (all L4 slices), `P-CX1` (S5, S12; S1 and S2 are excepted and edit `schema.ts` directly), `P-GW1`, `P-SPA1`; SD-13 (membership writer, option B: Control source-tagged writes) gates production enablement of S4 and S6, S8 and WS12-S3, S1/S2/S3/S5/S9/S10 and a dark S4 proceed without it; SD-14 (registration-shape bundle amending ADR-0001: archive as Control read-class state, DM kinds, visibility default, co-owners, topic under ZDR) gates S7, S8, S11; PD-WS04 defaults (WS04-S5 owns audience maintenance, 512-person audience cap, 10-minute reconcile, email in directory as `list_members` shows today).

**Verified starting point**
- The writer is one principal, `application-space-lifecycle`, scope `spaces:membership:write`, route `PUT /api/v1/internal/spaces/:space_ref/memberships` (`apps/Control Plane/user-core/internal/http/server.go:352`); `ReplaceMemberships` (`internal/spaces/repository.go:646`, verified) is declarative, carries no acting subject and has no sole-owner or rank rule. There are three Convex callers, not one (`apps/Application Plane/convex-core/convex/spaceMembershipSync.ts:109`, `spaceMembers.ts:235`, `spaceAgents.ts:732`). All [C].
- New audit gap (design V12): no code calls `spaces:replaceRecipientAudience` (defined `convex/spaces.ts:735`, verified) and the registration worker's `CONTROL_SPACE_AUDIENCE_URL` and `APPLICATION_SPACE_AUDIENCE_TOKEN` are set in no compose file or `startup.sh`; every shared-Space decision needs the caller in Control's current audience snapshot, so at the code level no member added today can read or post (not seen on a running stack: UNVERIFIED). Also an ordering defect: Application canonicalises recipient ids with `localeCompare` (`convex/spaceAudience.ts:40`, verified) while Control re-hashes with bytewise `sort.Strings` (`personal_thread_decision.go:44-71`, `repository.go:812-822`), so mixed-case or `_`/`-` ids mismatch; single-recipient audiences hide it.
- `syncAllOrganizationRooms` (`convex/spaceMembershipSync.ts:135`, verified) has no caller and `apps/Application Plane/convex-core/convex/crons.ts` is MISSING (verified); the only trigger is room activation.
- Archive cannot be a UI flag: eight read and decision resolvers plus the policy fence hard-code `registration_state='active'` (`repository.go:531,588,844,910,982,1029,1125,1187,1309`); an Application lifecycle value would break `space_lifecycle_by_ref` (gateway). `Register`'s replay branch (`repository.go:110-130`) raises a conflict that maps to HTTP 500 and the Application worker retries forever, so an `archived` state needs an archived-aware rule.
- Gateway has only `POST /members` and `DELETE /members/{id}` (`apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/apps/gateway/src/domains/spaces.rs:649-736,3407-3535,3669-3714`); the SPA picker lists every org member with no search (`src/features/spaces/components/SpaceMemberControls.tsx:34-210`); org-core `searchMembers` stops fetching profiles after `maxActiveFetch = 50` (`apps/Control Plane/org-core/internal/http/handlers.go:988`, verified), so a 60-person match set is silently truncated.
- Schema: `registered_spaces` has no visibility or `roster_mode`, `space_memberships` no `source` (only free-text `granted_by`), `registration_state` allows `active, suspended, deleting, deleted`; Application marks the org room with `spaces.isOrganizationRoom` (`convex/schema.ts:567`, verified), Control cannot. `spaceMemberGrants` (`schema.ts:821`) can hold only `editor` and nothing outside `spaceMembers.ts` reads it.
- GDPR erasure does not touch `space_memberships` (`internal/users/gdpr_erasure_store.go:240-262`; `resource_grants` delete at :242); a new ledger of user ids must be pseudonymised by the same saga. `PublishSpaceMembershipChanged` (`internal/nats/shared_publisher.go:207`) is a logged-only JetStream publish after commit; Session Core consumes with a plain subscribe (`session-core/src/space_membership_nats.rs`).
- File state: every WS04 source file is [C] except `SpaceRoomComposer.tsx` [M] (read-only prop), `src/shared/i18n/errors.ts` [M], `src/app/App.tsx` [M] (S8 route), `CoreSidebar.tsx` [M], session-core `grpc.rs` and `main.rs` [M] (S11 only). user-core top migration is 029.

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- No proto, no gRPC method, no new Control decision type, no NATS subject: every wire change is additive HTTP JSON or an additive field on an existing event or decision. Migrations (user-core, `*.up.sql`, idempotent, text contract test under `internal/database/`): 034 (S4), 035 (S7), 036 (S8), 037 (S11) as in the file list; `registered_spaces` gains `roster_mode`, `visibility`, `join_role`, `history_mode`, `archived_at`, `archived_by`; ledger table `space_membership_events` actions `member_added, member_joined, role_changed, member_removed, member_left, archived, unarchived, visibility_changed, settings_changed`. Go additions: `SpaceIndexEntry.State`, `CurrentMembership.{RecipientReady, RosterMode, State, ArchivedAt, Visibility, JoinRole, HistoryMode}`, `AuthorityChange ChangeAvailability` (advances `authority_revision` only), `MembershipReplacement.RosterMode`.
- Role matrix (`internal/spaces/roles.go`, golden `testdata/room-role-matrix.v1.json` mirrored in `src/shared/api/contracts/space-room-role-matrix.v1.json`): add needs rank >= manager and an elevated role (manager, owner) only by an owner; change role same plus never a self-promotion, self-demotion always allowed; remove/leave: leave always allowed, removing needs rank >= manager and an elevated target only by an owner; sole owner cannot demote, remove or leave (`activeOwners` counts active `user` owners who are active org members); join role viewer or editor only; archive and settings need >= manager (history mode: owner only). Inputs are read inside the transaction under `registeredSpaceForUpdate`, never taken from the gateway.
- Control routes (`/api/v1/internal/`, typed envelope on every new route; ACT = principal `verevon-gateway` + verified delegation + scope `spaces:membership:act`; org and actor only from the delegation; unknown JSON fields 400; other-org Space is 404 byte-equal to unknown):

| Route (slice) | Request -> success | Errors |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /spaces/:ref/members` (S4) | `{subject_id, role="editor", idempotency_key?}` -> `{data:{space_ref,subject_id,role,changed,replayed,membership_revision,authority_revision,member_count}}` | 400 `invalid_request`; 404 `room_not_found`; 403 `room_role_forbidden`, `room_elevated_role_requires_owner`; 409 `room_archived`, `room_roster_derived`, `room_personal_space`, `idempotency_key_reused`; 422 `member_not_in_organization`; 503 `space_authority_unavailable` |
| `PATCH /spaces/:ref/members/:subject_id` (S4) | `{role, expected_revision?, idempotency_key?}` | adds 404 `member_not_found`; 409 `room_sole_owner`, `room_member_changed` (`details.current_revision`) |
| `DELETE /spaces/:ref/members/:subject_id` (S4) | leave when subject is the actor; org room refuses | as above |
| `GET /spaces/:ref/audience-candidates` (S4) | principal `application-space-lifecycle` scope `spaces:membership:read` -> `{data:{space_ref,org_id,state,membership_revision,recipient_audience_revision,members:[{subject_id,role}]}}` | 404, 409 `room_personal_space` |
| `GET /spaces/:ref/membership` (S4, S7, S8, S11) | existing body plus `recipient_ready, roster_mode` (S4), `state, archived_at` (S7; `?readable=1` resolves active or archived, sent only by the six read handlers), `visibility, join_role` (S8), `history_mode` (S11) | unchanged 403 |
| `POST /spaces/:ref/archive`, `/unarchive` (S7) | `{idempotency_key?}` -> `{data:{state,changed,archived_at}}`; org room refused | 409 `room_not_archivable`, `room_state_conflict` |
| `PATCH /spaces/:ref/settings` (S8, S11) | `{visibility?, join_role?, history_mode?}`; `org_public` needs the org policy; a visibility change advances `privacy_revision` and `authority_revision` | 403 `directory_disabled`; 409 `room_roster_derived`, `room_archived` |
| `POST /spaces/:ref/join` (S8) | -> `{data:{role,changed,already_member,recipient_ready:false}}`; private, disabled-org and non-open rooms are 404 | 404 `room_not_found`; 409 `room_archived` |
| `GET /directory/rooms` (S8), `GET /directory/people` (S3) | rooms: up to 500, excludes own, personal, org, archived and private rooms; people: `?q=&limit=<=50&cursor=&exclude_member_of=` (ignored for non-members) -> `{data:{people:[{subject_id,display_name,email,is_self}],next_cursor}}` | policy off returns `enabled:false,rooms:[]` (200); 400 on q > 100 chars or bad cursor |
| `PUT /spaces/directory-policy` (S8) | `{org_id, org_public_rooms_enabled}`, scope `spaces:policy:write`, one operator event row | 400 |

- Declarative `PUT .../memberships` keeps its contract plus source scoping: a declared member whose row is `member_ops` or `self_join` is skipped (counted in `skipped_control_owned`), the stale pass deactivates only `source='application_sync'` rows (registrar row protected), new rows get `application_sync`, and `roster_mode:"org_derived"` is set once and never cleared. Archive: write resolvers (thread create/append, schedule, import, run-action, sandbox, process) stay `active` only; four existing read resolvers, the new `ResolveReadableUserMembership` and the policy fence widen to `active|archived`; a lifecycle event mapping to `active` while Control holds `archived` keeps `archived`; `deleting` and `deleted` always win.
- Events: reuse subject `aqencia.controlplane.space.membership_changed` (no NATS or provisioner change); payload `{space_ref, org_id, subject_id, active, event_id, space_seq, action, role, actor_kind}` (no actor id, names or topic), published after commit whenever a user row becomes active or inactive, never for a role-only change; S10 makes it durable. Session Core's decoder ignores unknown fields.
- Gateway (flags in `SpaceFeatureFlags`; limiters 60/min directory reads, 20 join, 30 member ops): `PATCH /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}` (400 `room_details_invalid` with `details.field`, 403 `room_role_forbidden`, 409 `space_kind_not_editable`, 503 `room_details_unavailable`); `GET /api/v1/directory/people` (S9 adds `kinds=person,agent`), `POST /api/v1/directory/resolve` `{query, kind, space_ref?}` -> `{status: ok|ambiguous|none, match?, candidates?<=5, reason?}` with `meta.presence_only:true`; `POST|PATCH|DELETE .../members[/{member_id|me}]` (flag on: Control then the Convex reconcile action; write is authoritative and never rolled back, `meta.warnings:["room_audience_unconfirmed"]` on failure of the reconcile), `POST .../archive|unarchive`, `PATCH .../settings`, `POST .../join`, `GET /api/v1/directory/rooms` (route name chosen to avoid colliding with `{space_ref}`); a refused feature answers 404 `feature_disabled`; 429 `rate_limited`.
- Convex: `crons.ts` (`space org-room roster reconcile` and `space audience reconcile`, 10 min each); `spaces:updateRoomDetailsForGateway`; `reconcileRoomAudience` action (typed statuses, maps "not an active Application organization member" to `projection_lag`, one retry on revision conflict); `spaceMembers:reconcileRoomAudienceForGateway`.
- Action registry (registry first, then dispatcher; none in `MODEL_EXECUTABLE_ACTION_IDS`, test asserts): `spaces.change_member_role`, `spaces.leave_room`, `spaces.update_room_details`, `spaces.update_room_settings`, `spaces.archive_room`, `spaces.unarchive_room`, `spaces.join_room`; `spaces.add_member` gains optional `role`. Control scope additions (`verevon-gateway`: `spaces:membership:act`, `directory:read:self`; `application-space-lifecycle`: `spaces:membership:read`) ride the `P-CFG` train; an unmapped POST would fall through to `users:write:self`, so each ACT handler also asserts the scope itself.
- History window (S11): Control adds optional `history_floor_revision` (omitempty) to the signed read decision when `history_mode='since_join'` and `SPACE_HISTORY_WINDOW_CLAIM` is on; floor derived from audience snapshots (first revision after the latest one that did not contain the subject); Session Core adds `history_floor: Option<i64>` beside the ceiling and filters `(floor IS NULL OR m.recipient_audience_revision IS NULL OR m.recipient_audience_revision >= floor)` where the ceiling applies; an old Session Core ignores the claim (fail-open on a presentation rule only, never on authority).
- ZDR: no WS04 route calls a model or stores conversation content, so a ZDR org is not refused anywhere; events and ledger carry ids, roles and counts only; the topic is a label, never in a prompt, event or notification (D-WS04-6).

**Flags and rollout**

| Flag | Owner and default | Kill switch |
|---|---|---|
| `space_org_room_reconcile_sync` (`SPACE_ORG_ROOM_RECONCILE`) | Convex env; off in production, on in dev | 0 + `docker restart convex-gateway` (wait for "Convex functions ready!") |
| `space_audience_reconcile_sync` (`SPACE_AUDIENCE_RECONCILE`) | Convex env; first two production flags with S1 | 0; last registered audience stays in force |
| `space_room_details_ui`, `space_people_search_api`, `space_membership_writer_api`, `space_room_archive_api`, `space_room_directory_api`, `space_directory_resolver_api` | gateway `SpaceFeatureFlags`; off in production | flip + restart; writer flag off resumes the legacy Convex path (emergency stop only: it cannot remove a member added through Control); directory also needs the org row `org_public_rooms_enabled` (absence denies) |
| dark by credential | `USER_CORE_SERVICE_CREDENTIALS` omits `spaces:membership:act` and `:read` in production | remove the scope and recreate user-core: every ACT route 403 |
| `space_membership_events_sweeper` (`SPACE_MEMBERSHIP_EVENTS_SWEEPER`) | user-core env; off in production | 0 + restart; inline publish stays |
| `space_history_window_read` (`SPACE_HISTORY_WINDOW_CLAIM` + session-core `SESSION_CORE_SPACE_HISTORY_FLOOR`) | off; rooms default `full` | either env 0: full history |

Order: S1, S5 (reconcile on in dev then staging; in production S1 only removes people who left the org and adds new ones, S5 is the prerequisite for any shared use), S2, S3, S4 (dark), S6, S7, then in M2.2 S8, S9, S10, and S11 last and opt-in. `WS04-S12` runs after one release with S6 on (M4). Flags are never authorization inputs.

**Tests**
