**Definition of done and evidence** (`06` M1-S6; S8-S12 evidence at the M2.2 gate)
1. Rebuild: update `USER_CORE_SERVICE_CREDENTIALS` for the new scopes first; `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core` and check migrations 034-037 in `schema_migrations`; Convex: `docker restart convex-gateway`, wait for "Convex functions ready!", confirm env with `npx convex env get SPACE_AUDIENCE_RECONCILE`; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway`, `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3185/health`; SPA on a second Vite server. Seed users A (owner), B, C in org X and D in org Y with `apps/Control Plane/scripts/seed-verified-test-user.sh` (or `M0-T0`), an effect policy row for X (WS03-S1 script), and for S8 `set-space-directory-policy.sh --org-id X --enable`.
2. Flows, each run with the flag on, then once off (kill-switch proof): F1 reconcile (add C to org X, Control roster shows C within 10 s, removal drops C); F2 details (A renames, B editor refused 403 `room_role_forbidden`); F3 search (org with more than 50 members: org-core search misses the 51st, the new search finds it); F4 writer and audience (A adds B as viewer: read ok, composer disabled, shared `thread-decision` for B is 403 until `recipient_ready`; A promotes B to editor; B cannot add C; A makes B manager then owner; A demotes self; B sole owner leaving is 409; `space_recipient_audiences` revision advanced; ledger rows present); F5 archive (banner, read-only composer, `thread-decision` 409 `room_archived`, transcript readable, unarchive restores, lifecycle replay does not unarchive); F6 directory and join (C browses, joins, "access is being prepared" then ready; private rooms never listed; D in org Y gets nothing and a 404 byte-equal to unknown; `resource_grants` count unchanged); F7 resolver (unique, ambiguous prefix, miss); F8 durability (stop NATS one minute, remove a member, restart: ledger `published_at` set and `space_membership_revocations` row present); F9 history (`since_join`: C's transcript lacks earlier rows).
3. Capture: recordings, HTTP transcripts of each typed error, `psql` selects (ledger, memberships, audience revisions, `registration_state`), Convex logs of `reconcileRoomAudience` statuses, byte-equality of the 404 bodies, cross-language vector sync script output, a dated line in the Members section of the audit ledger doc.

**Risks and mitigations**: dual writers during cutover -> source scoping makes Control-native rows immune to the declarative PUT, S4 ships dark before S6, `skipped_control_owned` is returned and logged; audience never registers or mismatches -> S5 wires env, trigger and codepoint order with a cross-language vector, cron heals; added member cannot read yet -> `recipient_ready`, 2 s poll up to 30 s, honest "access is being prepared"; archive widens four existing read resolvers plus the new `ResolveReadableUserMembership` and the policy fence -> strict default, source-scan pin test, reviewer checklist; directory enumeration -> 404 for private and other-org rooms byte-equal to unknown, per-user rate limits, same-org SQL, caps; audience cap 512 vs `maxSpaceMembers` 5000 -> `planAudienceReconcile` refuses above 512 with a typed reason (default org limit 100); `user_org_memberships` vs org-core drift -> divergence shows as a person missing from search, never extra access; Convex cron load -> one org-core call and one Control PUT per org room per 10 min, debounce, revisit with per-org batching; ledger personal data -> ids only, pseudonymised by the erasure saga; Session Core claim compatibility (S11) -> optional claim, re-verify no `deny_unknown_fields`; `spaces.rs` merge pressure -> child modules and one-line registrations; orphaned room (all owners deprovisioned) -> not solved (F-t1-006 phase 2), operator runbook via the declarative PUT.

**Cross-session touchpoints**: Session Core read filter (S11) (X01, X03): Model plane with WS01, WS09, WS13, one `audience_window(read) -> (ceiling, floor)` helper, search hits re-authorised through it; `membership_changed` payload (S4, S10): Control owns the shape, Session Core owns the consumer, additive only; agent-callable directory resolver (X19): WS18 owns the tool, WS04 supplies semantics and a pure function (the execution path must not call the BFF); archived rooms and browser or sandbox grants (X15, X18): archive denies every write decision, so WS20 and WS06 inherit denial with no Quarry change; agent binding PUT (`spaceAgents.ts:732`, `managed_subject_types:["service"]`) keeps working under source scoping; Control credentials and scopes (X29): `P-CFG` train; ZDR (X10): no model call, no typed refusal needed; Space-side users: WS01 (needs S5), WS02 (ledger as roster-change source), WS03 (policy writer for `space_directory_policies`, `ERROR_COPY`), WS05 (SCIM suspension reaches rooms through S1), WS08/WS12 (`DirectoryPicker`, Control writer), WS11 (notifications from the ledger), WS14 (archived rooms read-only for files), WS17 (agent owner link uses `source`).

**Open questions (blocking only)**: SD-13 (writer option B) gates production enablement of S4/S6/S8; SD-14 (archive as Control read-class state, visibility default, co-owners, DM kinds, topic under ZDR) gates S7, S8, S11; whether the production credential registry (`USER_CORE_SERVICE_CREDENTIALS`) lives outside the dev compose (only dev compose is in the repo, so production scope additions are UNVERIFIED); whether WS04 extends the GDPR saga to `space_memberships` and audience rows now (existing gap) or WS05 does; whether Convex codegen accepts imported table definitions (`P-CX1` spike, UNVERIFIED) for S5/S12.

### 3.B: Wave 1 and 2 hardening: security fixes and identity, Model Plane safety, frontend quick wins and artifacts, UI baseline and sidebar

- Delivers: the security holes closed first (audit read gate, SCIM 501, SSO escalation, Model Plane refusal typing, sandbox caps, link and HTML hardening), then enterprise identity, room artifacts and client resilience, then the locale/format baseline and a synced sidebar.
- Order: M1 = WS05-S1..S3, WS06-S1..S5 and S7, WS07-S1..S13 (incl. S9a); M2.3 = WS05-S4..S9, WS06-S6, S8, S9, S10, WS16-S1..S11. WS05 is its own lane (L5) and can start in week 1; WS06-S5/S7 and WS07-S1/S5/S7/S13 and WS16-S1/S2 have no prerequisite beyond `M0-BASE`.
- Parked inside this group (not in any exit criterion): WS06-S6b, WS06-S11, WS06-S12. `WS06-S0` (land the Z-series) is dropped: the Z-series is already committed on `model-plane` (`5ae7fe13`..`b67bb7f0`, 02 C16), replaced by `M0-BASE`.

The signed v3 delegation already carries the live org role (gateway `middleware.rs:228-284`, role replaced at :248 [C]); audit-core copies it to `serviceAuthorization.UserRole` (`service_auth.go:273` [C]) and no handler reads it (the audit pointer `:203-213` is `requiredAuditScope`).

A naive admin-only gate breaks the Trust Center; `tool_action` rows are content-free (`session-core/src/audit_publisher.rs:298-332` [C]).
- audit-core store migrations are embedded in `internal/store/migrate.go` (registry :36-43, top file `006_v2_producer_authority.sql`); the root `migrations/001_init.sql` is not loaded; no audit-core CI workflow exists.

Three tests assert today's 201/200 (`server_test.go:2583,2611,2758` [C]: `TestSCIMProvisioningStoresInboundEvent`, `TestSCIMTokenCRUDAndInboundAuth`, `TestSCIMProvisioningUsesOrgScopedBearerToken`, asserts at `:2596`, `:2624`, `:2649`, `:2672`, `:2689`, `:2771`); the other SCIM tests in that block assert 401, 500 or 400 and stay unchanged (review H1). `internal/auth/middleware.go` [M] also carries uncommitted hunks (R11).
- Membership authority is auth-core (Better Auth `member` table, no status column), not org-core (`OrgMember.status='suspended'` has no writer); `RevokeAllSessions` is self-service only. So "deactivate = suspend in org-core" cannot work (D-WS05-2).

- `GET /v1/audit` (audit-core): owner/admin see the org; other roles only `user_id = claims.UserID` (foreign `user_id`: 403 `{"error":{"code":"audit_scope_denied","message":"...","details":{"scope":"self"}}}`); `event=tool_action` with no `user_id` returns the redacted projection `{id, occurred_at, ingested_at, plane, event, outcome, details:{tool,data_category,zdr,phase}}`; unknown role is self scope; `meta.scope` is `org|self|org_redacted`. `GET /v1/usage`, `/v1/usage/summary`: members 403 `audit_scope_denied`. S4 adds `cursor` (base64url `{t,id}`, keyset on `(ingested_at,id)`), `plane`, `outcome`, `subject`, `resource_id`, `meta.next_cursor`, `limit` 1..500, 400 `invalid_cursor`. There is no export route: audit export is mp-WS06's compliance API (X21).
- Gateway: `GET /api/v1/audit`; domains `GET|POST /api/v1/orgs/{id}/domains`, `POST .../domains/{domain}/verify` (6/h/domain), `DELETE .../domains/{domain}` with errors `identity_admin_required`, `invalid_domain`, `domain_verified_elsewhere` (never names the other org), `domain_limit_reached` (10), `domain_in_use`, `txt_not_found|txt_mismatch|dns_unavailable|challenge_expired`; DNS challenge `_verevon-challenge.<domain>` TXT `verevon-site-verification=<token>` (24 random bytes, 7-day expiry, `net.Resolver{PreferGo:true}`, 4 s, no HTTP fetch); SSO `GET|PUT /api/v1/orgs/{id}/sso/policy`, `POST|DELETE .../sso/providers` (errors `policy_revision_conflict`, `no_verified_domain`, `no_provider`, `sso_not_proven`, `break_glass_invalid`, `break_glass_requires_2fa`, `domain_not_verified`, `provider_exists`, `invalid_issuer`, `last_provider_enforced`); sign-in error `sso_required` with `details:{domain}`; SCIM tokens `POST|GET|DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{id}/scim/tokens`, `GET .../scim/status`.
- SCIM edge: `/api/v1/scim/v2/*` (no session, bearer forwarded opaquely, 64 KiB cap) to org-core `/internal/scim/v2/*` under principal `verevon-scim-edge`, scope `org:scim:any`; `/ServiceProviderConfig`, `/ResourceTypes`, `/Schemas`, `/Users` only (`userName eq`, `externalId eq`, count <= 100); `/Groups` 501; role always `member`; deprovision through auth-core `POST /api/v1/internal/scim/memberships/{provision,deprovision}` with operation id = UUID of `(org_id, scim_id, target_active, revision)`; rate limit 300/min/token.
- Events (ids and kinds only, shape `verevon.audit.v2.<plane>.<producer>.<event>`): `org.domain.added|verified|revoked`, `org.scim.token.created|revoked`, `org.scim.user.provisioned|deprovisioned|reactivated`, `org.scim.deprovision.refused_last_owner`, `sso.enforcement.would_block`, `sso.break_glass_signin`, `space_decision_denied`, `space_decision_issued` (event ids `space-decision:<decision_ref>`, `space-denial:<sha256(route|org|subject|space|minute)>`; issued only for import, schedule-create, schedule-fire, watch-create, owner-grant, sandbox-capability, run-action, scheduled-run, scheduled-step).
- Action-registry entries (all human-only, kept out of `MODEL_EXECUTABLE_ACTION_IDS`): `org.add_domain`, `org.verify_domain`, `org.revoke_domain`, `org.update_sso_policy`, `org.create_scim_token`, `org.revoke_scim_token`; appended after `org.update_zdr`.

**Flags and rollout**

| Flag | Owner / default | Order | Kill switch | ZDR behaviour |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AUDIT_READ_ROLE_ENFORCEMENT` | audit-core, code default `enforce` | `enforce` from the first deploy in every environment (a W1 bug fix, not a feature); unknown readers are covered by the redacted `tool_action` projection, not by a permissive mode; remove the flag after two releases | none in production; in dev only: `report` (log would-deny, max 3 days, boot warning) or `off` (boot warning, refused when `APP_ENV=production`); test `production_refuses_non_enforce_mode` | metadata only; ZDR orgs keep audit |
| `SPACE_AUDIT_DECISION_EVENTS`, `SPACE_AUDIT_DECISION_KINDS` | user-core, false | denials first, then effect-bound kinds | false | `details` never holds token, digest, nonce or content |
| `ORG_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_ENABLED`, `ORG_IDENTITY_ADMIN_API` | org-core false; gateway `env_bool(key, dev_flags_allowed(APP_ENV))` | internal org, then pilot; gateway after org-core | false (routes 404; verified rows stay) | identity metadata, none |
| `SSO_ENFORCEMENT` | auth-core ceiling `off|report|enforce`, default `report` | `report` everywhere; per-org `enforce` only after a clean report week | `off` platform-wide | none |
| `ORG_SCIM_ENABLED`, `SCIM_EDGE_ENABLED` | org-core and gateway, false | org-core and auth-core first, gateway edge last; pilot org with a real IdP only; edge answers the S2 501 body while either is off | either false | identity keys only, no profile attributes |

S1, S2, S3 ship without new flags (S1 keeps its switch). Control images are rebuilt through `scripts/run-control-plane.sh` (bare compose build does nothing, `apps/Control Plane/scripts/run-control-plane.sh`).

**Definition of done and evidence** (repo rule: rebuilt images, running stack, verified end-to-end flow; no "deployed" claim without all three). Rebuild: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build audit-core org-core auth-core user-core`; `cd "apps/Ingestion Plane" && docker compose up -d --build integration-api`; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build`.
- S1 (scenario M1-S5): member and admin of the same org; HAR of `GET /api/v1/audit?limit=25` (member `meta.scope=self`, admin `org`), `?user_id=<other>` as member 403 `audit_scope_denied`, Trust Center loading for the member, Settings panel in both roles; direct call to audit-core with forged `X-User-Role: admin` and an unsigned delegation: 403 `signed service delegation required`. Gate: `enforce` proven in production (HAR of a member `GET /api/v1/audit` returning `meta.scope=self`) before sibling (b) replays audit rows (O13, R4).
- S2 (M1-S8): `curl -i -X POST <integration-api>/api/v1/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"x@y.z"}'` returns 501 with the SCIM error body; `SELECT count(*) FROM integration_webhook_events WHERE provider_key='scim'` unchanged and payloads `{}`; no `scim_event_received` on NATS.
- S3: an OIDC test IdP user with `jobTitle=Director` signs in; SQL on `member` shows role `member`.
- S4: cursor pages cover exactly the rows of the unpaged list, filters narrow, and no export route exists (404). S5: a viewer's denied thread decision and an issued effect-bound decision both reach `audit_events` within 10 s with no token or digest in `details`. S6: publish the TXT on a controlled test zone, verify; a second org claiming the domain gets 409. S7: `report` shows `sso.enforcement.would_block` for a password sign-in; `enforce` returns `sso_required`, SSO works, break-glass owner signs in with password plus 2FA and emits `sso.break_glass_signin`.
- S8 and S9 (M2-S2): a real IdP test tenant (Entra or Okta, UNVERIFIED until run) provisions, PATCHes `active:false`, replays; capture the IdP log, `organization_scim_users` row, `member` row gone, sessions gone, user-core `user_org_memberships.status='removed'`, Convex projection removed, a Space decision refused, with timings; `scripts/verify-deprovision.sh` 30 s propagation table.

**Risks and mitigations**
- Trust Center regression from the role gate: redacted org-wide `tool_action` view, explicit test; the gate enforces from the first deploy in every environment (ruling K1-03), so a non-admin keeps own rows plus the redacted projection and no legitimate member read breaks; the gateway self-scope check (independent of the audit-core flag) ships with it.
- SSO lockout: report mode, proof-of-SSO precondition, two break-glass owners with 2FA, `SSO_ENFORCEMENT=off`, fail closed only for non-SSO paths.
- Domain hijack: DNS proof only, unique verified-owner index, public-suffix and free-mail blocks, re-check at SSO sign-in.
- SCIM idempotency and IdP dialects: operation ids, state-compare idempotency, narrow filters, real-IdP pilot before any claim.
- Plain-NATS membership lag leaves Space and run effects alive briefly: WS04-S10 makes events durable; decisions already issued live up to 2 minutes; the probe states the bound honestly.
- `sso_provider.oidc_config` stores client secrets as text (`auth-schema.ts:107`; encryption by the plugin UNVERIFIED): encrypt with the existing `encryptToken` helper in the internal controller. Whether `auth.api.registerSSOProvider` accepts a service context is UNVERIFIED (fallback: direct insert).
- Uncommitted integration-corev2 hunks (`server.go`, `config.go`, `internal/auth/middleware.go`) conflict with S2: merge after the owner commits or rebase.
- No server-side export in Space: audit export is (b)'s compliance API (mp-WS06, DEC-35); a second export route on audit-core would be a second authorisation surface. SIEM token and hash chain are sibling (b) F-t3-004. A person-readable download, if wanted, is a client-side CSV of already-authorised list pages, no new route.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- Audit/SIEM pipeline, event shape (C15, X21): WS05 owns reads, indexes, view and Space event kinds; sibling (b) mp-WS06 owns hash chain, compliance API, `siem-exporter`; one shape `verevon.audit.v2.<plane>.<producer>.<event>`, content-free rows. audit-core migrations: (b) 007-010, Space 011.
- Agent-invocation `tool_action` events (sibling b `audit_publisher.rs`): shape stays `{tool,data_category,zdr,phase}`; a new field needs a WS05 projection update.
- Sibling (a) `AuthzDecision` and SIEM export (F-t2-036, F-t2-073) emit into the same shape; no second export surface.
- Agent owner link and suspension cascade (ADR 4 / SD-04): WS17-S4 and F-t1-043 own it; WS05 publishes `org.scim.user.deprovisioned` and the member-removed event they consume.
- auth-core cross-plane token fixtures (`cross-plane-token-requests.json` [M], pinned with Quarry): sibling (a); WS05 changes no token request.
- WS05-S1 deploy gates (b)'s mp-WS01.S2 audit replay (O13).

#### WS06 Model Plane safety hardening (ZDR, sandbox caps)

- **Resolves**: F-t1-005 ZDR binding in every plane (Recommended, Partial, S, W1, High); F-t1-021 Agent computer confinement (Priority, Partial, M, W2, Medium). **Owner**: Model Plane (session-core, execution-core, model-gateway, sandbox-manager, mp-contracts) plus Control (user-core, S5 only) plus Frontend gateway (S4 table). **Lane and milestone**: L2 SCR (S1, S2, S4, S12), L3 RUN (S3, S6-S11), L4 CTL (S5); M1: S1-S5 and S7; M2.3: S6, S8, S9, S10; parked: S6b (M2.3 conditional), S11 (M3), S12 (M3). **Depends on**: `M0-BASE` for S1-S5 and S7 (the Z-series commits `5ae7fe13`..`b67bb7f0` on `model-plane` replace the design's S0); S6 on S5 (contract-first); S8 on S7; S9 on S5 (contract-first); S10 on S7, S8, S9; ADR 6 (SD-06) gates only S11; SD-12 (ZDR behaviour for Space) gates the S2 `enforce` flip and S6b, can start without it (S2 ships `observe`).

**Verified starting point**
- Session Core refuses ZDR with untyped free text at 11 sites, not two: `apps/Model Plane/rust/services/session-core/src/auth.rs:276-281,327-331,360-364,377-381,395-399,580-584,787-789` [M], `src/grpc.rs:6385-6388` [M] (audit cited 6378-6395), `src/memory_grpc.rs:107-117` [M], `src/terminalization.rs:379-384,1586-1589` [M]. The typed pattern exists (`mp-contracts/src/zdr_refusal.rs` [U]; execution-core `tests/zdr_refusal_inventory.rs` [U]) and model-gateway `grpc_status_to_http` turns any status with the kind trailer into the typed JSON body, so no model-gateway change is needed. Re-run the inventory scan at the base cut: sibling (b) may have typed some sites.
- The Space decision ZDR flag is decoded (`ControlSpaceDecisionClaims`, `grpc.rs:631-662` [M]) then dropped in the thread-create verifier (`:1749-1755`); the append and read verifiers never read it. It is reachable: `space_effect_policies.zero_data_retention` via `PUT .../spaces/effect-policy` (`UC/internal/http/server.go:354`, handler `spaces.go:1359`), carried by every thread:create/append decision (`personal_thread_decision.go:378,453,475`). The matrix pins `space_zdr = "not_applied_in_v1"` (`MP/api/contracts/zdr-posture-matrix.json:9,67,196-205`).
- Scope limit (review K1-13): `IssueSpaceCapabilityDecision` calls `validatePersonalAuthority` (`space_capability_decision.go:138`), so a shared room cannot get a sandbox decision today. Sandbox caps and the shell lease apply to personal Spaces only until the shared sandbox decision exists (SD-28, epic E02/E03); shared-room sandbox use stays refused (typed) until then.
- sandbox-manager has no ZDR handling: `authz.Authorize` passes any user principal (`go/services/sandbox-manager/internal/authz/authz.go:81-83` [C]), decision struct omits `zero_data_retention` (`capability_verifier.go:58-80`), gRPC server built with a single `grpc.UnaryInterceptor` (`cmd/main.go:169`); the only refusal is upstream in execution-core.
- Control's capability decision closes `processes` to a vocabulary (`UC/internal/spaces/space_capability_decision.go:39`, validated :78) but not `egress`: any value other than `disabled_by_default` earns `space:egress` (:158) with no entitlement check; `space:processes` granted at :169. Latent (execution-core always sends `disabled_by_default`); `space_capability_decision_test.go:61-81` pins the open behaviour with `allow_domains`.
- Three spawn sites, all `MpNetworkPolicy::Disabled`: `shell` (`execution-core/src/runtime_loop/mod.rs:876`, `execute_shell` :859), `code_interpreter.rs:581`, `process_host.rs:420`. No rlimit, cgroup, pids, memory or CPU key exists; the 64 KiB output cap is applied after `command.output()` has collected the whole stream (`executor.rs:292`, `spawn_capture` :270); the workspace forbids `unsafe_code`, so per-spawn limits go through `prlimit`.
- Lease rule is weaker than the audit says: a lease is demanded only for `code_interpreter` with a Space id and for `process_start`; `shell` takes none and inherits execution-core's full environment (new finding; code reading, approval-gated except in `auto` mode).
- Metrics: `gateway_requests_total` and `gateway_request_duration_seconds` label `path` with the raw URI (`MG/gateway_metrics.rs:50,58` [M]), so thread and run ids enter Prometheus. The README's `zdr-contract-sync` script exists and CI runs it; the audit's "missing" is wrong.

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- No new public route. Typed ZDR refusal body from model-gateway: `{error:{code:"zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden"|"zdr_feature_not_supported", ...}}` with HTTP 412 (existing catalogue; `zdr-refusals.json` gains no new code or feature key, so goldens, pins and SPA copy are unchanged). sandbox-manager answers FailedPrecondition plus trailer.
- Migrations: Session Core and user-core none; sandbox-manager `0008_lease_retention_class` (S6b only, conditional; 04-sequencing 4.6.B; 02-decisions notes sibling (b) mp-WS22-S1 plans the same column as 0005, so the slice may be absorbed there). Proto: `sandboxes.proto` `AcquireLeaseResponse.durable_workspace_permitted` (S6b; the design said field 7 on `AcquireLeaseRequest`, 04-sequencing 4.6.C reserves `AcquireLeaseRequest` 7 and (b) takes `zdr = 8`: reconcile at the ledger entry), additive.
- Control: `space-capability-profile-v2` only in S11 (parked). Metrics (labels closed, no ids): `mp_session_space_zdr_flag_total{action,enforced}`, `execution_core_sandbox_limit_hits_total{kind=cpu|file_size|output|killed|busy}`, `space_shell_unleased_total`.
- Action-registry entries: none.

**Flags and rollout**

| Flag | Owner / default | Order | Kill switch | ZDR behaviour |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SESSION_CORE_SPACE_ZDR` | session-core, `observe` (`observe|enforce`, exact match) | observe everywhere for the existing owner `create_thread` and `append_message` paths only; `enforce` per stack after the counter shows real exposure and SD-12 (G3). `observe` never applies to a route this plan adds: every new route (member append and human post, thread reply, mention records, reactions, canvas, files, attachments, search, personal-agent admission, browser run) reads `zero_data_retention` from the verified decision claims and refuses with the catalogue code from its first merge, regardless of `SESSION_CORE_SPACE_ZDR`; test `member_append_refuses_when_decision_zdr_true_in_observe_mode` | back to `observe` | counter carries no ids; `enforce` makes a ZDR-flagged Space refuse new posts and agent turns, reads/delete/archive keep working |
| `SANDBOX_MANAGER_REQUIRE_RETENTION_CLAIM` | sandbox-manager, `off` | `on` after a test replays Auth Core's real mint for audience `sandbox-manager` and both callers carry `zdr:false` | `off` | refuses an absent claim |
| `SANDBOX_MANAGER_SPACE_ZDR` | sandbox-manager, `off|scratch_only` | only after SD-12 and S6b | `off` | scratch-only never persists |
| `EXECUTION_SANDBOX_LIMITS` (+ `_MAX_CONCURRENT`, `_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES`, `_MAX_ADDRESS_SPACE_MB` 4096, `_MAX_FILE_MB` 64, `_MAX_OPEN_FILES` 1024, `_CPU_FACTOR` 2, `_QUEUE_WAIT_MS`) | execution-core, `enforce` | dev, compose, production, watching the limit counter; the `MAX_*` and compose limits ship with S7 (M1), the `LIMITS` switch and `prlimit` with S8 (M2.3) | `off` warns at every start | ZDR callers never spawn |
| `EXECUTION_CORE_SPACE_SHELL_LEASE` | execution-core, `observe` | one release in observe, then `enforce` (Space `shell` needs `sandbox_capability_entitled` and editor role) | `observe` | n/a |
| `SPACE_SANDBOX_EGRESS` | reserved | not built | n/a | refused for ZDR |

Switches follow the Model Plane pattern: one exact-match parser per switch in `mp-contracts` (like `process_host_enabled_from`), compose `${VAR:-default}`, no `true`/`1` truthiness. Typed trailers are additive so deploy order is free; enforce flips go last (session-core, execution-core, model-gateway, sandbox-manager). Rebuild with `cd "apps/Model Plane" && ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core execution-core model-gateway sandbox-manager`; two cargo targets fail pre-existing on Windows (use `--lib`), Go `-race` needs cgo.

**Definition of done and evidence** (rebuilt images, running stack, verified flow; scenarios M1-S4 and M1-S8; per-spawn caps verified in M2.3).
- Flow A (ZDR, F-t1-005): seed a ZDR test org. As a Space member: (1) start an agent turn: typed 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden` or `zdr_feature_not_supported` with the catalogue text in the SPA and no Session Core row (`messages` count before and after); (2) call model-gateway with a ZDR token on each S4 route: every non-GET refused typed; (3) grpcurl `AcquireLease` with a delegated ZDR token: FailedPrecondition with trailer `x-mp-provider-error: zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`; (4) in a non-ZDR org set the policy flag via `PUT /effect-policy` and start a Space thread: `observe` succeeds with `mp_session_space_zdr_flag_total{enforced="false"}` = 1, `enforce` refuses typed with `enforced="true"`. Capture responses, counter scrapes, DB counts, `REQUIRE_CONTRACT=1 bash scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh`.
- Flow B (confinement, F-t1-021) on the production-profile stack (production overlay, seccomp, `cap_drop ALL`): `code_interpreter` memory bomb gives `limit_hit` with the container alive; CPU spin killed with `cpu`; 200 MB file write `file_size`; 100 MB stdout `output` with flat execution-core RSS; fork bomb leaves `/healthz` 200; `shell` in a Space without entitlement refused "requires a sandbox lease" once enforce is on and `env` shows only `PATH`; a request claiming `egress: allow_domains` refused by Control. Capture tool results, limit counter, `docker stats`, script output.
- Done also means: S10 calibration numbers recorded in the PR description, WS03 told that S5 and S6 merged (it flips its `zdr_unproven` bits), ADR 6 recorded in `apps/Model Plane/docs/decisions/ledger.md` (no entry today).

**Risks and mitigations**
- `RLIMIT_AS` false positives break numpy/matplotlib jobs: calibrate in S10 against the real image; env-tunable; `off` kill switch; watch the counter (4096 MB is a guess).
- Container `pids_limit`/`mem_limit` collide with tokio threads and the 512m `/tmp` tmpfs (counts against memory): per-service limits; S10 includes fork bomb and tmpfs fill.
- A fork bomb still exhausts container pids until the timeout: accepted and measured (per-spawn cgroups need delegation the container lacks).
- `prlimit` missing or different under bwrap: Dockerfile assertion; `limits_enforceable()` fails closed (UNVERIFIED in the built image).
- Go trailer not read by tonic: S6 cross-language test; fallback: execution-core maps the flat status.
- Enforcing the shell lease removes `shell` from unentitled Spaces: one `observe` release plus release note.
- `SESSION_CORE_SPACE_ZDR=enforce` makes ZDR-flagged Spaces read-only: off by default, product decision, counter first.
- `space_id` on `ExecuteStepRequest` is caller-asserted (residual trust point, recorded; hardening is reading the run's Space from Session Core).
- Hot files: session-core `grpc.rs`/`auth.rs`, model-gateway `http_routes.rs` (never `sse.rs`), execution-core `runtime_loop/{mod,agent}.rs` are shared with sibling (b)'s loop work: S1/S2 land first, S9 edits registration-level lines only after rebasing on (b)'s latest train.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- ZDR refusal catalogue, posture source, matrix (C16/X10): sibling (b) owns catalogue and matrix (built on `model-plane`); WS06 consumes, adds a row per new Space store/route; posture only from the verified token claim.
- ZDR-safe telemetry (X11): WS06 owns the Model Plane metric-label guard; sibling (a) owns Quarry and log fields; Space adds its own lint for gateway and Convex.
- Sandbox egress tiers and enforcement point (C8/X18): one closed tier enum in the Control decision, unknown means `Disabled`, refused for ZDR; enforcement point open (WS06-D3), S11 parked.
- `execution` object on `CodeResult`: (b) F-t3-043 part a owns the UI badge, WS06 supplies `{sandboxed, limits, limit_hit}`.
- Per-thread sandbox computer/backend seam (b F-t3-009, mp-WS22): adopts `SpawnAdmission`, `ResourceLimits` and the lease rule after S9; its decision must not alias a Space workspace.
- Route classification: WS06 owns the S4 tables and the surface registry; WS01, WS04, WS09, WS10 register routes in the same PR.
- Policy bits: after S5 and S6 WS03 flips `sandbox_capability` compatible and `process_registry` inert under Space ZDR.

**Verified starting point**
- No `Errored`, `Loading`, `vite:preloadError`, `unhandledrejection` or watchdog code exists. `FV/src/index.tsx:9` [M] renders `App` directly; `FV/src/app/App.tsx` [M] has 31 `lazy()` calls (30 at :8-37 plus one scene route at :42). Solid is 2.0.0-rc.0 (exports `Errored`, `Loading`); `lazy`+`Errored` behaviour without an outer `Loading` is UNVERIFIED (S1 spike first).
- nginx (`FV/nginx.conf` [C]): hashed assets `expires 1y` + `immutable` (:102-105), CSP enforced at :71 and re-emitted per location (:113, :127), everything else falls to `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html` with no cache header, so `/version.json` would answer 200 with index.html; the browser reaches only `/api/` and `/health`. Build id half plumbed: `ARG SOURCE_REVISION`/`BUILD_DATE` exist in the `dev` and `production` stages (`FV/Dockerfile:5-6,72-73`) but not the `build` stage; `FV/vite.config.ts` has no `define`; CI builds without the args (`.github/workflows/verevonv3-ci.yml` [M]).
- The room timeline fetches one transcript per post and swallows the 403: `SpaceRoomTimeline.tsx:201` `.catch(() => null)` [C]; BFF `list_space_threads` already knows when Control declined the decision (`GW/domains/spaces.rs` :1155-1163, response :1235-1243) but does not say so. Each transcript call mints its own Control decision (N posts cost N decisions).
- Links: `chat-media-markdown.tsx:1279` renders `<a href={link[2]}>` with no scheme check (bare-URL branch :1275 only matches `https?://`); `sandbox-html.ts:31-32` splices its CSP `<meta>` into the FIRST `<head>` match of untrusted HTML (a match inside a comment or script string leaves no CSP; code reading, not executed). The iframe is `sandbox="allow-scripts"` without `allow-same-origin` (`ChatArtifactPanel.tsx:516-519`).
- Artifact persistence exists with limits the audit missed: only kinds `document`, `code`, `html`, text, at most 200,000 characters reach `metadata.artifacts` (`MG/sse_events.rs:850-889`); a ZDR turn never reaches that path (`zdr_features.rs:162` marks `artifacts` inert), so there is no unguarded durable write. Whether a live Space turn takes this path is UNVERIFIED.
- `ListThreads` is NOT owner-bound in the live tree (the sweep is wrong): `ListThreadsRequest.space_read_decision_ref/token` (`sessions.proto:983-984` [M]) and `ListConversation` share `verify_thread_read_space_decision` (`session-core/src/grpc.rs:1970` [M]). The transcript read returns every metadata key flattened (`MG/http_routes.rs:7726-7753`, handler :8479-8540 [M]; BFF passes through `spaces.rs:2708-2727`): grounding, citations, compaction, receipts.
- Avatar colour is stored (`CX/schema.ts` agent definition, `spaceAgents.ts:441` writes any string, projected :89,:194), validated as 7-char hex only on the gateway create path (`spaces.rs:3324-3333`), then dropped by the gateway field map (`spaces.rs:4121-4134`); turns carry only `agent_name`; `latest_run_status` is never `awaiting_approval` today (WS09 finding), so a hover card cannot yet lead with "waiting on the owner" from live data. `SpaceTabId` has six values (`SpaceCockpit.tsx:43`); panels mount eagerly.
- Corrections to the audit and sweep: no Model Plane persistence work and no ZDR guard gap; DOCX/XLSX/PDF/image artifacts have no persisted source so no room preview can be built for them; a free-text `client-diagnostics` endpoint is not allowed by the ZDR telemetry rule; the sidebar agent-avatar target does not exist.

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- `GET /api/v1/client-config` -> `200 {"data":{"contract":1,"min_contract":1,"policy":"banner","revision":"<SOURCE_REVISION>","build_date":"..."}}`, `Cache-Control: no-store`. `POST /api/v1/client-diagnostics` `{"kind":"render_error|chunk_error|watchdog","build":"<=12 hex"}` (body cap 512 B) -> 204, else 400 `invalid_diagnostic`. `POST /api/v1/client-diagnostics/csp-report` (`application/csp-report`, `application/reports+json`, `application/json`, cap 8 KiB) -> 204, 400 `invalid_report`, 413. All three are public (a crashed or logged-out app must reach them) and IP rate-limited by the existing middleware; they store nothing: counters `verevon_client_failures_total{kind, build_match}`, `verevon_csp_reports_total{directive, disposition}` (closed directive set, never the blocked URL; with `CSP_REPORT_LOG_HOSTS=1` and `dev_flags_allowed(APP_ENV)` only the blocked origin is logged).
- `list_space_threads` response gains `data.shared_read = {"available": bool}` (additive).
- `GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/artifacts?limit=50&cursor=...` -> `200 {"data":{"artifacts":[{thread_id, message_id, artifact_id, kind, title, version, version_count, size_chars, agent_name?, created_at}],"next_cursor":..|null,"shared_read":{"available":true},"retention":{"zdr":false|true|null}}}`; content is not in the response (viewer reads the thread through the existing transcript route). Errors, all `{"error":{"code","message","details"}}`: 400 `invalid_space`, `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit`; 403 `active_membership_required`, `space_read_not_authorized`; 404 `space_not_found`, `space_room_artifacts_disabled`; 502 `invalid_model_gateway_response`; 503 `space_lifecycle_unavailable`, `delegated_auth_unavailable`, `space_artifacts_unavailable`.
- Proto (`space_room.proto`): `rpc ListSpaceArtifacts(ListSpaceArtifactsRequest) returns (ListSpaceArtifactsResponse)` on `SpaceRoomReadService`; request `{org_id=1, space_id=2, limit=3, cursor=4, space_read_decision_ref=5, space_read_decision_token=6}`; `SpaceArtifactSummary {thread_id=1, message_id=2, artifact_id=3, kind=4, title=5, version=6, version_count=7, size_chars=8, agent_name=9, created_at=10, space_id=11}`; response `{artifacts=1, next_cursor=2}`. Query: summaries only (`char_length`, never content), `DISTINCT ON (thread_id, artifact_id)` latest version, audience ceiling `recipient_audience_revision <= $3` on thread and message rows, keyset `(created_at, message_id)`, `limit` 0 means 50, clamp 1..200, malformed cursor `invalid_argument`. Because it is a separate service, the three `SessionCore` mocks (`execution-core/src/runtime_loop/agent.rs:5969`, `model-gateway/src/grpc.rs:3517`, `model-gateway/tests/e2e_invoke_chain_test.rs:1169`) and the real service (`session-core/src/grpc.rs:4468`, `impl SessionCore for SessionService`) stay untouched.
- Migration: Session Core `0085_messages_space_artifact_index` (final number from 04-sequencing 4.6.A; the design's 0046 was a placeholder). The design uses a plain `CREATE INDEX` in a quiet window; 06-verification 6.x asks index builds to be online-safe, so use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` with `-- no-transaction` as the first line if the table is large at merge time. sqlx 0.8.6 (`Cargo.lock:4116-4117`) honours a first-line `-- no-transaction`, but no committed migration uses it yet (0077 is WS13-S1's own planned migration, not yet written), so whichever of S9 and WS13-S1 lands first is the first user: include a migration test that the file applies on a scratch DB (K2-10). No Control, Convex or Data migration; no NATS subject.
- Action-registry: none new (the instruction snippet reuses `spaces.update_space_instructions`).
- Control: none (the existing `model.thread.read` decision is reused unchanged; no new decision type or audience).

**Definition of done and evidence** (rebuilt images, running stack, verified flow; scenario M1-S7). Rebuild: `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build frontend gateway`; production image `docker build --target production --build-arg SOURCE_REVISION=<sha> --build-arg BUILD_DATE=<iso> ...`; `cd "apps/Model Plane" && ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway`; Convex edits reach the backend by bind mount, then `docker restart convex-gateway` and wait for "Convex functions ready!".
- Flow A (resilience, S1-S3): image A and image B at different revisions. `curl -sI http://localhost:8080/version.json` shows `no-store` and JSON; `/index.html` `no-cache`; an asset `immutable`; security headers and CSP on each location. Swap the container to B: banner appears on visibility change with no reload; a lazy route with a missing old chunk gives exactly one automatic reload, then the page on B; with all chunks blocked, the `stale_deploy` card after the guarded reload; a throw in one Space tab shows the card only there. `CLIENT_VERSION_POLICY=enforce` plus raised `CLIENT_MIN_CONTRACT`: banner, no auto-reload (no probe). Capture curl transcripts, HAR, three screenshots, `/metrics` `verevon_client_failures_total`, `nginx -t`.
- Flow B (restricted and links, S4-S6): org without `thread_read_entitled`: one restricted notice, zero `/transcript` requests in the HAR, own posts still show previews. Post `[x](javascript:alert(1))`, `[https://bank.no](https://evil.example)`, and an HTML artifact with `<!-- <head> -->` plus an image beacon: link as text, spoof shows host, beacon request absent. Trigger an `img-src https:` load: `verevon_csp_reports_total{directive="img-src",disposition="report"}` increments, no URL logged.
- Flow C (artifacts, S9-S13): user A asks the room agent for a brief as an artifact, then a revision in the same thread; SQL `SELECT id, jsonb_array_length(metadata->'artifacts') FROM messages WHERE space_id=<ref> AND jsonb_exists(metadata,'artifacts')` shows two rows. User B (other browser): chip under the turn, Artifacts tab one entry with `version_count 2`, stepper walks v1 and v2, HTML needs Run preview; `EXPLAIN` uses the index. Negative: user C outside the room gets 403/404; a decision for another space is refused by Session Core. The transcript for B has no `grounding`, `citations`, `confidence` (HAR), and with `SPACE_ROOM_METADATA_LEGACY_PASSTHROUGH=1` they return (then reset). ZDR seed org (`FV/apps/gateway/scripts/zdr-seed-test-org.mjs`): no `messages` row for a ZDR user's turn, tab shows the ZDR copy, no artifact content in browser storage.
- Flow D (identity, S7-S8): agent with colour `#2563eb` shows on card, timeline, picker; gateway response contains `avatar_color`; a Convex write of `red` stores nothing; two same-named agents render neutral; hover and focus open the card.

**Risks and mitigations**
- Solid 2 rc.0 `lazy` without `Loading` may not reject into `Errored`: spike first; fall back to a `lazyWithRecovery` wrapper.
- Reload loop: `sessionStorage` guard (60 s), policy `off`, watchdog uses the same key.
- nginx refactor drops a header on a location: node test over the config, CI curl, single snippet.
- Aggregate reads a JSONB column across a large room: partial index, keyset, summaries only, `EXPLAIN` test; measure on 10k messages before enabling in production.
- Allowlist hides a key someone uses: no Space consumer found; kill switch; WS09 and WS17 register keys in one constant.
- Hover-card attribution by `agentName` is heuristic: ambiguous names render neutral until WS08 adds agent ids. Kobalte alpha under Solid 2 may fail: in-house popover fallback.
- Untrusted HTML in rooms: click-to-run, wrapper fix, opaque origin, CSP meta first; residual self-navigation of a sandboxed frame accepted and stated.
- Shared files with uncommitted scene/demo work (`index.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `package.json`): keep those hunks out of every WS07 change set. `SpacePage.tsx`, `SpaceRoomTimeline.tsx`, `SpaceRoomComposer.tsx` [M], `spaces-client.ts` and `nginx.conf` are hot: tabs and panes plug in through `P-SPA1` registries, one registration line each.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- Viewer registry and sandbox primitive, no new origin (C21/X26): WS07 owns `src/shared/artifacts/viewer-registry.ts`; sibling (b) mp-WS19.S1 `artifact-renderers.ts` folds into it; sibling (a) F-t2-071 deletes `WebPageViewer` and does not reintroduce a permissive iframe.
- Client contract and build id (X35): WS07 owns `CLIENT_CONTRACT` and the parity test; (b) F-t3-067 generated-types gate may subsume it.
- Session Core aggregate read and metadata allowlist: WS07 owns the RPC; (b) owns artifact persistence (`create_artifact`); persisted shape stays `{id, kind, title, content, version}`, kinds document/code/html; new room-visible keys are added to `ROOM_VISIBLE_METADATA_KEYS` by their owner. `P-SC1` owns the service skeleton (SD-29).
- ZDR: WS06 owns the matrix; WS07 writes nothing; ZDR turns produce no artifacts; telemetry is kind and build only.
- Agent-work frames and `metadata.work`: WS09; the `artifact` frame carries id and kind; WS07 opens by (thread id, artifact id) with its own authority.
- Hover-card blocking state: WS10 derives `awaiting_approval`; WS07 reads `latest_run_status` unchanged.

**Open questions** (none blocks a slice; defaults ship)
1. Should room HTML artifacts need a "Run preview" click (default) or auto-preview as in Chat (WS07-D1)? One registry flag.
2. Is it acceptable that every member who can read a thread sees all its artifacts, including ones built from the starter's private retrieval (same audience as the turn text)?
3. Artifact-first rule: opt-in per-room snippet (default) or added to every new room's instructions (WS07-D3)?
4. May idle tabs reload themselves after a contract bump once composers register unsaved work (`enforce`), or must the person click Reload (WS07-D5)?
5. May production record CSP violation counts by directive, with host inventories only in staging (WS07-D6)? Are `http:` links acceptable (WS07-D7: https, http, mailto; the audit text said https and mailto only, one constant)?
6. Is Norwegian-first copy in the failure card, restricted notice and ZDR notice acceptable with English as the second string?

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- No migration number is consumed (user-core stays at 029 for WS16; WS03/WS04/WS09/WS10/WS12 hold 033+). No proto, no Control decision type, no NATS subject, no Channel Plane work.
- Control preference contract v2 (additive, storage stays `user_settings` categories `language` and `appearance`): `GET /api/v1/preferences` returns `{"preferences":{theme, language ("en-US" default kept), timezone (omitted unless a valid IANA zone, legacy `region` read only if valid, never `"US"`), dateFormat (`MM/DD/YYYY|DD/MM/YYYY|YYYY-MM-DD`), timeFormat (`12h|24h`), compactMode, crawlIngestMode, notifications, explicit:{language,timezone,dateFormat,timeFormat,compactMode}}}`; stored `auto` is not explicit. `PATCH` accepts the same plus `auto`, validates `timezone` with `time.LoadLocation` (400 `{"error":"timezone must be an IANA zone name"}`) and `language` against `^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Z]{2})?$` (max 10); writes key `timezone`, stops writing `region`. Errors stay legacy plain strings until WS03 moves user-core to the typed envelope.
- Locale precedence (SPA): first paint from `localStorage`; adopt-once (marker `verevon.locale.synced.v1`: local value wins and is PATCHed); then server wins when `explicit.language` maps (`nb*/nn*/no*` -> `no`, `en*` -> `en`, else untouched); user toggle writes through (debounced 500 ms, `verevon.locale.dirty=1` on failure, dirty local wins next boot).
- Sidebar document `SidebarDoc` v1 (<= 32 KiB; refs only: `starred` <= 100, `hidden` <= 500, `sections` <= 30 with <= 200 refs each, section name NFC 1-40 chars unique case-insensitively, `groups` closed ids `channels|dms|personal|archived`, `computed {needsYou, unread, working, muted}`; ref charset `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$`). Convex table `spaceSidebarPreferences` (`externalOrgId`, `externalAuthId`, `revision`, `doc`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`; index `by_subject`); functions `spaceSidebar:getForGateway`, `spaceSidebar:putForGateway {baseRevision, doc}` -> `{status:"ok", revision}` or `{status:"conflict", revision, doc}` (each starts `assertServiceKey` then `requireGatewayMember`), `spaceSidebar:sweepOrphans` (S11).
- `GET /api/v1/spaces/sidebar` -> `200 {"data":{"mode":"server","revision":3,"doc":{...}|null,"limits":{"sections":30,"refs_per_section":200,"starred":100,"hidden":500,"name":40}}}`; under org ZDR `{"mode":"zdr_local","revision":0,"doc":null,...}`; errors 404 `space_sidebar_disabled`, 403 `active_membership_required`, 503 `space_sidebar_unavailable`. `PUT /api/v1/spaces/sidebar {"base_revision":3,"doc":{...}}` -> `200 {"data":{"revision":4,"doc":{...}}}`; errors 400 `invalid_sidebar_doc` (`details.reason`), 409 `space_sidebar_conflict` (`details:{revision, doc}`), 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`, 413, 404, 403, 503. Org from `authorized_org_id`, user from the session, body keys outside `{base_revision, doc}` rejected; no Control call, no decision minted, no Model Plane call. A ZDR lookup failure is 503, never a silent flip to `zdr_local` (needs `org_zdr_lookup` from `P-GW1`).
- Gateway turn path: browser body `locale: 'no'|'en'`, gateway maps to `nb-NO|en-US`, model-gateway `InvokeRequest.locale: Option<String>`; request-scoped, never stored; `Treatment::Honored` in the ZDR matrix; absent on agent wake-ups.
- Action-registry: `settings.update_preferences` input extended (`dateFormat`, `timeFormat`, `compactMode`); new `spaces.update_sidebar` `{baseRevision: int >= 0, doc}` (`ownerPlane: 'application'`, `risk: 'low'`, `requiresApproval: false`, `reversible: true`, human-only, not in `model-eligibility.ts`).
- Group registry and slot precedence (one tested table): 1 Needs you (overlay, includes hidden rooms), 2 Starred, 3 custom sections (a room appears once), 4 built-in groups, 5 Muted (only when `computed.muted` is on), 6 Hidden (behind "Show hidden (n)", included in search). The room list always comes from `listSpaces()` (Control's index), so the document cannot add a room; unknown refs render nothing and are pruned on the next write.

**Definition of done and evidence** (rebuilt images, running stack, verified flow; scenario M2-S8 for the UI baseline and sidebar).
1. Preferences: a new user's `GET /api/v1/preferences` has no `timezone` and all `explicit` false; toggle the language in browser A, reload in browser B with cleared storage and see the same language from the server; Settings density compact, date `DD/MM/YYYY`, time `24h` change Space dates; a user whose server value says `en-US` and local says `no` keeps `no` once and the server then shows `nb-NO`.
2. Grammar: in English, Activity and Work show English verbs and outcomes; an unknown raw status stays verbatim; Norwegian output unchanged.
3. Announcer: a second member's post and a run needing approval each produce one announcement (screen reader or DOM log); an identical repeated post announces twice.
4. Contrast: Playwright `forcedColors: 'active'` and `contrast: 'more'` screenshots show the working, unread and presence dots and the critical row border.
5. Locale hint (when the Model image carries it): turns in English and Norwegian; model-gateway debug log (field names only) shows `locale`; a ZDR-org turn is accepted and persists nothing new.
6. Sidebar: two sections, two stars, one hidden room, a dragged room, sort by name; reload in a second context shows the same layout; two-tab edit shows the 409 rebase; with org ZDR `PUT` returns 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`, the note "Saved in this browser only" shows and `spaceSidebarPreferences` is unchanged; with `SPACE_SIDEBAR_API=0` the legacy panel returns.
7. Capture: HAR of preference and sidebar calls (incl. 409 and 412), the Convex row before and after, screenshots (sidebar, forced colors, density, announcer DOM), Playwright trace, and summaries of `go test`, `cargo test` (gateway, model-gateway), Convex `pnpm test`, `vitest`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`.

**Risks and mitigations**
- First release flips users whose old Settings language disagrees with the toggle they use: adopt-once rule plus precedence test.
- `CoreSidebarSpacesPanel.tsx` is edited by WS01, WS04, WS11, WS12: S9 lands the group registry first, the others add registry entries.
- user-core image lacks zoneinfo so valid zones are rejected: `time/tzdata` import; test with a real zone in the container.
- Convex `requireGatewayMember` throws for a removed member and the sidebar breaks the shell: gateway maps any Convex failure to 503; SPA keeps the cached doc read-only; shell render never depends on it.
- ZDR posture blip flips a user between server and local docs: unknown posture is 503 (needs `org_zdr_lookup`); edits during a blip live only in the local doc.
- Orphan rows (no cron, no erasure hook): inert for removed members through `requireGatewayMember`; S11 sweeps; refs only, no content.
- Announcer noise: queue cap 5, one per 1.2 s, burst summary, per-viewer `off` (`verevon.a11y.announce-posts`).
- Locale sentence changes the prompt prefix (golden tests may move) and Space must not edit `sse.rs`: ship the field and gateway stamp dark; one sentence per user.
- Two copies of the limits: hash-pinned golden in both planes (`FV/src/shared/actions/space-sidebar-limits.json` and the Convex fixture), parity-tested; path added to `contract-goldens.yml`.
- Uncommitted files this touches ([M]/[U]: `chat-client.ts`, `SpaceRoomComposer.tsx`, `http_routes.rs`, `zdr_features.rs`, `global.css`, `CoreSidebar.tsx`, `ChatSidebarOrganizer.tsx`): rebase on the base cut, take each file's owner's disposition first; new CSS goes into new files, never `global.css`.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- Locale field, hint sentence, `zdr_features.rs` row: WS16 owns the field and gateway stamp; sibling (b) accepts the prompt-assembly change (X36: (b) owns the composer, Space supplies layers; ADR-0003 order unchanged); WS06 owns the matrix.
- Sidebar run-state sections (O8/C17): WS16 owns the Spaces sidebar slice (S10); WS11 owns the single mapper `runStateToSignal` and `GET /api/v1/spaces/attention` (`rooms[].{unread_threads, mentions, needs_you, working, level, badge, last_activity_at}`); (b)'s chat sidebar stays in `ChatSidebarOrganizer`.
- Per-room mute: WS11 owns the notify level; WS16 only calls `spaces.set_notify_level` (mute is not agent pause; no second mute store).
- Shared announcer and i18n ratchet (X35): WS16 owns `announce()` and the ratchet test; (b) F-t3-066 owns CI wiring and the ChatPage migration (`ChatPage.tsx:533` hard-coded string reported, not touched).
- Control preference contract v2: WS16-S2 owns; WS03 later moves user-core to the typed envelope; additive fields only.
- Group registry: WS04 (`archived`, browse) and WS12 (`dms`) register entries and never edit the panel body.
- `WorkspaceSettingsPage.tsx` is not touched by WS16 (WS03/WS05 own it); `AccountSettingsPage.tsx` is.

**Open questions** (defaults ship; blocking only the named slice)
1. May the model-gateway locale sentence (D6, D-WS16-6) land from this plan with the single call-site in `sse.rs` made by sibling (b)'s prompt composer, since Space may not edit `sse.rs`? Blocks activating S6 only; the field, gateway stamp and `locale_hint.rs` ship dark.
2. Should an org under ZDR get a synced sidebar (ids and short labels) or stay browser-local as designed (D-WS16-3, SD-12)? Blocks the S8 ZDR branch.
3. Is silently adopting a user's existing local language into the server preference acceptable on first release (D-WS16-2)? Blocks S3's precedence step only.
4. Remove `fr-FR` and `de-DE` from Settings now (recommended, D-WS16-7)?
5. Is "hide never hides a room that needs you" the intended meaning (D-WS16-4)? Defaults for computed sections once WS11 ships: Needs you on, Unread, Agent work, Muted off, off, on.
6. Are cross-org badges and Ctrl+1..9 wanted in this wave or as epic WS16-E1 in W4 (preconditions recorded in design D8.9; not built here)?

### 3.C: Wave 2: addressed wake-up and mentions, agent work visible to the room, approvals, notifications and attention

- Delivers the agent half of a human room: a person can address one to three bound agents by identity (WS08), every member sees the agent's work live and can stop it (WS09), approvals say the truth and carry scoped, revocable consent plus a per-tool policy (WS10), and members learn what needs them across rooms (WS11).
- Ship order (04-sequencing): WS09-S1 run guard in M1; then M2.1 (train T4) WS08-S1/S5, WS09-S3/S7, WS10-S1/S2, then WS08-S2/S3/S4/S6, WS09-S4/S5/S2/S6/S8, WS10-S3/S4/S5a/S5b, WS08-S8; M2.2 (T5) WS11-S1..S11 after WS15-S5; M2.3 (T6) WS10-S6..S9 (member decide, origin rules, quarantine, kind registry).
- All four assume SD-01 (Session Core owns posts), SD-02 (ids and kinds on any push), SD-05 option 1 (only the thread owner's own post wakes an agent), SD-12 (ZDR orgs get typed refusals, no durable feature), SD-15 (sibling vocabularies ratified). Effort: WS08 13.5-19.5, WS09 11.0-14.7 (+2.0-3.0 conditional), WS10 17.5-27.0, WS11 15.8-22.7 engineer-weeks.

#### WS08 Addressed agent wake-up and identity-bound mentions

- **Resolves**: F-t1-002 addressed agent wake-up (Priority, L, Partial, W2, High); F-t1-007 identity-bound mentions for people and agents (Priority, M, Partial, W2, Medium). Delivered: human posts carry `mentions` (ids, not text); one to three bound agents are woken in order, each as a separate run started from the stored post; per-binding `respond_to`; Control-signed `turn_origin` on `runs`; durable mention records; one ranked picker; offer-to-add and request-to-add. Not delivered: ambient judge, standing orders, `@room`/groups, member-woken runs (S9-S11 outline, unsized). **Owner plane and service**: Model Plane (session-core records and run start, model-gateway wake mode) with Control user-core (signed `model.run.wake`), Application (convex-core binding policy), Frontend (BFF gateway, SPA); mention notifications are WS11's, not WS08's. **Lane and milestone**: S1 L4, S2/S3 L1, S4 L7, S5 L6, S6/S8 L8; all M2.1 (train T4). **Depends on**: WS01-S1/S4/S5/S6 (hard; S3 member append also gates behavior), WS09-S1 (guard ON before any fan-out), P-UC1, P-GW1, P-CX1, P-SPA1/P-SPA2; decisions SD-01, SD-05 option 1, SD-15 (origin vocabulary C4, ADR-0012), SD-26, SD-12. - **API, proto, data model and migrations**:
  - Migration `0075_space_mentions_and_wake_origin.sql` (+ `revert/`): `message_mentions(org_id, message_id REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, thread_id, space_id, subject_id, subject_kind IN ('user','agent'), source IN ('typed','locked'), wake_expectation IN ('expected','refused'), refusal_code IN ('respond_to_denied','mention_not_enabled','invocation_blocked','owner_only_thread'), ordinal SMALLINT, created_at, PK (message_id, subject_id), CHECK (agent iff wake_expectation set))`, index `message_mentions_subject_idx (org_id, space_id, subject_id, created_at DESC)`; `runs` gains `turn_origin` (`direct|ambient|automation`, NULL reads as `direct`), `trigger_message_id`, `agent_subject_id` with NOT VALID then VALIDATE constraints (`runs_turn_origin_chk`, `runs_wake_pair_chk`) and `runs_trigger_idx`. Cascade carries every erase path to mention rows; ids are not content.
  - Routes (BFF, typed envelopes): `POST /api/v1/spaces/{ref}/threads[/{tid}/messages]` (WS01) gains `mentions:{people:[{subject_id,label,source?}], agents:[{subject_id,source?}]}`; 201 adds `data.mentions:{recorded:[{subject_id,kind,wake:"expected"|"refused",reason?,ordinal?}], rejected:[{subject_id,code}]}`. 400 `invalid_mentions` (`details.reason`: `too_many_people`, `too_many_agents`, `duplicate`, `bad_subject_id`); soft per-ref `rejected` codes `person_not_in_room`, `agent_not_bound`, `mention_text_missing`; agent refusal reasons as the migration enum. The post never fails because of a mention.
  - Wake: `POST /api/v1/chat/stream` and `/api/v1/ag-ui/stream` accept `wake:{message_id, client_wake_id}` (`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$`), requiring `thread_id`, exactly one `mentioned_agent_ref`, `content`. Errors: 400 `wake_requires_thread`, `wake_requires_single_agent`; 403 `agent_respond_to_denied`, `agent_mention_not_enabled`, `agent_invocation_blocked`, `wake_not_authorized`; 404 `mentioned_agent_not_bound`; 409 `wake_trigger_mismatch`, `thread_run_active` (WS09-S1), `wake_owner_required`; SSE error `managed_run_already_started` is treated as accepted; 503 `space_decision_unavailable`; ZDR typed 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden` before any Control call. `client_wake_id` feeds `managed_start_keys.derive` (`managed_start_key.rs:35`).
  - Control: `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/run-wake-decision {space_ref, thread_id, trigger_message_id, content_digest, agent_subject_id, turn_origin, idempotency_key}` returns `{data:{decision, token}}`; issued to editor, manager, owner with `thread_create_entitled` and a current recipient audience; `turn_origin` must be `direct` (Control refuses `ambient` and `automation` until E01 exists); 403 `{error:"Space run wake is not authorized"}`; the BFF maps this internal string error to `wake_not_authorized` in the typed envelope, and no internal string error reaches the browser (test `wake_denial_is_typed_at_the_bff`). No migration, no new entitlement bit. Disjointness both ways with thread tokens.
  - gRPC: `AppendMessageRequest.mentions = 20`; `StartManagedRunRequest.wake = 10` (`RunWakeContext`: the twelve Space decision fields in the order of `AppendMessageRequest` 5-16, then `trigger_message_id`, `trigger_content_digest`, `agent_subject_id`, `turn_origin`); errors PermissionDenied, FailedPrecondition `wake_trigger_mismatch`, AlreadyExists (start key reused with another wake), Aborted `thread_run_active`. Session Core checks: signature, subject equals caller, owner gate, same Space, trigger row is the caller's own `post` with `sha256(content)` equal to the bound digest, agent present as an `expected` mention, run slot guard. Reply slot becomes `(last_role, assistants_since_last_user, expected_agent_mentions)` with a cap of 3.
  - PATCH `/api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/agents/{binding_ref}/policy {respond_to?, respond_to_subjects?, expected_updated_at}`; owner or manager through `require_space_agent_grant_role` (`spaces.rs:3669`); 400 `unsupported_policy_field`, `invalid_policy`; 403 `space_role_cannot_manage_agent`; 404 `agent_binding_not_found`; 409 `policy_conflict`; 503 `agent_binding_unavailable`.
  - Events: `MESSAGE_APPENDED` payload gains `mention_count` and `agent_mention_count` only (ids and counts on the wire).

Prove migration 0075 with `psql` (`\d message_mentions`, `\d runs`); `/healthz` proves nothing. Flow: manager A binds agents X and Y; B is editor. A posts plain: no `runs` row. B posts "@A ...": `message_mentions` row, no out-of-app signal from WS08 (the `space.mention` item is WS11-S6's). A posts "@X @Y compare": two `expected` rows, SPA runs X then Y, two `runs` rows with `turn_origin='direct'`, `trigger_message_id`, `agent_subject_id`, two assistant rows named X and Y, no duplicate user row; a fourth agent is `invalid_mentions`. A sets X to `managers`: B's mention of X records `refused/respond_to_denied`, no run, the UI says why. B replies in A's thread mentioning X: `refused/owner_only_thread`. Negative: viewer cannot wake; forged `turn_origin`, `wake_context`, wrong digest, another user's trigger give no run; client `metadata.mentions` stripped; replayed `client_wake_id` gives one run; ZDR org gets the typed 412 and its legacy turn still answers. - **API, proto, data model and migrations**:
  - No Session Core migration. User-core migration **038** `run_control_entitled` (S7). A reserved partial index on `runs(thread_id)` is taken from the spare range 0086-0090 only if a load test requires it.
  - Derived phase `RUN_PHASE_SQL`: `CASE WHEN r.status='queued' AND EXISTS (open or processing row in managed_run_terminalization_outbox with deadline_at > now()) THEN 'running' ELSE r.status END`; maps through (b)'s run-state enum (mp-WS16) and WS10 adds `awaiting_approval` to the same const. Guard: inside the start transaction `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('thread-run-slot'||chr(31)||thread_id,0))` then a root-run liveness check (`parent_run_id IS NULL`, `threads.space_id IS NOT NULL`, `configured_source IN ('gateway_direct','execution_agent')`); refusal is gRPC `Aborted` with `x-mp-error-code: thread_run_active` and `x-mp-active-run-id`, mapped to an SSE error `{code:'thread_run_active', retryable:true}` before any model call.
  - Routes: `GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/runs/{run_id}/live` (SSE, `Last-Event-ID`): session, org membership, Space lifecycle, Control `model.thread.read` (needs `thread_read_entitled`), org ZDR refuses before Control. Errors 400 `invalid_space`; 403 `active_membership_required`, `space_read_not_authorized`, `zdr_feature_not_supported` (feature `agent_run`); 404 `space_not_found`, `run_not_found`, `feature_unavailable`; 410 `run_stream_expired` (`details.fallback: thread_transcript`); 429 `too_many_live_views`; 503 `space_lifecycle_unavailable`, `run_live_unavailable`. Internal `POST /v1/spaces/{space_id}/runs/{run_id}/live` (decision in the body, never a URL). `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/runs/{run_id}/stop {idempotency_key}`: 403 `space_run_control_not_authorized`, `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`; 404 `run_not_found`; 200 `cancelled:false` when already terminal; 503 `run_control_unavailable`. `list_space_threads` adds `data.agent_work`.
  - Frames (SSE `event:` names, `id:` = source seq): `snapshot` (first), `text {offset, delta}`, `text_progress {chars}`, `step {id, class, state, ms?}`, `steer {count}`, `plan`, `artifact {id, kind}`, `finished {outcome, reason}`, `reauth_required`, `error`. `class` is the closed enum `search_knowledge, web, code, artifact, lookup, effect, memory, delegate, plan, check, tool` (`browser` reserved for WS20). Everything not named in `ROOM_EVENT_POLICY` is dropped; free-text fields are never forwarded.
  - RPCs: `RunService.AuthorizeRoomRunAttach {run_id, space_id, space_read_decision_ref, space_read_decision_token}` returns `{run_id, thread_id, org_id, owner_subject_id, run_phase, started_at_unix, valid_until_unix}`; NotFound for any run outside the audience (no oracle); ZDR credential, ZDR decision claim or `retention_class <> 'persistent'` gives `Refusal::feature_not_supported("agent_run")`; called at subscribe and every 15 s. `CancelRunAsRoomManager {run_id, space_id, space_control_decision_ref, space_control_decision_token, idempotency_key, reason}` returns `{cancelled, receipt_id, owner_org_id, owner_user_id}`; event `RUN_CANCELLED` with `cancelled_by`, `acting_as:"room_manager"`, `decision_ref`, key `run_cancelled:{run_id}`.
  - Control: `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/run-control-decision {space_ref, run_id, operation:"cancel", idempotency_key}`; action `model.run.control`, schema `sha256:run-control-v1`, permissions `["run:cancel"]`, audience `model-plane`; manager or owner with `run_control_entitled` and current audience; disjoint from read tokens both ways; 403 `{error:"Space run control is not authorized"}`.
  - Action registry: `spaces.stop_run`; steer reuses `chat.queue_invocation_input` (`action-registry.ts:2838-2858`); `chat.cancel_invocation` unchanged. Durable `metadata.work: {v:1, steps:[{id,class,state,ms}], steer:n}` (max 64 steps) under the message's own audience columns, erasure and retention; never written under ZDR.

- **Definition of done and evidence**: repo rule; 06 scenario M2-S1 (live half) and M2-S2 (revocation mid-run). Rebuild: `cd "apps/Model Plane" && ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway`; `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway frontend`, restart Vite and hard-reload. Seed `apps/Control Plane/scripts/set-space-effect-policy.sh --thread-create-entitled --thread-read-entitled --run-control-entitled`. Flow: users A (editor), B (viewer), C (manager), D (non-member), a ZDR-org user. (1) A starts a multi-tool turn; B sees the card move step to step with streaming text and resumes after a reload; A sees no duplicate card. (2) SQL: `runs.status` stays `queued` while the list API reports `running`. (3) A types mid-run: delivered at the round boundary, steer marker for B, 429 on the fourth message. (4) Remove B mid-run: stream closes within 15 s (capture timestamps and the `space_membership_revocations` row), within 130 s if the NATS event is dropped. (5) B replies while A's run is live: `thread_run_active`, no second run row; guard off reproduces the lost reply. (6) C stops A's run: `cancelled`, `RUN_CANCELLED` shows `cancelled_by` C and `acting_as`, A sees a neutral stop; B has no Stop and a direct call is 403. (7) D and the ZDR user get typed refusals; `mp_room_run_attach_total{outcome}` and an attach gauge exist with id-free labels. (8) Each flag off restores the legacy row with no data change. Capture screen recording, SSE transcripts with tokens redacted, `docker logs`, SQL outputs, test summaries; attach to the PR and store beside the plan's other evidence.
- **Risks and mitigations**:

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Projection leaks raw content | allowlist by event name, rebuilt payloads, sentinel tests tied to the taxonomy; member path never reads raw frames |
| Reconnect storms and Control load (2 min decision) | at most 3 attaches per browser, jittered reconnect, per-user and per-run caps, one decision per attach |
| Guard blocks a thread after a producer crash | liveness predicate limits it to 15 min; manager Stop; kill switch; a run waiting for approval releases after the same deadline (interplay with WS10, to confirm) |
| Parked runs from (b) (`park_reason`, `resumable`) are not `queued`/`running` | S1 first task: decide with (b) whether a parked run blocks the thread (UNVERIFIED) |
| Orphan user message when two sends race | UI pre-disables invoking sends on a live thread; copy says the message was posted; durable queue is an epic |
| Text deltas before the answer is durable or after a Stop | `space_run_live_text` off in production first |
| Redis buffer TTL 10 min | attach after TTL returns 410 with the persisted `work` summary as fallback; breaker open gives 503 |
| Single-replica cancel and steer flags | durable cancel works across replicas; producer notices within its liveness check (up to 5 min); (b) F-t3-016 swaps `stop_live_producer()` |
| Hotspot merges (`grpc.rs`, `sse.rs`, composer, timeline) and 4.4.1 row 16 | all new logic in new files; `sse.rs` limited to four hook lines (S1 `:1358-1366` plus the three of S3), rebased on (b)'s +6,305-line train |
| Decision token in a POST body between gateway and model-gateway | body not URL; confirm request logging does not record bodies (UNVERIFIED) |

- **Cross-session touchpoints**:
  - Run phase vocabulary: (b) F-t3-015 (mp-WS16) owns the closed enum; WS09 supplies `running` through `RUN_PHASE_SQL`, WS10 adds `awaiting_approval`; WS11 maps through one function.
  - Stream buffer and event names: (a)/(b) own the envelope and taxonomy (X12); Space owns `ROOM_EVENT_POLICY`, default deny; WS09 never changes the invoke wire or `sse-taxonomy`.
  - Cancel and queued input across replicas: (b) F-t3-016 (C2: owner-bound queue, member steer later through a Control run-steer decision, which S7 delivers dark).
  - ZDR: one catalogue, `zdr_feature_not_supported` with `agent_run`, `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`; no new free text. Telemetry labels carry no ids (WS06).
  - Browser frames and `human_takeover`: (a)/WS20; the room never executes; a `browser` step class is reserved. Push wake: WS02 maps content-free run frames in one adapter; the poll stays the fallback. Artifact frame carries id and kind only (WS07, WS17).

#### WS10 Approvals: honest card, scoped consent, tool policy, addressee, quarantine

- **Resolves**: F-t1-010 approvals with grant scopes and durable resume, tool permission policy with ceilings, quarantine-and-release (Priority, audit L, Partial, W2; designed size 17.5-27.0 engineer-weeks, XL, because the card never said what the audit's L hides). Delivered: truthful card and derived continuation state (S1); Control-held standing rules and the once-token (S2-S4); per-tool allow/ask/block policy with Space ceiling and agent layers plus Agent-tab editor (S5a/S5b); addressee routing and member decide (S6); origin rules (S7); quarantine-and-release (S8); resumable-kind registry (S9). Not delivered: in-place loop resume ((b) F-t3-002), auto-review, per-user personal "always" ((b) F-t3-006), browser per-origin consent ((a) F-t2-032), new resumable kinds, notifications (WS11, WS02). **Owner plane and service**: Model Plane (session-core approvals, execution-core gate, model-gateway wire) with Control user-core (grants, policy, decisions); Frontend gateway and SPA; Convex projection of tool policy. **Lane and milestone**: S1 L2, S2/S5a L4, S3/S8/S9 L3, S4 L7, S5b L8, S6/S7 L2; S1, S2, S3, S4, S5a, S5b in **M2.1** (train T4), S6-S9 in **M2.3** (T6). **Depends on**: `M0-BASE` and `P-UC1`; S3 needs S1 and S2; S6 needs WS01-S3 (member append authority) and ADR-0011; S7 needs WS08-S2; decisions SD-15 (scope enum C3, policy registry C5), SD-21 (approver acts as requester), SD-01, SD-05, SD-12, SD-02. Can start without them: S1, S2 (after the scope-enum amendment below), S4, S5.
- **Verified starting point**:
  - Only the run owner can decide: `pin_approval_decision_identity` (`session-core/src/orchestration_grpc.rs:309`) stamps `decided_by`; the decide SQL carries `($6::text IS NULL OR user_id = $6)` (`orchestration_store.rs:826-833`); `decide_approval` (`:2644`) refuses ZDR callers first [M]. The audit's pointer to `SpaceApprovalPanel.tsx:1-60` for the pin is wrong; that file has no owner logic.
  - A grant writes authority only: model-gateway answers `continuation_delivery: "pending"` for every granted approval because `quarantine_granted_approval_continuation` (`model-gateway/src/approvals.rs:265`) always returns Err (`http_routes.rs:1560-1583`); the SPA never reads the field. The worker cold-executes one action from the encrypted descriptor (`execution-core/src/approval_delivery_worker.rs:463` `parse_resumable_action`: `execute_provider_action`, `book_shipment`, `tickets.create`) and fails closed `invalid_continuation` otherwise; it never re-enters the agent loop [C/M].
  - The card says "Approving lets the run continue" (`SpaceApprovalPanel.tsx:167-172,202`) and `settleApproval` calls `resumeRun` (`space-approvals.ts:91-117`), which cannot resume an approval-gated run; `approval_value` returns id, run, step, kind, state, `requested_of`, `decided_by`, reason only (`http_routes.rs:6146-6157`); nearly every gate is kind DESTRUCTIVE [C/M].
  - Three gates decide today: capability-core risk, hooks and `permission::evaluate_call` (`permission/mod.rs:43`; never-auto set `requires_durable_owner_approval` `:77`, `requires_consent_to_disclose` `:160`, `is_risky_call` `:195`), folded in `execute_step_inner` (`runtime_loop/mod.rs:467`); under posture `auto` provider writes self-approve. `allowed_tools` and `approval_mode` are advisory gateway filters, not the boundary (`spaces.rs:4500-4573`). There is no policy writer; Agent tab chips are read-only (`SpacePage.tsx:945-953`) [C/M].
  - Control stores no grant record: the only revocable grant is `conversation_agent_action_grants` in Application (`tickets.create` only); capability-core policy has no Space layer (`capability-core/internal/policy/engine.go:46-55`, `IsSupportedScope` accepts org and global only) [C].
  - (b) already built on `model-plane` (not in the live tree): `approval_consume_and_mode` (0046: `Approval.consumed_at = 14`, `continuation_mode = 15`, single-use `ConsumeApproval`); reserved by (b), NOT built: `DecideApprovalRequest.decision_source = 6` and `scope = 7` (assumed order, UNVERIFIED), `Approval.cause = 16`, decision record 17; commit `78a3d169` makes Space runs never loop-owned, so rooms cannot resume in place and WS10 stays action-only. The `Approval` message in the live proto stops at the fields of the committed tree (`orchestration.proto`, `ApprovalKind` 1-5).
  - Browser has two approval paths: whole-tool pause (descriptor, fails closed) and live per-action approvals polled inside the running browser loop with an empty descriptor (`execution-core/src/browser_events.rs:238-330`); WS10 must not break the second.
  - Room Activity cannot show others' approvals: it reads `/v1/runs/{id}/approvals` with the viewer's token and reports any failure as `approvals_upstream_unavailable` (`spaces.rs:1511-1553`); `envelope.rs` has no `details`; `turn_origin` exists nowhere; no CI job runs approval tests.
  - **Rulings that override the design** (02 C3, C5, SD-21; 05 X08, X22, N9; 04 4.6): (1) scope enum is (b)'s `ApprovalScope {ONCE, THREAD, RUN}`; "always" is a Control standing rule (`rule_id`, `review_by` default 90 d), only for MCP tool kinds; provider writes, destructive, owner effects and browser actions are ONCE only; any deny beats any grant (`block > grant > ask`). THREAD and RUN grants live in session-core (mp-WS13-S6, `approval_scope_grants`, (b) migration 0062, NOT built). (2) The design's `org_floor` layer is dropped; the org floor is read from capability-core `OrgAgentPolicy` when (b) delivers it. (3) `resume_class`, `cause_code`, `grant_scope` leave the proto (derive from `continuation_mode`; consume (b)'s `cause = 16` and `scope` once built; the WS10 slices that read them wait for that PR). (4) Numbers: session-core 0074 and 0082; user-core 039 and 040; proto tags below; quarantine `ApprovalKind` (`UNTRUSTED_CONTENT`) is 7 because 4.6.C gives 6 to `HUMAN_ASSIST` (PROPOSED, to be ledgered). The designs' 0046/0047/030/031 and Approval 14-23 are placeholders.

- **API, proto, data model and migrations**:
  - Migrations (4.6): session-core **0074** `approval_gate_context` (S3), **0082** `quarantined_outputs` (S8); user-core **039** `approval_grants`, **040** `space_tool_policies`. Convex: additive `toolPolicyRevision`, `toolPolicyDigest` on `spaceAgentBindings`, no migration directory.
  - Proto (4.6.C, add-only): `Approval` `tool_key = 18`, `action_label = 19`, `addressee = 20`, `requester_subject_id = 21`, `grant_ref = 22`, `turn_origin = 23`, `continuation = 24` (read projection); `CreateApprovalRequest` `context_json = 14`, `addressee = 15`, `tool_key = 16`, `action_digest = 17`, `turn_origin = 18`, `grant_use_token = 19`; `DecideApprovalRequest` `space_id = 8`, `space_decision_ref = 9`, `space_decision_token = 10`, `grant_use_token = 11`; `ApprovalKind` `UNTRUSTED_CONTENT = 7` (quarantine, PROPOSED; `HUMAN_ASSIST = 6` is the coordinated WS20-S7 kind). `ResumeClass` is a derived read model of (b)'s `continuation_mode`: `action_continuation` for the three cold kinds, `live_poll` for browser live approvals, `none` otherwise. Events: `ApprovalStateChanged` gains `grant_ref` and `decided_by` kinds only, no content.
  - Control internal routes (typed envelope, no authority in bodies): `POST .../spaces/approval-grants {space_ref, approval_id, scope: always, idempotency_key}` (403 `approval_scope_not_permitted`, `approval_grants_not_entitled`; 409 `approval_not_granted`; 404 `approval_not_found`; ZDR 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`); `GET .../spaces/{space_ref}/approval-grants`; `DELETE .../approval-grants/{grant_id}` (creator or manager, idempotent); `POST .../spaces/approval-decide-decision` (S6; 403 `approval_not_addressed_to_you`, 409 `approval_already_decided`); `POST .../spaces/tool-gate-view {run_id, org_id}` (service scope, returns levels per tool with source, `max_grant_scope`, `quarantine_mode`, `expires_at` at most 100 s); `POST .../spaces/approval-grants/use {run_id, org_id, tool_key, action_key, schema_hash}` (404 `no_applicable_grant`); `POST .../spaces/approval-continuation-check {approval_id, org_id}` (403 `authority_changed`); `PUT .../spaces/{space_ref}/approval-policy`, `PUT .../tool-policy` (403 `tool_policy_role_required`, 400 `tool_policy_invalid`).
  - Gateway routes: `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/approvals/{approval_id}/decide {decision, scope?, reason?, idempotency_key}` (400 `approval_scope_requires_space`; 403 `approval_not_addressed_to_you`, `approval_scope_not_permitted`; 409 `approval_already_decided`, `approval_expired`; 503 `approval_authority_unavailable`); a failed rule call leaves a plain once decision and answers `{grant:{status:"not_recorded"}}`; `GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/approvals?status=` (S6, redacted room view); `GET/DELETE .../approval-grants`; `GET/PUT .../tool-policy` and `PUT .../agents/{binding_ref}/tool-policy`; `PATCH .../approvals/{approval_id}/addressee`. The existing `POST /api/v1/orchestration/approvals/{id}/decide` (`orchestration.rs:92`) stays for chat and returns new fields additively; a `scope` in its body is refused.
  - Gate semantics: levels folded with `max_restrictive` over `allow < ask < block`; absent policy rows mean `allow` and never loosen default gates; never-auto set is never passable by a grant; gate view unavailable in a Space run makes risky calls `ask` with grants disabled (cause `policy_unavailable`); the approved action runs as the requester, the approver is recorded in `decided_by` (SD-21); ZDR: no grants, no once-token, no digest, no held content, existing catalogue codes only.
