Rebuild: `cd "apps/Model Plane" && ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core execution-core model-gateway`; `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `docker restart convex-gateway`, wait for "Convex functions ready!"; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway frontend`, restart Vite. Seed an org effect policy with thread, agent-action and `approval_grant_entitled` and a Space approval policy (script `apps/Control Plane/scripts/set-space-effect-policy.sh`). Flows: (1) member A runs a gated provider write: approval JSON shows `tool_key`, `continuation.state`; decide once; capture queued, running, completed, verified by read-back, integration receipt actor equals A; a shell (non-resumable) kind shows "retry this exact action once", never "the run continues". (2) Once-token retry passes (SQL `consumed_at`), second retry pauses; a standing rule for an `mcp_tool` kind passes without a pause (needs a callable `mcp_tool` in a Space run, UNVERIFIED that one exists; never for provider writes) and, once (b) mp-WS13-S6 lands, a THREAD grant passes a repeat call, a new thread pauses, manager revokes and the next call pauses; the M2.1 exit proves ONCE only. (3) Negative: member without role refused the standing rule; viewer refused; forged token refused; Space ceiling `block` denies with a typed cause even with a rule present. (4) ZDR org: rule create refused `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`, no digest rows. (5) S6: A requests, editor B is the named approver and decides; row shows `user_id=A`, `decided_by=B`, execution actor A; removing A before approval ends the continuation `authority_changed`, nothing runs. (6) S8: flagged fixture in shadow gives counter and log only; in enforce the content is held, previewed inertly to A only, released once. Capture HTTP transcripts, SQL rows, container image ids, `docker compose ps`, screenshots; commit the evidence note next to the plan.

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| (b)'s THREAD/RUN grants (mp-WS13-S6, 0062) are not built; a THREAD grant step has no store | M2.1 proves ONCE only (plus the consume-once race test); S3/S4 ship the once-token first and the standing rule for `mcp_tool` kinds only; the THREAD option is hidden until (b) lands; the standing rule never substitutes for a provider-write grant in the M2-S3 exit evidence |
| Once-token duplicates (b)'s `ConsumeApproval` | S3 first task: default to the design's `ClaimOnceApproval`; reuse `ConsumeApproval` only if a test on `model-plane` shows it accepts `continuation_mode = ''` rows and binds `action_fingerprint` (its request keys on `approval_id, org_id, run_id, step_id, action_fingerprint, claim_token, omit_call` and claims a loop-mode approval); never extend (b)'s message |
| Policy of record (C5) | the fold keeps sources independent; only the S5a store location would move |
| Grants widen authority | invariants: approver never gains authority, never-auto set never passes, `block` beats grant, schema-hash binding, cascade on agent removal, `review_by`, per-use Control check |
| Quarantine false positives (16-phrase marker list) | shadow first, per-Space `quarantine_mode`, external trust classes only |
| Go proto regeneration drift | scoped regen of `orchestration` and `runs` only, parity tests, controlled PR |
| Control latency on the tool path | per-run view cache at most 100 s; `use` only on `ask` |
| Once-token digest mismatch when the model rephrases | card says "this exact action"; standing rules exist for repeated work |
| Three copies of the resume list | one const list and the S9 parity test |
| Principal and scope registry parity | P-CFG train; run the parity script in S2 |
| Uncommitted base (Z-series, `retention_receipt.rs`, `zdr_posture.rs`) | `M0-BASE` before any S3 work |

- **Open questions**:
  1. Who may create a standing rule: managers and owners only (assumed)?
  2. May a manager override an approval addressed to a named requester, or only when the addressee is `any_manager`?
  3. Is "approving runs the action as the requester" (SD-21) the product rule?
  4. Until (b) delivers THREAD grants, is once plus standing rule acceptable for the M2.1 exit? Answered (review ruling 8): the M2.1 exit proves ONCE only (plus the consume-once race test); standing rules exist only for `mcp_tool` kinds (their M2.1 evidence needs a callable `mcp_tool` in a Space run, UNVERIFIED that one exists) and never for provider writes; THREAD is proven when (b) lands mp-WS13-S6 (criterion 10b).
  5. Is `UNTRUSTED_CONTENT = 7` acceptable given `HUMAN_ASSIST = 6` (ledger entry), and what false-positive rate moves quarantine from shadow to enforce?
  6. May WS10 later relax the room `agentic` strip so `require_confirmation` bindings run tools under `ask` (behaviour change, not in these slices)?

#### WS11 Notifications, cross-room attention, read state

- **Resolves**: F-t1-008 Space notifications (Priority, XL, Partial, W2, High); F-t1-009 cross-room attention (Priority, L, Partial, W2); F-t1-042 read state, presence, follow-ups (Recommended, L, Partial, W2). Delivered: closed signal set `mention, reply, invite, agent_done, agent_failed, reminder` as refs-only Application items; approvals and "agent waiting" as live-derived needs-you; per-room levels (`all`, `mentions`, `off`), thread follow and mute, fixed precedence, coalescing, budgets; polled aggregate `GET /api/v1/spaces/attention` with one server-computed badge; Home inbox at `/attention` (lanes, done, snooze); mark unread, first-unread divider and jump; org-scoped status with text and expiry; agent availability chips; reminders; refs-only email through notification-core. Not delivered: Web Push and PWA (F-t1-035), DND schedules (F-t1-059), delivery ledger and digests (F-t1-060), cross-room realtime push (S12 reserved), cross-room Activity view, inline reply, saved items, per-thread receipts, reaction and edit signals (WS12). WS11 stores and transports ids, closed words and timestamps only; titles in the inbox are re-read at render under the viewer's current Control decision. **Owner plane and service**: Application (convex-core projection and ingest, notification-core courier) with Model Plane (session-core `SpaceAttention` RPC and outbox, model-gateway route), Control user-core (one bulk read-decision route, no table), Frontend (BFF aggregate, SPA store and inbox). **Lane and milestone**: S1 L4, S2/S5 L2, S3/S6/S9/S10/S11 L6, S4/S7 L9, S8 L7; all **M2.2** (train T5). **Depends on**: `P-UC1`, `P-CX1`, `P-SPA1`; S2 needs WS15-S5 (thread activity summary, migration 0078, pulled forward by rule R7); S5 needs WS02-S1 (`space_event_log`, 0072) and external gate E3 (mp-WS01.S2 outbox fix deployed) for live proof; S6 soft WS08-S2 (mentions); S9 needs Novu workflows (operator fact SD-27); decisions SD-17 (transport and badge), SD-02, SD-12, SD-15 (run-state vocabulary C17). Can start without them: S1-S4 and S10.

- **API, proto, data model and migrations**:
  - Migrations (4.6): session-core **0079** conditional (S2) and **0080** (S5); notification-core **020** (S9); Convex tables as above, no numbering; no Control table or migration. 0079 and 0080 are idempotent with `revert/` files; the runbook creates the index `CONCURRENTLY` first.
  - Control: `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/thread-read-decisions {items:[{space_ref, idempotency_key}] (1..60), service_audience?}` returns `{data:{results:[{space_ref, status:"issued", decision, token} | {space_ref, status:"denied", reason:"not_member"|"not_entitled"|"not_active"}]}}`; 400 `{error:"..."}` for 0 or more than 60 items; every token is an ordinary `model.thread.read` decision (2 min), so no new action, schema or Rust verifier change. UNVERIFIED: that decision material may be generated N times in one request.
  - Proto `space_attention.proto`: `GetSpaceAttention(org_id, user_id, rule, spaces[<=60]{space_id, decision_ref, decision_token, since_ms, headline_thread_ids[<=20]})` returning per space `{status OK|DENIED|ZDR|ERROR, unread_threads, unread_capped, latest_activity_ms, working_runs, pending[<=20]{approval_id, run_id, thread_id, requested_at_ms, kind}, headlines[]{thread_id, title}}`; `UnreadRule LEGACY_OWNER|LAST_AUTHOR`. Unread rule is WS01's (latest user or assistant message newer than the effective marker and not authored by the viewer); no marker means nothing is unread; effective marker is the manual floor if set else `lastReadAt`; working = root runs of the space with open live phase in the last 20 minutes (replace with WS09 `RUN_PHASE_SQL`); pending = approvals addressed to the viewer (run owner until WS10-S6).
  - BFF routes (typed envelope, flag off gives 404 `space_attention_disabled`, `require_session`, `authorized_org_id` first): `GET /api/v1/spaces/attention?refs=` (at most 60; `rooms:[{space_ref, unread_threads, unread_capped, mentions, needs_you, working, last_activity_at, last_read_at, manual_unread, level, badge:{kind,n}, gaps}]`, `totals:{badge, unread_rooms, other_open}`, `mode:"live"|"zdr_empty"`; failing sources become `gaps` and `meta.stale_sources`, never 5xx; 429 `rate_limited` 6 per minute per user; 503 `space_index_unavailable` only when Control's index fails); `GET .../attention/items?state=&kind=&limit=50&cursor=` (404-filtered by Control index; `headline_state` `ok|hidden|restricted`); `POST .../attention/items/{item_id}/state` (400 `invalid_snooze`, 404 `attention_item_not_found`); `POST .../attention/read-all` (never creates markers, never touches `needs_you`); `GET/PUT .../{space_ref}/notify` (400 `invalid_level`); `PUT .../threads/{thread_id}/follow` (ZDR 412); `POST .../{space_ref}/unread`; `POST .../{space_ref}/read` gains `reason:"enter"|"while_open"`; `GET/PUT .../spaces/status` (400 `invalid_status`; text under ZDR 412); `POST .../{space_ref}/reminders`, `GET .../spaces/reminders`, `DELETE .../reminders/{id}` (400 `invalid_reminder_time`, 429 above 50 pending). Static segments register before `{space_ref}` routes. Action contracts (`ownerPlane` application, risk low, none model-eligible): `spaces.mark_all_read`, `spaces.mark_unread`, `spaces.set_notify_level`, `spaces.set_thread_follow`, `spaces.set_attention_item_state`, `spaces.set_status`, `spaces.create_reminder` (reversible through `spaces.cancel_reminder`).
  - Badge rule (computed once, in Rust, table-tested): `n = needs_you + mentions`; `n > 0` gives Count(n) at every level; else level `all` with unread gives a muted count, level `mentions` a dot, level `off` none; `totals.badge` sums `n` only; unread reported separately as `unread_rooms`. Default level `mentions` (PD-WS11).
  - Events: `mp.v1.space.<space_ref>.event` on JetStream `MODEL_PLANE_SPACE_EVENTS`, envelope `SPACE_MESSAGE_APPENDED` or run event with `zdr:false`, ids and closed words only, deterministic `event_id` as `Nats-Msg-Id`; refs containing `.`, `*`, `>` or whitespace are skipped and counted. Convex precedence (fixed): drop self; drop non-members of the active acknowledged audience; `mention` and `invite` pass every level and mute; level `off` and muted thread drop the rest; `reply` needs a following recipient; `agent_done` and `agent_failed` go to the run starter only; observed-room suppression for `reply` and `agent_done`; coalesce per (recipient, kind, thread or space); out-of-app only for new or reopened rows, status not `dnd`, budget 30 per recipient per hour.
  - Out of app: delegation v2 service id `space-attention` (key `NOTIFICATION_SPACE_ATTENTION_SERVICE_TOKEN`), types `space.mention|reply|invite|agent_done|agent_failed|approval_needed|agent_awaiting|reminder`, `retention_mode: standard`, payload `{space_ref, thread_id?, message_id?, run_id?, actor_kind, deep_link_path}`, `idempotency_key = <eventId>:<recipient>`; no title, text or name.

- **Definition of done and evidence**: repo rule; 06 scenario M2-S4. Rebuild: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `cd "apps/Model Plane" && SPACE_ATTENTION_SUMMARY=1 SPACE_ATTENTION_EMIT=1 ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway nats-provisioner`; `cd "apps/Application Plane" && docker compose up -d --build convex-backend convex-subscriber notification-core jetstream-provisioner`, restart `convex-gateway`; frontend `docker compose up -d --build gateway`, restart Vite. Prove up with `bash "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/build-verevon-services.sh" --status`, `psql` (`\d messages`, `\d space_attention_settings`), `nats stream info MODEL_PLANE_SPACE_EVENTS` and `nats consumer info MODEL_PLANE_SPACE_EVENTS convex-space-attention`; `/healthz` is constant and proves nothing. Flow: (1) A and B in one room with `thread_read_entitled`; B posts while A is elsewhere: within one poll `GET /api/v1/spaces/attention` shows `unread_threads=1` and A's sidebar shows the dot with the room closed; A opens the room and the next poll shows 0; removing A's entitlement removes the room's counts as a gap. Mark unread then re-enter proves `reason:"enter"` clears the floor. (2) B mentions A (WS08 path or a DB fixture setting `messages.metadata`): SQL shows the `space_event_log` row and one outbox row with subject `mp.v1.space.<ref>.event` and `published_at` set; one `spaceAttentionItems` row `kind=mention` with no text field; replaying the NATS message keeps one row; `/attention` lists it with the title fetched at render and hides it under `hide_preview`; Done removes it. (3) A run completes: A (starter) gets `agent_done`; a run waiting for approval shows under Needs you from the live query with no item. (4) Negative: muted thread yields no item; a user outside the audience yields none; ZDR org gets `zdr_empty` and typed 412 on follow; forged `recipient` rejected; notification-core refuses `space.mention` from the gateway principal. (5) S9 with `NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_MODE=novu` in a test org: one email-eligible mention creates one `notification_requests` row, refs-only payload, budget cap 30 per hour holds. Capture SQL, `nats` outputs, Convex rows, HAR of aggregate and items calls, screenshots (badge, page, divider, restricted headline), log excerpts without content or recipient ids, Playwright trace, test summaries; note beside `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/docs/SPACE_*`.
- **Risks and mitigations**:

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Control cost of 60 decisions per poll per user | cap 60, 30 s visible-only poll, one poller per browser (Web Locks), BFF 6 per minute and 10 s single-flight per user; fallback is a Control-side bulk evidence query with the same route and output |
| Clock skew between Convex `Date.now()` and Session Core `created_at` | 2 s grace in the SQL; skewed-fixture test |
| Double counting | badge rule sums `needs_you + mentions` only |
| Notification storms from chatty agents | one row per (recipient, kind, thread), `agent_done` to the starter only, budget 30 per hour, observed suppression |
| Lost or duplicate events | durable consumer with explicit ack, deterministic `Nats-Msg-Id`, Convex dedupe, hourly sweep; a lost item degrades to the derived unread badge, never to a wrong authority decision |
| WS02 or WS15-S5 not landed or columns differ | S5 is the only slice reading the log; S2 is blocked on WS15-S5 by sequencing |
| Mentions dark until WS08 | pipeline proven with a DB fixture; other kinds ship regardless |
| notification-core delivery never exercised live | S9 last and flagged; in-app does not depend on it |
| Outbox CHECK has three editors ((a), (b), Space) | one subject class each, one editor (X31), integrator batches |

- **Cross-session touchpoints**:
  - Outbox event class `mp.v1.space.*.event` and closed run-state words: WS11 owns subject and envelope; (b) owns the run-state enum (mp-WS16: `needs_input > failed > running > parked > queued > unseen_done > idle`) and the outbox classifier; one mapper `runStateToSignal` absorbs renames (C17); Space runs its own room stream and aggregate and does not join (b)'s hub (N11).
  - notification-core registry (X32): WS11 owns `space.*`, (b) owns `agent.*`, `chat.*`, `modelplane.*`, (a) `quarry.*`; one allowlist; payloads refs-only; migration numbers 015-017 (b), 018-019 (a), 020 Space; the principal goes through the P-CFG train.
  - Approvals and agent work: `needs_you` reads Session Core approvals through the WS10-S6 addressee predicate; WS10 owns `awaiting_approval`; WS09 owns `RUN_PHASE_SQL`; WS15-S5 owns the thread activity summary.
  - ZDR and telemetry: persistent-only projection, typed refusals, metrics are counts with a bounded `kind` label, never recipient or space ids. Web Push, PWA, shell stream: (b) F-t3-015 and F-t1-035 own them; WS11 provides items, badges and the content-free wake contract (S12).

### 3.D: Wave 2: DMs and message lifecycle, search and navigation, attachments and sharing, composer and timeline

- Delivers: Teams/Slack-class human collaboration on top of the Wave 1 member-post spine: DMs and group DMs, edit/delete/retract and reactions (WS12); permission-checked message search, permalinks, command palette and slash commands (WS13); durable room files and repaired artifact sharing grants (WS14); drafts, markdown composer, a 2,000-post-scale timeline and typed entries (WS15).
- Order: WS12 ships first as milestone M2.2 (S1 and S4 in parallel, then S2/S5, S6, S3/S7, S8 last). WS13, WS14 and WS15 form M2.3 and run in parallel lanes: WS15-S5 before WS13-S1 on the session-core lane (L1), WS14-S1/S2 on Control, client-only slices (WS13-S6, WS14-S8, WS15-S1/S2) can start in week 1.
- Rules for this part: sequencing (`04-sequencing.md`) owns slice order, lanes, milestones and every migration/proto number, so design numbers are replaced where noted ("design said N"); flags are rollout controls, never authorization; every durable write is refused for ZDR callers with the typed code `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden`.

Seam mapping (04-sequencing 4.4, applies to all four workstreams): line numbers are live-tree; on `model-plane` `grpc.rs` is 14,179 lines and `list_conversation`, `start_managed_run`, `load_thread_messages` sit 440-553 lines lower (`append_message_in_tx` `:2436`, `sse.rs` `load_recent_thread_messages` `:5375`), so anchor by function name and re-grep at `M0-BASE`; `P-GW1` renames `GW/domains/spaces.rs` to `GW/domains/spaces/mod.rs`, so "spaces.rs :NNN" in this part means the same function after the move, and each feature adds `GW/domains/spaces/<feature>.rs` plus one `mod` and one `.merge()` line. `P-SC1` creates `SC/src/space/` (new session-core logic goes in `src/space/<feature>.rs`, not `grpc.rs`) and `MG/src/space_routes/` (one file per feature, one `.merge()` line in `http_routes.rs`). `P-UC1` splits Control routes into `routes_<feature>.go` and scopes into `scopes_spaces.go`. `P-CX1` splits Convex tables into `convex/schema/<feature>.ts`. `P-SPA1` splits `spaces-client.ts` into `spaces-client/<feature>.ts` behind a barrel and action-registry entries into `src/shared/actions/domains/spaces/<ws>.ts` fragments (gateway dispatchers into `dispatchers_spaces/<ws>.rs`). New proto services go in new `space_*.proto` files. The design paths below are kept where they name today's code; new files follow the seams above.

#### WS12 Direct messages, message lifecycle, reactions

- **Resolves**: F-t1-016 DMs and group DMs (Priority, Absent, L, W2, High) and F-t1-017 message lifecycle and reactions (Priority, Absent, L, W2, High). Audit sized L+L; designer total 12.0 to 17.5 ew. Left to others: mutable DM rosters with history windows (WS04-S11), agents inside a DM (WS17), DM notifications (WS11), quote/fork (WS13), agent reactions (WS08/WS18), edit window, org-admin moderation. **Owner plane and service**: Control user-core (DM identity, revise decision, policy), Application convex-core (DM Space record, hide, reactions), Model session-core (revision log, single writer of messages, ADR 1 option A) and model-gateway (relay), Frontend gateway and SPA. **Lane and milestone**: M2.2; L4 (S1, S5), L6 (S2, S8a), L1 (S4, S6), L7 then L8 (S3 and S7 split `-a` gateway, `-b` SPA; S8 `-b` gateway/SPA). **Depends on**: `M0-T0` (seed script and fixtures), WS01-S1 (S4), WS01-S5/S6/S7a/S7b (S3, S7, S8), WS04-S4 (the only room-membership writer) and WS04-S5 (audience registration; no DM works without it), WS03-S1 merged first (catalogue rows), seams P-UC1, P-CX1, P-GW1, P-SPA1/2; soft WS04-S3 or S9 (people picker). Decisions: SD-01 (ADR 1) gates S4-S7, S1-S3 can start without it; SD-13 and SD-14 (membership writer, DM kinds amend ADR-0001) gate enabling S1-S3; SD-19 (purge versus retain, reactions store, moderation, DM entitlement) gates S4, S5, S8; SD-15 (revision vocabulary, C11) gates the schema-bearing S4; SD-18 gates enablement; SD-12 for ZDR copy.

**Verified starting point** (live tree `C:/dev/CoresSystem`, re-checked 2026-10-20)
- Space kinds `personal, room, project, case` live in three places: constraint `registered_spaces_kind_chk` (`UC/migrations/017_space_authority.up.sql:19` [C]), Go constants and two validators (`UC/internal/spaces/authority.go:17-20,109,356` [C]), the Convex union (`CX/convex/schema.ts:549-554` [C]). Every shared evidence resolver filters `space_kind <> 'personal'`, so a new kind resolves as shared automatically.
- No code calls `replaceRecipientAudience` (`CX/convex/spaces.ts:735` [C], definition only), so a DM, whose shared decisions need a registered audience, cannot work until WS04-S5 lands.
- Membership writers have no DM guard: `Repository.ReplaceMemberships` (`UC/internal/spaces/repository.go:646` [C], refuses personal only), `requireManagedRoom` (`CX/convex/spaceMembers.ts:22`), `createSpaceAgentForGateway` (`spaceAgents.ts:412`) and `bindExistingSpaceAgentForGateway` (`:529`); `AuthorizeDeletion` (`repository.go:171`) admits personal Spaces only. The gateway create route refuses all but personal and room (`GW/domains/spaces.rs:2877` `unsupported_space_kind`, test `:7395-7399`).
- Session Core `messages` has no `UPDATE` anywhere; `sequence` is a global identity column, so the audit's "(thread, seq)" key is wrong and revisions key by `message_id`. `append_message` is owner-gated (`SC/src/grpc.rs:4495-4504` [M]); `append_message_in_tx` at `:2432`, `INSERT INTO messages` at `:2571`.
- `ListConversation` has four consumers that must see one folded view: `MG/src/sse.rs:5350-5433` [M], `MG/src/tool_loop.rs`, `MG/src/http_routes.rs`, capability-core `MP/go/services/capability-core/internal/sessionreview/transcript.go:43` [C]. The earlier persisted-versions design was rejected (`MP/docs/CHAT_RESUME_AND_VERSIONS_SPEC.md:87-93`); this design is per-message, no nesting, no supersede.
- Both SPA transcript normalizers drop empty-content turns and `message_id` (`FV/src/shared/api/spaces-client.ts:627-656`, `FV/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceRoomTimeline.tsx:49-69`), so a tombstone would vanish. Audit/Haiku "no `spaces.*` registry pattern" is wrong: `FV/src/shared/actions/action-registry.ts` already holds 14 `spaces.*` ids.
- ZDR: `authorize_operation` refuses non-read scopes (`SC/src/auth.rs:276-281` [M]); typed `Refusal::DURABLE_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` is at `MC/src/zdr_refusal.rs:65` [U] and `require_non_zdr_durable_mutation` at `MG/src/http_routes.rs:823` [M]. Implementation must start from a tree containing that uncommitted work (the sequencing base `space`, cut from `model-plane`, does).

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- DM routes: `POST /api/v1/spaces/dm` body `{participants:[subject_id], client_request_id}` (`deny_unknown_fields`); 202 `{data:{space:{space_ref,name,kind,lifecycle:"pending_registration",participants},created:true}}`, 200 with `created:false`; errors 400 `dm_participants_invalid`, 403 `dm_not_entitled` (`details.missing[]`), 404 `dm_disabled`, 409 `dm_registration_failed`, 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden` (no `feature` field), 503 `zdr_decision_unavailable`/`space_provisioning_unavailable`. `POST` and `DELETE /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/hide` -> `{data:{space_ref,hidden,hidden_at}}`, 409 `space_not_hideable`. `GET /api/v1/spaces` adds `participants`, `agent_scope`, `hidden`. Control `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/dm-eligibility` (scope `spaces:resolve`): 200 `{data:{eligible,kind,participant_hash,participant_ids}}`, 403 `dm_not_entitled`, 422 `dm_participants_invalid` (`details.reason` in count, duplicate, self, not_in_org, inactive), 404 `dm_disabled`.
- Revision routes: `PATCH /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/threads/{thread_id}/messages/{message_id}` `{content, idempotency_key}` and `DELETE` same path (header `Idempotency-Key`, optional `?moderation_reason=` closed set) -> 200 `{data:{message_id,revision_state,revision_no,revised_at}}`; errors 400 `invalid_message`/`revision_noop`/`invalid_idempotency_key`, 403 `space_message_revise_not_authorized`/`message_revise_forbidden`, 404 `message_not_found`, 409 `message_already_deleted`/`thread_run_active`/`idempotency_key_conflict`/`space_authority_stale` (re-mint once), 412 typed ZDR, 503 `space_decision_unavailable`/`session_unavailable`. model-gateway: `PATCH` and `DELETE /v1/threads/:thread_id/messages/:message_id`, `GET .../target`. Reactions: `PUT` and `DELETE .../messages/{message_id}/reactions/{emoji}`; 403 `space_role_cannot_react`, 400 `invalid_emoji`, 409 `reaction_limit`; transcript turns gain `message_id, revision_state, revised_at, revised_by_subject_id, agent_followed_up, reactions[]`.
- Control decision `model.thread.revise`, schema `sha256:thread-revise-v1`, audience `model-plane`, role floor editor; permissions `thread:revise`, `thread:moderate` (manager or owner, never in DM kinds), exactly one of `revise:purge_original` or `revise:retain_original`; internal routes `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/thread-revise-decision` (`spaces:issue`), `GET /api/v1/internal/spaces/{space_ref}/message-policy` (`spaces:resolve`, hints only), `PUT /api/v1/internal/spaces/message-policy` (`spaces:policy:write`).
- Proto (tags per 04-sequencing 4.6.C): `SessionMessage` `revision_state = 15`, `revised_at = 16`, `revised_by_subject_id = 17`, `revision_no = 18`, `agent_followed_up = 19` (design said 8-12); RPCs `ReviseMessage` (request carries the append decision envelope fields plus `message_id`, `action`, `content`, `moderation_reason`), `ResolveMessageTarget` (read class, returns role and state only), appended after (b)'s RPCs in merge order. `buf breaking` against `baseline.binpb` must pass; `MP/go/gen` regenerates in one L0 PR.
- Session Core `0076_message_revisions.sql`: `message_revisions(revision_id PK, org_id, thread_id, message_id REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, revision_no, action in edited/deleted, actor_subject_id, actor_class in author/agent_owner/moderator, moderation_reason closed set, content NULL when deleted or purged, content_digest, prev_content_digest, original_retention in retain/purge, idempotency_hash, space/audience/authority refs, created_at)` with `UNIQUE(message_id, revision_no)` and `UNIQUE(message_id, idempotency_hash)`; the single sanctioned `UPDATE messages` (purge mode) lives only in `SC/src/space/revisions.rs`. Fold: `LEFT JOIN LATERAL` on the latest allowed revision in `list_conversation`, `load_thread_messages`, Dreaming loaders; deletion applies above the audience ceiling (fail closed).
- Control migrations: `041` (`registered_spaces_kind_chk` incl. `dm`,`group_dm`; `participant_hash` with `CHECK ((space_kind IN ('dm','group_dm')) = (participant_hash IS NOT NULL))`; partial unique index `(org_id, participant_hash)`; `space_effect_policies.dm_create_entitled`), `042` (`message_revise_entitled`, `message_moderate_entitled`, `space_message_policies` default absent = purge, `space_message_policy_events`). `participant_hash = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256("participant-set/v1\0" || per byte-sorted unique id: uint64be(len) || id))`; 2 to 9 participants.
- Convex: `spaces` gains `participantHash`, `participantExternalAuthIds`; tables `spaceDmHides {externalOrgId, spaceRef, externalAuthId, hiddenAt}` and `spaceReactions {externalOrgId, spaceRef, threadId, messageId, emoji, externalAuthId, createdAt}` (cap 20 distinct emoji per message). Events: `MESSAGE_REVISED` (ids and enums only, carries `thread_id` so thread delete erases it) plus audit body `event:"message_revised"`, `plane:"model"`, `producer:"session-core"` (family `verevon.audit.v2.model.session-core.*`). Registry entries: `spaces.open_dm`, `spaces.hide_space`, `spaces.edit_message`, `spaces.delete_message` (medium risk, `reversible:false`), `spaces.toggle_reaction`; none model-executable.

**Flags and rollout**

| Flag | Owner | Default | Kill switch | ZDR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SPACE_DM_REGISTRATION` | user-core env | off in production | 0 and restart: no new DMs, existing DMs keep resolving | n/a |
| `SPACE_DM_OPEN` | Convex env (`set_convex_env`) | off | 0 | n/a |
| `SPACE_DM_API` | gateway `space_features` | on outside production | gateway flip hides UI and routes | typed 412, no Control or Convex call |
| `dm_create_entitled`, `message_revise_entitled`, `message_moderate_entitled`, retention row | Control effect policy | false, purge | policy flip | refused |
| `SPACE_MESSAGE_REVISE_CORE` | session-core env via `MC` | off in compose, `1` in dev override | 0: no new revisions, existing stay applied (fold is always on) | `authorize_operation` refusal remains the backstop |
| `SPACE_MESSAGE_REVISE_API` | model-gateway + gateway env | off in production | gateway flip | typed 412 at gateway and model-gateway |
| `SPACE_REACTIONS`, `SPACE_REACTIONS_API` | Convex env, gateway env | off in production | gateway flip | refused before any Convex write |

Rollout: S1 and S4 dark; S2, S5; S6; enable CORE then API in dev; S3, S7, S8 in dev; staging with two members and a policy row; production per org (G5). DMs additionally need WS04-S5 on and its live check green first. Revision rows, events and audit carry ids, enums and digests only; content exists only in `message_revisions.content` for non-ZDR orgs and is purged per policy.

**Definition of done and evidence** (repo rule: rebuilt local images, a running stack, a verified end-to-end flow; scenario M2-S5 of `06-verification.md`)
1. Provision an org effect policy with `thread_create_entitled`, `thread_read_entitled`, `dm_create_entitled`, `message_revise_entitled`, `message_moderate_entitled`; `space_message_policies` once `retain`, once `purge`; WS04-S5 audience registration live; members B and C seeded by `scripts/space-e2e-seed.sh` (M0-T0).
2. Rebuild: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core` (confirm 041 and 042 in `schema_migrations`); `cd "apps/Model Plane" && SPACE_MESSAGE_REVISE_CORE=1 SPACE_MESSAGE_REVISE_API=1 ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway` and `\d message_revisions` in `psql` (`/healthz` proves nothing); `docker restart convex-gateway`, wait for "Convex functions ready!"; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway`, restart Vite; `bash build-verevon-services.sh --status`.
3. DM flow: A opens a DM with B (202 then active); SQL shows one `registered_spaces` row kind `dm` with `participant_hash` and two memberships; second open by A and open by B return the same `space_ref` with `created:false`; A and B exchange posts; B hides, A posts, the DM resurfaces for B; a 3-person group works with no add-member path; agent bind in a DM returns 409; org without `dm_create_entitled` gets 403 with `missing[]`; ZDR org gets typed 412 and no Control call in user-core logs.
4. Lifecycle flow: A edits (row in `message_revisions`; `messages.content` unchanged under retain, blanked under purge), B sees "edited"; A deletes: tombstone for both, linked `agent_memory` rows gone, `GET /v1/threads/<id>/context` shows the tombstone line, `MESSAGE_REVISED` event has ids only, audit-core has `event=message_revised`; manager deletes B's post (`actor_class=moderator`); B editing A's message gets 403 `message_revise_forbidden`; viewer, non-member, removed member refused; replayed key returns `deduplicated:true`, same key with other text 409; edit during an active run `thread_run_active`; B toggles two reactions, a viewer is refused, delete clears them, ZDR org refused. Forged `actor_class`/`original_retention` body fields rejected; a v1 append token is refused by `ReviseMessage`.
5. Capture: SQL outputs per step, HAR of PATCH, DELETE, reaction and open-DM calls, screenshots (sidebar DM group, toolbar, tombstone, restricted states), Playwright trace, content-free log excerpts, test summaries from `cargo`, `go`, `vitest`, Convex; a dated note beside `FV/docs/SPACE_*`.

**Risks and mitigations**
- Revision model re-litigates the rejected versions design (conflict C11): per-message, no nesting, no supersede; reviewer checklist cites `CHAT_RESUME_AND_VERSIONS_SPEC.md:87-93`; 02-decisions C11 names the shared `effective_content` fold, and (b)'s `message_versions` (0061) stays personal-thread only.
- Purge mode is the first `UPDATE` on `messages`: one module, source-scan test, retain mode strictly append-only.
- A hidden `ListConversation` reader shows the stale original: fold lives in the shared SQL; contract test over every caller; capability-core test.
- DM orphan Space after Control rejects registration: gateway pre-check, Control backstop, `failed_registration` surfaced as `dm_registration_failed`, operator cleanup note.
- Audience never registers: hard dependency on WS04-S5; DM flag stays off until its live check passes.
- GDPR erasure of the DM creator deletes the peer's messages (inherits WS01 open question): flagged, counsel needed (SD-19); author-level erase is a follow-up.
- Agent-owner rule uses thread owner as run initiator: documented; add `messages.run_id` when WS09-S9 member runs land.
- Reactions or edits mistaken for approval: no code path from reactions to approvals; a test pins it. Migration or tag collisions: only numbers from 04-sequencing 4.6; `grpc.rs` edits limited to registration, fold and verifier lines, logic in `src/space/revisions.rs`.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- `ListConversation` fold, message tree (F-t3-012), rewind (F-t3-069): WS12 owns the per-message revision fold for Space threads, sibling b owns the personal tree (DEC-29 partition by `threads.space_id`); b's search clause that skips revised-away originals covers Space revisions; first lander of `append_message_in_tx` owns it.
- Memory retirement on delete (`agent_memory.source_links`, Letta mirror): WS12 retires rows linked to the deleted message only; label schema is WS17 (`SC/src/space/memory_scope.rs`).
- ZDR typed refusals: WS12 uses `DURABLE_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` and `DECISION_UNAVAILABLE`; WS06 types the Session Core free text. Audit stream: `message_revised` joins `verevon.audit.v2.model.session-core.*`.
- `space_effect_policies` (X34): Space owns the schema, one column per capability, WS03 catalogue rows. WS04-S4/S7/S8 must allow-list `kind = 'room'`; WS11 replaces the interim DM unread poll; WS16 owns sidebar organisation around the DM group; WS13 permalinks need the tombstone behaviour.

3. Reactions in Application Convex (assumed) or in Session Core with the message (SD-19; S8 swaps the store behind the same gateway contract)?
4. May room managers and owners delete others' posts; may non-member org admins?
5. What happens to a DM when its creator is erased under GDPR?
6. May `sse.rs` take one call-site line from WS12-S4 (`render_for_model` in `load_recent_thread_messages`)? Answered: listed in 4.4.1 row 16 (integrator approves per PR); WS08-S3's splice fix lands first.

**Verified starting point**
- No Space search exists: no `tsvector` or `websearch_to_tsquery` in `SC/src` or `SC/migrations`, no search RPC in `sessions.proto`, and `GW/domains/search.rs:37-45` [C] has only web, similar, suggest, images, videos, suggestions, answer routes. The audit's `grpc.rs:5425-5475` is `list_conversation` (`SC/src/grpc.rs:5387` [M]), a read pattern to copy, not a search.
- A Control read decision is Space-scoped, not thread-scoped, so one decision authorizes a room-wide query; Session Core verifies it with `pub(crate) fn verify_thread_read_space_decision` (`SC/src/grpc.rs:1970` [M]; `UC/internal/spaces/shared_thread_read_decision.go` [C]). The BFF mints per request (`shared_thread_read_decision`, `GW/domains/spaces.rs:1268`) and treats Control 403/404 as no shared read (transcript route `:2616` then returns 403), so search needs an honest `coverage` split rather than an empty list.
- `messages.sequence` is `GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY` for the whole table (`SC/migrations/0001_init.sql:14-24` [C]); the audit's `?thread_id=&seq=` would leak global volume. Permalinks use `messages.id` (ULID, already returned as `message_id` by model-gateway; the SPA drops it).
- ZDR: `authorize_operation` refuses non-read scopes for ZDR credentials (`SC/src/auth.rs:276-285` [M]) so ZDR turns write no rows to index; a `zdr_waived` run is persisted on purpose (`SC/migrations/0044_run_retention_receipt.sql:78-81` [U]; Dreaming already skips such threads), a class the audit did not name.
- Erasure deletes `messages` rows directly (`SC/src/gdpr.rs:290,368` [C]), so an expression index needs no new purge hook; the gateway Space router is `GW/domains/spaces.rs:649` with sub-module precedent `mod schedule_template;` at `:30`; `spaces.rs` is 9,882 lines.
- Cmd/Ctrl+K opens `GlobalSearchDialog` (`FV/src/features/core/components/CoreNavbar.tsx:383` [M]): Data v2 knowledge search plus a local chat-title filter, no focus trap or listbox roles (`CoreNavbar.test.tsx` has 2 cases). The room `/` is a skill picker (`FV/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceRoomComposer.tsx:83,247` [M]). `?thread_id=` is emitted by Activity (`FV/src/features/spaces/lib/activity-grammar.ts`) and consumed by nothing in Spaces; `App.tsx` has only `/spaces` and `/spaces/:spaceId`.
- 14 `spaces.*` action descriptors exist (`FV/src/shared/actions/action-registry.ts`) with a strict dispatcher-parity test (`GW/../scripts/action-surface-contract.test.mjs`); the registry has no hotkey or `when` field, so the palette wraps it. Pins are owner-only (`thread_presentation_owner_only`); Convex has no pins table.

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/search` body `{query, prefix?, scope (room, thread, person), thread_id?, author_subject_id?, role?, since?, until?, sort?, limit?, cursor?}` (strict, unknown fields 400) -> 200 `{data:{hits:[{message_id,thread_id,space_id,role,author_subject_id?,agent_name?,created_at,snippet:[{text,matched}],thread_title}], next_cursor, truncated, coverage ("shared" or "own_threads_only"), excluded[]}}`, `Cache-Control: no-store`. Errors 400 `invalid_query` (`min_chars:2,max_chars:200`), `invalid_filter`, `invalid_cursor`; 403 `active_membership_required`; 404 `space_not_found`, `space_search_disabled`; 429 `search_busy`; 502 `invalid_model_gateway_response`; 503 `space_lifecycle_unavailable`, `space_decision_unavailable`, `delegated_auth_unavailable`, `search_timeout`, `search_unavailable`. The audit's GET became POST so text and token stay out of URLs and logs (D-3).
- `GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/entries/{message_id}` -> `{data:{kind:"message",space_ref,thread_id,message_id}}`; 403 `space_read_not_authorized`, 404 `entry_not_found` (identical for hidden, missing, foreign). `GET /api/v1/spaces/features` -> `{data:{features:{message_search,entry_links,command_palette,room_pins,thread_fork}}}`. Pins: `PUT` and `DELETE /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/pins/{thread_id}` (editor or above; thread existence proven through a read decision).
- model-gateway: `POST /v1/spaces/:space_id/messages/search` and `.../resolve` (decision in body; org and user from claims; 404 `space_search_disabled`; error map InvalidArgument 400 `invalid_query`, PermissionDenied 403, NotFound 404 `entry_not_found`, ResourceExhausted 429, DeadlineExceeded 503). No ZDR refusal (reads), no cache, no event.
- Session Core `SpaceHistoryService`: `SearchMessages` steps in order: identity; `authorize_operation(session:read)`; refuse service principals; flag; validate (query 2 to 200 chars, limit clamp 1..50); `verify_thread_read_space_decision` (`Some` = shared, `None` = owner-only, `coverage="own_threads_only"`); revocation row check; semaphore of 8 and `statement_timeout 2500ms`; one SQL with Space equality on thread and message, audience ceiling on both, owner predicate when no decision, archived skipped, `zdr_waived` threads excluded (reported in `excluded`), keyset on `(created_at, id)`; snippets via `ts_headline` with a per-request nonce parsed into text segments (never HTML). Added by this plan: `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_revisions r WHERE r.message_id = m.id)` so edited or deleted originals under retain mode are never found (see Risks). Index expression must match the query expression character for character.
- Proto: new file `space_history.proto` (design requests; 04-sequencing 4.4 row 14 lists it), no `sessions.proto` tags taken by S1-S8. S9 adds repeated `space_grants = 16` on `SearchSpaceMessagesRequest` (own message, no collision). Migration 0077 (design 0048); fork migration dropped (consume (b)'s `thread_fork_lineage`, `ThreadSummary.forked_from_thread_id = 19`). Control: no migration for S1-S8; S9 adds `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/thread-read-decisions` `{space_refs:[<=25], idempotency_key}` (scope `spaces:issue`). Convex `spacePins {spaceRef, externalOrgId, threadId, pinnedByExternalAuthId, pinnedAt}`. Registry: no new action ids (palette runs only `risk low`, `requiresApproval false` entries; phase 1 is `spaces.mark_read`).

**Definition of done and evidence** (scenario M2-S6; repo rule: rebuilt images, running stack, verified flow)
1. Provision: effect policy with `--thread-read-entitled` (`bash "apps/Control Plane/scripts/set-space-effect-policy.sh" ...`); member B (editor) seeded; a scratch copy with 50,000 seeded messages.
2. Rebuild: user-core via `scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `cd "apps/Model Plane" && SPACE_MESSAGE_SEARCH_CORE=1 SPACE_MESSAGE_SEARCH_API=1 ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway`; gateway `docker compose up -d --build gateway`, restart Vite. Prove: `build-verevon-services.sh --status`, `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3185/health`, `psql`: `idx_messages_space_fts` in `\d+ messages`, `indisvalid` true, gRPC health lists `SpaceHistoryService` (`/healthz` proves nothing).
3. Flow: A posts "kvartalsbudsjett"; B presses Ctrl+F, types "kvartals" (prefix hit), Enter on the full word, opens the hit (URL `?thread_id=...&m=...#chat`, scroll, highlight, focus); `/spaces/<ref>/m/<id>` in a new tab redirects and highlights; `EXPLAIN` of the captured SQL uses the index; Cmd/Ctrl+K room switch, `Alt+2`, `?` sheet, `/read` posts nothing.
4. Negative: remove B, the next search and `/m/` open fail closed; org without `thread_read_entitled` shows the `own_threads_only` banner; a thread with a `zdr_waived` run returns no hit and `excluded` says why; a ZDR credential's search succeeds and leaves no row anywhere and zero grep matches for the unique word in gateway and model-gateway logs; a 100,000+ character message appends cleanly; an edited or deleted message (WS12) is not found.
5. Capture: SQL and `EXPLAIN` outputs, HAR (no token in any URL), screenshots, Playwright trace, p50/p95 on the 50,000-row copy (target p95 under 300 ms at `limit=20`, else trigger D-10 composite index), test summaries.

**Risks and mitigations**
- Index treated as an access boundary: authority is the signed decision plus SQL predicates, BFF asserts hit space, open re-authorizes; tests named above.
- Retain-mode revisions leave original text in `messages.content`, so the index would find deleted or edited-away text (touchpoint with WS12): S1 excludes any message that has a `message_revisions` row; fold-aware indexing is a later decision; (b)'s search clause covers its own population.
- Expression drift defeats the index: plan-shape test, one Rust constant for expression.
- `-- no-transaction` is unproven in the pinned sqlx (no migration uses it): prove in S1 on a scratch database; fallback is a one-off operator step plus a no-op marker migration; failed build leaves an INVALID index: `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_messages_space_fts;` then re-run.
- Query text reaches logs or caches: POST body, `no-store`, counts-only logging, grep check in evidence; never reuse `GW/domains/search.rs` caching (finding F-t2-003).
- Heavy queries degrade Session Core: 2.5 s timeout, 8 permits per replica, 100-hit cap, global rate limiter; per-route limiter if abuse shows.
- Hotspot files (`CoreNavbar.tsx`, `SpaceRoomComposer.tsx`, `grpc.rs`): edits are swaps and registration lines; logic in new files.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- Message index and recall (b F-t3-012, mp-WS17.S3): WS13 owns the Space index (`space_id IS NOT NULL`) and `SpaceHistoryService`; (b) owns the personal index (`IS NULL`, its 0055) and the recall tool; two partial GINs share one `build_tsquery` and snippet module (first lander creates it); agent recall stays owner-scoped (C10, X05).
- Fork and message tree (X06, F-t3-012): owner is (b) (one `ForkThread` RPC, `thread_fork_lineage` 0059); WS13-S10 adds only the member-decision wrapper and UI.
- `messages` semantics (WS01 `post_kind`, WS12 revisions): index covers `user`/`assistant` rows; `post` rows indexed; revised and deleted originals excluded. History floor (WS04-S11 `audience_window`): applied at the single SQL site when the helper exists. Notification refs (WS11) carry `SpaceEntityRef`, not hrefs; link chips (WS07) use `parseSpaceEntityLocation`; WS16 registers `org.switch.*` into the command registry; WS13 owns `FV/src/features/command/` (b F-t3-077 consumes). Gateway cache and ZDR hole (a F-t2-003): no shared code with `search.rs`.

2. Threads with a ZDR-waived run: excluded (default, as Dreaming) or findable?
3. Accept GET to POST for search, `Alt+1..9` instead of Ctrl/Cmd+1..9, `simple` text config and the 100,000-character and 100-hit horizons?
4. Do room pins replace the author-only pin or sit beside it, and may viewers pin (D-4)?
5. Ship "All my rooms" now (S9, D-5) or defer; who owns `ForkThread` (X06 says b)?

A second grant writer exists: gRPC `DocumentAccessService.GrantDocumentAccess` (`UC/internal/grpc/service_auth.go`, `UC/internal/handlers/document_acl.go`).
- Control issues import decisions for personal Spaces only (`UC/internal/spaces/personal_import_decision.go`; `import_write_entitled` is per org, `UC/migrations/020_space_import_effect_policy.up.sql`); `UC/internal/spaces/entitlement_catalog.go` does not exist yet (WS03-S1). **API, proto, data model and migrations**
- R1 `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/files` (multipart `files` 1..10, header `Idempotency-Key` 8-128 chars) -> 202 `{data:{upload_id,deduplicated,files:[{file_name,status:"queued"}]}}`, 200 when deduplicated. R2 `GET .../files/uploads/{upload_id}` (uploader only; status queued/running/completed/completed_with_errors/failed, items with `document_id?`, `error_code?`). R3 `GET .../files?limit&cursor` -> `{data:{files:[{document_id,file_name,mime_type,size_bytes,sha256,extension,status,text_chars,uploaded_by,uploaded_at}],next_cursor,unavailable:[]}}`. R4 `GET .../files/{document_id}/text?max_chars` (default 100,000, `no-store`, text only, no download). R5 `DELETE .../files/{document_id}` (uploader, 204, 404 `file_not_found` also for no access). R6 `GET .../context` adds `features.room_files{turn_attachments,durable,files_tab}` and `limits.room_files{max_files,max_file_bytes,max_request_bytes,allowed_extensions,turn_inline_chars:60000,turn_total_chars:120000}`.
- Typed refusals (envelope `{error:{code,message,details}}`, mirrored in `errors.ts` in Norwegian and English): `room_file_empty` 400, `room_file_too_large` 413 (`max_bytes`), `room_file_count_exceeded` 400, `room_file_type_unsupported` 415 (`allowed[]`), `room_file_no_extractable_text` 422 (scanned PDF until the shared OCR router, F-t2-037), `room_file_text_too_long` 413 (5,242,880), `room_file_duplicate` 409 (`document_id`), `room_files_quota_exceeded` 409, `space_files_not_authorized` 403 (`reason_code`), `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden` 412 with no `feature` field (`Refusal::DURABLE_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` is feature-less, `zdr_refusal.rs:190-196`; the room-file context is a gateway-local `details.surface:"room_files"` outside the catalogue; a catalogue feature label `room_files` would need WS06 to regenerate `zdr-refusals.json` and its sha, then `zdr_feature_not_supported`), `room_files_disabled` 404, `upload_requires_multipart` 422 (JSON action dispatch).
- Control: `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/import-decision` `{space_ref, source_type, idempotency_key}` (scope `spaces:issue`; same action id `ingestion.import.write`, schema `sha256:ingestion-import-v1`, same digest function, so imports-core, documents-api and the Go/Python/Rust verifiers need no change; 403 `code` in role_insufficient, import_entitlement_inactive, zdr_forbids_durable_import, source_type_not_allowed, audience_unresolved); `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/file-grant` `{decision_token, document_id}` (scope `spaces:file-grant:write`, principal `documents-api`) -> 200 `{data:{grant_id,created}}`; `GET /api/v1/internal/authz/space-visible?org_id&subject_id&resource_type=document&space_ref` -> `{ids,space_ref,audience_revision}`; owner-asserted `POST/DELETE /api/v1/internal/authz/grant` and `GET .../grants` (delegation v2, `zdr=true`, user proof, `delegation_operation` in authz:grant, authz:revoke, authz:grants, `service_id == OwnerService(resource_type)`, `granted_by` from the delegated user; 400 `role_not_supported`, `subject_type_not_supported`). documents-api R12: `GET/POST /v1/documents/{id}/shares`, `DELETE /v1/documents/{id}/shares/{subject_id}`, `GET /v1/documents/shared-with-me` (404 not owner, 400 `role_not_supported`, 409 `self_share`, 200-grant cap). imports-core `POST /api/v1/import/jobs/space-upload`; retrieval-engine `POST /v1/knowledge/space-sources` gains `types`, `cursor`, provenance; new `POST /v1/knowledge/space-document`; both paths join `space_decision_is_enforced_for_path`.
- Data model: a room file is a `documents` row `type='space_upload'`, `space_ref=S`, `owner_id` = uploader, `visibility='shared'`, extracted text at most 5 MiB, metadata `filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, extension, parser, text_chars, created_by_kind:'human', upload_id, scan_state:'not_scanned_text_only'`; no new table, no original bytes. Audience = owner plus a `resource_grants` row `(document, id, 'space', S, 'view')`, honoured only inside a Space read carrying a verified retrieval decision for a current member and recipient (intersection rule: Space decision AND current membership/audience AND the owner's grant; service principals never get Space grants). Limits: `SPACE_UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES=pdf,docx,xlsx,pptx,txt,md,csv,json`, `SPACE_UPLOAD_MAX_FILES=10`, `SPACE_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_MB=25`, room `SPACE_FILES_MAX_PER_ROOM=500`, `SPACE_FILES_MAX_TEXT_BYTES_PER_ROOM=209715200`.
- Migrations (04-sequencing 4.6.B): user-core `043_resource_grants_space_subject.up.sql` (design said 039); imports-core `005_space_upload_idempotency.sql` (unique index `uq_import_jobs_space_upload_idem`, `create_job` returns the existing job); Data `uq_documents_space_file_sha256` with a merge-time timestamp. No proto changes (Space import contract is HTTP). Registry: `space.files.attach` (owner plane `ingestion`, human-only multipart), `space.files.list`, `space.files.read_text`, `space.files.delete` (reversible false); `ownership.share_document` and `ownership.revoke_document_share` change owner plane to `data` and stay out of `MODEL_EXECUTABLE_ACTION_IDS` (negative assertion in `catalog-manifest.test.ts`).

**Flags and rollout**

| Flag | Owner | Default | Kill switch | ZDR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CONTROL_SPACE_SHARED_IMPORT`, `CONTROL_OWNER_ASSERTED_GRANTS`, `CONTROL_SPACE_SUBJECT_GRANTS` | user-core env | off in production, on in dev | 0 and restart (fence as today; R9/R10 404) | policy bit and `zero_data_retention` refuse |
| `DOCUMENTS_SPACE_FILES`, `DOCUMENTS_SHARE_WRITES`, `RETRIEVAL_SPACE_GRANTS`, `IMPORTS_SPACE_UPLOAD` | per-service env, compose `${VAR:-false}` | off in production, on in dev override | 0 per service; existing rows stay readable | imports-core 409, documents-api `persistentZDRReason` |
| `space_room_files_api`, `space_turn_attachments_ui`, `space_room_files_ui` | gateway `space_features` | off in production | gateway restart, no SPA rebuild | typed 412 before any Control call (`request_zdr` or `org_zdr_enabled`, fails closed on org-core error) |

Rollout order: S1, S2, S5, S6 (flags off) -> S3 -> S4 (re-point the `ownership.*` actions first, then flip `CONTROL_OWNER_ASSERTED_GRANTS`, never the reverse) -> S7 -> dev flags on -> S8 -> S9 -> staging with two members -> production per org. Rollback leaves files and grants in place. ZDR orgs get no durable files, only ephemeral text extraction and typed refusals.

2. Provision: `CONTROL_SPACE_POLICY_TOKEN=... bash "apps/Control Plane/scripts/set-space-effect-policy.sh" ... --thread-create-entitled --retrieval-read-entitled --import-write-entitled`; second member B seeded.

Flow: A uploads `brief.docx` and `data.csv` (R1 202, R2 `completed`); SQL shows `documents` rows `owner_id`=A, `visibility='shared'`, `space_ref`, `type='space_upload'` and `resource_grants` rows `subject_type='space'`; B lists and previews; non-member and removed member get 403 or an empty list; same `Idempotency-Key` replays `deduplicated:true`; identical file is `room_file_duplicate`; 10 MiB passes, 30 MB is `room_file_too_large`; scanned PDF is `room_file_no_extractable_text`; A deletes and B's list empties and the grant row is gone; ZDR org gets typed 412 and no Control call in the user-core log. Phase 1: paste long text and drop a PDF, the turn carries the labelled fence and the timeline shows chips; an image on a ZDR turn shows the typed refusal.
5. F-t1-057: owner A shares a document with C through the dialog (grant row, C sees it); C cannot share A's document (404); `isModelExecutableAction('ownership.share_document')` is false (unit test); `role:"edit"` returns `role_not_supported`; the gateway principal calling `/authz/grant` directly gets 403.

**Risks and mitigations**
- Un-fencing grants before the actions are re-pointed lets any signed-in user write a grant for a document they do not own (no owner check in `shares.rs`): rollout order fixes S4 before the Control flag; test that the gateway principal cannot reach the write and that the share actions are not model-executable.
- `owner_id` change surprises existing connector imports (D-3): no backfill; rule pinned to `space_upload` plus personal connector decisions; DoD step 1 confirms scope.
- Owner-asserted mode trusts documents-api's owner check (decision SD-30; option B would re-verify through a read call): one registry entry per type, only the registered service passes (test), audit row per grant with `granted_by`.
- Stale grant after delete or erase: delete revokes; Space deletion revokes by subject; the grant is inert without the document.
- Extra Control round trip for `space-visible`: one call per Space read, 3 s timeout, fails closed to owner-only, no cache by design.
- Zip, parser and storage abuse: existing zip budget and deadline, 25 MB, 10 files, room quotas, rate limit per user, scan seam for E1. Prompt injection through attachment text: labelled fence, size caps, WS01 post kinds keep member posts out of context.
- Dirty `retrieval-engine-rs` and composer files: new code in `visibility.rs`, `files.rs`, `room-attachments.ts`; M files edited at call sites only; S5 blocked until the owner commits the residue. Migration collisions: only numbers from 04-sequencing 4.6.

T6 ZDR typed refusal and telemetry (WS06; routes log ids, codes, counts only). WS07 viewer registry takes `room_file_text`; Control credential changes ride the `P-CFG` train (X29).

**Verified starting point**
- The room composer keeps its draft in a bare `createSignal('')`, clears it at send start and never restores it on failure; the textarea is `rows={2}` and disabled while submitting (`FV/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceRoomComposer.tsx:147,376-402,387,745-746` [M], diff is one ZDR line). It imports only `cancelInvocation` and `streamChat`, never `queueInvocationInput` (`FV/src/shared/api/chat-client.ts` [M]).
- Human turns render as plain `<p class="verevon-room-turn__plain">`; only assistant turns use `ChatMarkdown` (`SpaceRoomTimeline.tsx:329-336` [C]; `ChatMarkdown` exported from `FV/src/features/chat/components/ChatMessages.tsx:1086` [M]).
- `normalizeTranscriptTurns` keeps the first 30 turns (`MAX_TURNS_PER_POST = 30` at `SpaceRoomTimeline.tsx:50`, `break` at `:73`), silently dropping the newest turns of a long post, and the transcript route returns the whole conversation with no limit (`GW/domains/spaces.rs:2686-2693`, `MG/src/http_routes.rs:8470-8530` [M]).
- Posts beyond the newest 80 are unreachable (`SpaceThreadsQuery` `GW/domains/spaces.rs:951`, default 80, clamp 200; `ListThreadsRequest` has no cursor); the sort key is derived at read time through three lateral joins (`SC/src/grpc.rs:5562-5582` [M]); `messages.sequence` is a global identity column, which makes it a unique keyset key per thread tail. The only production message writer is `append_message_in_tx` (`:2432`, INSERT `:2571`), so a trigger covers every writer.
- No `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset`, `content-visibility` or `IntersectionObserver` exists under `features/spaces` (the verdict's "keep aria-setsize" is wrong); the poll is `setInterval(refetchThreads, 6000)` (`FV/src/features/spaces/components/SpacePage.tsx:101,293-297` [C]); the chat controller has the only anchoring precedent (`use-chat-controller.ts:1954-1967` [M]). Which element scrolls at runtime is UNVERIFIED (no browser run).
- Home has the draft machinery: `useHomeDraft` (`FV/src/features/dashboard/home/home-draft.ts:43` [C]; 400 ms debounce, ZDR gate via `isLocalRetentionAllowed`, key `verevon.home-draft.v1:{org}:{user}`, `HOME_DRAFT_MAX_CHARS` 20,000) and a prefix purge on sign-out and ZDR verdict; paste chips live in `DashboardComposer.tsx` (`PASTE_TEXT_ATTACHMENT_THRESHOLD` `:608`, `pastedTextAttachmentFile` `:835` [M]), not `home-draft.ts` (card mis-cited).

Control publishes `aqencia.controlplane.space.membership_changed` (`UC/internal/nats/shared_publisher.go:196-212`), consumed by Session Core only; Convex owns bindings (`CX/convex/schema.ts:606` `spaceAgentBindings`, mutations `spaceAgents.ts:412,529,596`) and none records a change event.
- Corrections: Convex `messages` (`schema.ts:144`) is chat projection, not room posts (the F-t1-052 verdict cites the wrong range); queue and steer is a wiring gap on an existing Space-aware route and WS09 owns it; pinned posts older than the newest 80 do show today (server sorts pinned first), so the window design keeps a pinned shelf.

**API, proto, data model and migrations**
- R1 `GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/timeline?limit=50&before=<cursor>&after=<cursor>&refresh=<id,id>` -> 200 `{data:{space,membership (first page),threads[] ascending,pinned[],system_entries[],page:{windowed:true,limit,has_more,next_before,newest,total_posts},refreshed[],read_marker,unavailable[]}}`; flow: flag, `authorized_org_id`, `space_lifecycle_by_ref`, Control membership, fresh `shared_thread_read_decision` per page (`None` = 403), model-gateway, `thread_items_match_space`. Errors 400 `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit`, `invalid_refresh`; 403 `active_membership_required`, `space_read_not_authorized`; 404 `space_not_found`, `space_timeline_disabled`; 502 `invalid_model_gateway_response`; 503 `space_lifecycle_unavailable`, `delegated_auth_unavailable`, `space_timeline_unavailable`. Cursor `base64url("v1|" + sequence)`, carries no authority. Legacy fallback (flag off or `summary_backfill_pending`): legacy listing shaped `{threads, page:{windowed:false,has_more:false}}`.
- R2 existing `GET .../threads/{thread_id}/transcript?tail=12&before_sequence=<n>&include_first=1` gains additive window params (design names; proto side adopts (b)'s `limit` and `before_message_id`, see below) and `data.transcript.window{omitted_before,has_more_before,first_sequence}`; 400 `invalid_window`. R3 `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/link-previews` `{url}` (editor or above, ZDR typed 412, SSRF pre-check, 20 per minute per user; snapshot kept in the BFF cache 900 s under `link-preview:{org}:{user}:{preview_id}`); errors 400 `invalid_url`, 422 `preview_blocked`/`preview_unreachable`, 429 `preview_rate_limited`, 404 `space_link_previews_disabled`. R4: WS01 post routes gain `preview_ids` (at most 3); the BFF builds `entry` itself, a miss is 400 `preview_expired`. R5 `GET .../context` adds `features.{composer_drafts,composer_markdown,human_markdown,timeline_anchor,timeline_windows,system_entries,link_previews}` and `limits.tail_window_turns:12`.
- Control: `GET /api/v1/internal/spaces/{space_ref}/membership-events?after&before&limit` -> `{data:{events:[{event_id,space_seq,action,actor_kind,actor_id,subject_type,subject_id,from_role,to_role,created_at}],truncated}}`, actions the closed WS04 set, history floor applied when WS04-S11 is on; no new decision type or migration. Convex `spaceRoomNotices {noticeId, spaceRef, externalOrgId, kind (agent_bound, agent_paused, agent_resumed, agent_revoked, room_renamed, topic_changed), actorExternalAuthId?, subjectId?, createdAt}` index `by_space_and_created`, query `spaces:roomNoticesForGateway`; ids and kinds only.
- Session Core `0078_thread_activity_summary.sql` (design said 0049): `threads` gains `last_message_seq`, `last_activity_at`, `turn_count`, `last_role`, `last_author_subject_id`, `recent_author_subject_ids TEXT[]` (at most 5), `activity_max_audience_revision`; AFTER INSERT trigger on `messages` updates the summary inside the appender's transaction (on the row it already holds `FOR UPDATE`); backfill runs outside the migration and `ListSpaceTimeline` refuses with `failed_precondition("summary_backfill_pending")` until no `last_message_seq IS NULL` row with messages remains. Eligibility per reader: `COALESCE(activity_max_audience_revision, recipient_audience_revision, 0) <= ceiling` (fail closed). Window query orders by `last_message_seq DESC` on `idx_threads_space_activity` (a test asserts the plan), plus `pinned` (first page, at most 10), `refreshed` (at most 30 caller ids, Space-scoped), `total_posts`.
- Proto tags (04-sequencing 4.6.C): `ThreadSummary` `last_message_seq = 25`, `recent_author_subject_ids = 26`, `last_role = 27`, `turn_count = 28` (design said 20-23); `SessionMessage` `entry = 14`, `sequence = 12` (drop if message-id paging suffices); `AppendMessageRequest` `entry = 21`; `MessageEntry{kind, version, link_previews}` and `LinkPreview{url, final_url, host, title, description, site_name, fetched_at}` in `sessions.proto`; `ListConversationRequest`: adopt (b)'s `limit = 6`, `before_message_id = 7`, response `has_more = 2` and Space `omitted_before = 3` instead of the design's `tail_limit`, `before_sequence`, `has_more_before`; `include_first` (first visible row prepended) has no reserved tag, so propose `ListConversationRequest.include_first = 11` and let the sequencer confirm (UNVERIFIED). `ListSpaceTimelineRequest/Response` in `space_room.proto` (binding, 4.4.1 row 14); the RPC lives there while the message-field additions (`ThreadSummary`, `SessionMessage`) stay in `sessions.proto`; service `SpaceRoomReadService` created by P-SC1. Entry rules: human post (`post_kind = 'post'`) only, `kind` = `link_previews`, `version == 1`, at most 3, http(s) URLs of at most 2048 bytes without userinfo, `host` recomputed from `final_url`, title 200 / description 400 / site 80 characters, stored in `messages.metadata.entry` (no migration), unknown future `kind` returned as `{kind, version}`.
- Registry: `spaces.preview_link` (owner plane `ingestion`, risk low, `requiresApproval:false`, input `{spaceRef, url}`) with a negative assertion in `catalog-manifest.test.ts`; reads (timeline, transcript window) are routes, not actions. Preview fetch contract (sibling a, unscheduled): `POST {QUARRY_EDGE_URL}/v1/preview` scope `preview:read`, static fetch, 5 s, 256 KB, at most 3 redirects, robots honoured; interim `/v1/scrape` without render hints, title and description only, no images.

**Definition of done and evidence** (scenario M2-S8; repo rule: rebuilt images, running stack, verified flow)
1. Provision as WS01 step 1 (`--thread-create-entitled --thread-read-entitled`), second member B seeded.
2. Rebuild: user-core via `scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `cd "apps/Model Plane" && SPACE_TIMELINE_CORE=1 SPACE_TIMELINE_API=1 ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway`; gateway `docker compose up -d --build gateway`, restart Vite; `cd "apps/Application Plane" && docker compose up -d --build convex-core` for S12; prove with `build-verevon-services.sh --status`, `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3185/health`, `psql` (`\d threads` shows the seven columns, `\d messages` shows trigger `messages_thread_activity`); `/healthz` proves nothing.

As B: first paint shows 50 posts and "Load earlier"; one timeline and at most four transcript requests; scrolling up pages by keyset; position does not jump when A posts; "N new" pill only when scrolled up; DOM posts under 450; a 200-turn post shows the first turn, last 12 and "188 earlier turns". `?before=garbage` gives 400, a removed member 403, flag off 404 (legacy list renders).
4. Composer: drafts restored per scope after navigation and reload; gateway stopped, send keeps text and Retry works; success clears; sign-out empties keys under `verevon.home-draft.v1:`; ZDR org stores nothing; markdown post renders, a `javascript:` link renders as text.

Typed entries (when S10 is on): pasted https URL shows a chip, `SELECT metadata->'entry' FROM messages WHERE id=...` shows the snapshot, B sees the card with host; a private-IP URL gives 422 `preview_blocked` with no Quarry call; ZDR org gets typed 412 and `redis-cli --scan --pattern 'link-preview:*'` is empty. System rows (after WS04-S4): add B, change role, pause an agent give three rows on next refresh; ledger and `spaceRoomNotices` match; a `since_join` late joiner does not see earlier rows.
6. Capture: SQL outputs per step, `EXPLAIN` of the window query, HAR of one scroll-to-top session, screenshots, Playwright trace with the frame-time check, test summaries; dated note beside `FV/docs/SPACE_*`.

**Risks and mitigations**
- Trigger on `messages` slows appends or deadlocks: it updates a row the appender already holds `FOR UPDATE`; benchmark with and without; concurrent-append DB test.
- Backfill load on a large table: 500-row batches with sleep, resumable, window refuses until done, BFF degrades to legacy.
- Bump-on-reply ordering surprises paging users: keyset on tail sequence never skips, client dedupes by `thread_id`; D2 lets the owner choose creation order (changes the key in S5 and S6 only).
- Summary leaks counts to a lower audience ceiling: fail-closed `activity_max_audience_revision` predicate, fresh decision per page, DB test.
- One scroll root regresses the cockpit on narrow screens: S1 behind `features.timeline_anchor`, Playwright at 390 and 1280 px; Solid 2 RC reactivity traps in the store: two-phase `createEffect` pattern as `SpacePage.tsx:145-190`, spike before S8.
- Proto tag and migration collisions with WS01, WS02, WS07, WS08, WS10, WS11 and (b): only numbers from 04-sequencing 4.6; first lander defines shared fields; S6 needs the `include_first` tag confirmed.
- Preview spoofing or SSRF, and Quarry preview mode is another session's work: BFF cache indirection, host from URL, "Preview captured when sent" label, `safeHref`, SSRF pre-check, no images, rate limit; S10 stays conditional (X23). Ledger or notice source down: named gap in `unavailable`, never a failed timeline.

**Cross-session touchpoints**
- Session Core `messages` read and summary (b F-t3-012, F-t3-021; X03): WS15 owns the thread activity columns and the tail window; (b) owns the paging contract (`limit`, `before_message_id`, `has_more`), which WS15 adopts; one anchoring module `FV/src/shared/lib/scroll-anchor-policy.ts` created by whichever lands first (likely (b)).
- One composer and draft store (b F-t3-052; C14, X25): WS15 owns `useHomeDraft` scope and the composer shell, (b) adds context chips through a slot; queue and steer (b F-t3-016, WS09-S2): WS09-S2 owns the UI, WS15 only keeps the draft intact (C2).
- Link preview fetch (a F-t2-005/048/049; X23): (a) would own `/v1/preview`; no date, so S10 stays conditional; under ZDR no preview is fetched or stored. Typed entry and card registry (b F-t3-044): one `entry-registry.ts`, WS15 owns it and the fallback; WS09 run card, WS10 approval panel, WS14 `room_file` card register into it; WS18-S7 `space.thread.post_card` uses `MessageEntry`.
- WS11-S2 reads the activity summary (migration 0079 dropped if it serves); WS04 ledger (`space_membership_events`) and `history_mode` floor feed S11; WS02 later replaces the 6 s poll with a coalesced `store.refresh()`; ZDR-safe telemetry: routes log ids, counts and status only.

**Open questions** (blocking only)
1. Keep bump-on-reply order (assumed) or order by post creation with a reply count (D2; changes S5/S6 key)?
2. Drafts only in the browser tab (`sessionStorage`, assumed) or surviving tab close (`localStorage` with the same ZDR gate)?
3. Confirm the read-model for system rows (D1, S11/S12 wait) instead of server-signed system messages; show them to every member or only owners and managers?
4. Does sibling a schedule `/v1/preview` (otherwise S10 stays dark) and are text-only previews, at most three per post, acceptable?
5. Which tag does `include_first` take on `ListConversationRequest` (none reserved in 04-sequencing 4.6.C; proposal 11), or is "first turn plus tail" dropped in favour of title and preview only?

### 3.E: Wave 3 priority items: personal agents and memory, agent self-API, room canvas, room-scoped agent browser

- Delivers the "colleague" half of the goal: memory that cannot leak between a person and a room (WS17) and personal agents that a room can admit under owner-derived authority; a governed registry through which a room agent may act on its own thread (WS18); a shared, revisioned room document that people and agents co-author (WS19); and a room-bound browser run with a card, evidence, hand-off and take-over (WS20).
- Ship order (04-sequencing): WS17-S1/S2 ship in M1 (memory containment must precede any room agentic run and sibling (b)'s `GATEWAY_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED`). M3.1 then runs WS17-S3..S9, WS18-S1..S7 (+S4a, S10) and WS19-S1..S9 in parallel lanes (G6 closed first: SD-03, SD-04, SD-22); WS17-S3 labels are ON before any personal agent is admitted to a shared room. M3.2 is WS20-S1..S9 (longest chain, gated by sibling (a) deliveries E6 and E7 and by SD-23). Conditional and not in any exit gate: WS18-S8, WS18-S9, WS19-S10.
- All four assume ADR 2 (ids and kinds only on any wire), ADR 3 option A and ADR 4 option A (WS17), ADR 5 (re-resolve authority per hop, the invoker is the delegating human), ADR 6 (Model proposes, Quarry executes) and SD-12 (ZDR orgs get typed refusals, no durable feature). Effort (engineer-weeks): WS17 17.8-25.7, WS18 11.5-17.5 (+5.0-7.0 conditional), WS19 11.0-17.0 (+1.5-2.0 conditional), WS20 19.8-28.7.

#### WS17 Personal agents and audience-safe agent memory

- **Resolves**: F-t1-012 audience-safe agent context and memory (Priority, Partial, L, W3, High, delivered here as containment, labels, declassify, per-turn opt-in) and F-t1-011 personal agents, access list, add policy, private assistant (Priority, Partial, XL, W3, High). Left out: per-chunk and tool-result source labels and taint (epic E1), whole-audience Data Plane entitlement (D-8, needs WS14), per-room knowledge list (E2), Letta semantic partition (D-9), binding trigger/tool/approval editors (WS08, WS10), group principals, per-binding model and language, the agent's own PC and browser (WS20). **Owner plane and service**: Model (session-core memory, resolver), Control (user-core registry, admission, decisions), Application (convex-core agents), Frontend (gateway, SPA); Go letta-bridge hardening. **Lane and milestone**: S1 L1 M1; S2 L1 M1; S3 L1, S4 L4, S5 L6, S6 L8, S7 L1, S8 L1, S9 L4, all M3.1. **Depends on**: S1 P-SC1; S3 S1 and ADR 3 (SD-03; S1/S2 can start without it); S4 P-UC1, WS04-S4 (c, cascade B only; the sweeper covers cascade A alone), ADR 4 (SD-04), SD-13, soft WS03-S2; S5 P-CX1, S4 (c), WS01-S5 (c); S6 S5, WS01-S6, WS01-S7a, P-SPA1; S7 S3, WS01-S5 (c), soft WS03-S1 (ordering rule D4: WS03-S1 merges first); S8 S3, S7; S9 S1, P-UC1, soft WS14-S5. Scope rule: WS17 never widens an owner-plane ACL; a personal agent in a room borrows nothing from its owner (invoker authority intersected with binding and audience).
- **Verified starting point**:
  - Write leak: `append_message_in_tx` `session-core/src/grpc.rs:2432` extracts candidates at `:2632-2635` from every thread not `source_scope='conversation'`, Space threads included, persisted under the thread owner (`dreaming.rs:760-806`); the Letta mirror follows in `sync_appended_memory` `grpc.rs:2685` [M].
  - Background leak: `dream_once` `dreaming.rs:197` skips only conversation-only threads (`skipped_conversation_scope` `:226`) and waived runs; `load_pending_messages` `:1263` loads Space messages [M].
  - Org-wide write from a room (not in the audit): `index_agent_memory` `dreaming.rs:1558` maps topics `USER`, `POLICY`, `AGENT`, `WORKSPACE` to user or tenant-wide `scope='org'` rows; a room turn calling `save_memory` writes memory every thread of the org later reads [M].
  - Read leak: `load_agent_memory_context_rows` `:1344` and `search_agent_memory` `:1443` apply no Space test; every caller (model-gateway prefetch `fetch_chat_memory_context` `sse.rs` ~:5191, `recall_memory` `tool_loop.rs:3142`, `model-gateway/src/grpc.rs:366`, execution-core `runtime_loop/mod.rs`) reaches the one session-core `MemoryService`, so one resolver there covers all. The Letta read path is thread-bounded; the leak is the write side (audit correction).
  - No label store: `agent_memory` (`migrations/0004_tasks_cron_hooks_skills_memory.sql` [C]) has no space or audience column; `threads` has `space_id` and audience stamps but no Space kind, so a personal-Space thread cannot be told from a room thread; Control's `Decision` (`decision.go:60-94`) carries no kind.
  - Agents: any room owner or manager can bind any org agent: `listInstallableSpaceAgentsForGateway` (`convex/spaceAgents.ts:486`), `bindExistingSpaceAgentForGateway` (`:529`) and `confirmSpaceAgentMembershipForGateway` (`:709`) trust the gateway; Control validates subject type and role only (`ReplaceMemberships` `user-core/internal/spaces/repository.go:646`); `agents.createdBy` is optional (`schema.ts:409`) and room creation does not set it; a personal Space refuses membership replacement. Binding policy (`triggerModes`, `allowedTools`, `approvalMode`, `schema.ts:628-632`) already exists and is enforced by `apply_mention_binding_policy` (`gateway spaces.rs:4500`); only the writers are missing.
  - `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/retrieval-decision` is registered (`http/server.go:361`) but absent from the `spaces:issue` case at `http/service_auth.go:114`, so it takes the generic default scope: a security defect adjacent to this item (D-10); the fix ships earlier as WS05-S3b (M1, List A) instead of waiting for M3.1.
