- **API, proto, data model and migrations**:
  - Resolver rule: contained thread = `threads.space_id IS NOT NULL AND space_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'personal'` (missing kind fails closed). Rule W (write): nothing said in a shared room is learned into personal or tenant memory. Rule R (read): a room turn recalls only this thread's rows, labelled room memory of this Space at or below the thread's audience revision, or an owner-signed declassification. Rules (flag on): C1 no extraction or `record_dream_run` in `append_message_in_tx`; C2 no Letta index (`DEGRADED_LETTA_SPACE_SUPPRESSED` beside `WAIVED_MEMORY_INDEX_SUPPRESSED`); C3 Dreaming writes `dream_runs` `skipped_space_scope` like `:226`; C4 `IndexMemory` topics `USER`, `POLICY`, `AGENT`, `WORKSPACE` refused `failed_precondition("memory_scope_contained: ...")`, other topics write a thread row; C5 reads return only `session_id = thread_id` rows and skip Letta; C6 no org-wide Data call or `memory_index` persist; C7 legacy rows whose `source_links` name a contained thread are excluded (same shape as the waiver exclusion `dreaming.rs:595-625`).
  - Rollout order of the claim: Rust reader first (`ControlSpaceDecisionClaims` gains `#[serde(default)] space_kind`), then Control sets it; the claim is in no payload digest (no golden change). 0073: `ALTER TABLE threads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS space_kind TEXT CHECK (space_kind IS NULL OR length(space_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 32);` (no value list: Control owns the kind enum and WS12's Control 041 adds `dm` and `group_dm`, K4-11; `dm` and `group_dm` threads are contained under the resolver rule, which is correct); no bulk backfill (D-2). Self-heal (K4-12): on every verified Control decision that carries `space_kind` (thread-append or thread-read), session-core runs `UPDATE threads SET space_kind = $claim WHERE id = $1 AND space_kind IS NULL`, so a legacy personal-Space thread is stamped by its next verified decision and learns again; S1 evidence reports the count of NULL-kind personal threads (row count UNVERIFIED).
  - 0081 (idempotent; constraints `NOT VALID` then `VALIDATE`): `ALTER TABLE agent_memory ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS origin_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal', space_ref TEXT, audience_hash TEXT, audience_revision BIGINT, scope_kind TEXT, scope_id TEXT;` checks `origin_kind IN ('personal','room','declassified','room_unverified')` and, unless `personal` or `room_unverified`, `space_ref`, `audience_hash` set and `audience_revision > 0`; index `agent_memory_space_idx (org_id, space_ref, scope) WHERE space_ref IS NOT NULL`; unique index `agent_memory_space_key_uq ON agent_memory (org_id, space_ref, key) WHERE scope = 'space'` and `agent_memory_org_scope_key_uq` (0011, arbiter `(org_id, scope, owner, key) WHERE session_id IS NULL`) recreated with `AND scope <> 'space'` so two Spaces of one org that write the same `key` do not hit the same arbiter row (K4-13; the two `ON CONFLICT` targets in `dreaming.rs` at `:1013` and `:1678` branch on scope; key derivation for room rows UNVERIFIED); legacy `UPDATE ... SET origin_kind='room_unverified', space_ref=t.space_id` for rows whose `source_links` contain `thread:<id>` or `session_id` of a contained thread (batch 1,000 rows via a startup task above about one million rows; row counts UNVERIFIED). `scope_kind` and `scope_id` follow sibling (b) K1-10; the value enum is ratified with (b) before S3 (open question). Room memory uses new `scope='space'` (`session_id NULL`, owner `''`). Visibility is one pure `memory_visible(row, ReaderScope)` plus its SQL twin, table-tested against each other; writes in a contained thread stamp labels from the thread's stored audience columns, never from the request.
  - 0083 `memory_declassifications(decision_ref PK, org_id, space_ref, source_memory_id, room_memory_id, subject_id, content_digest, audience_hash, audience_revision, created_at)` (hashes and ids only).
  - Control 044: `agent_subjects(org_id, agent_subject_id PK, owner_user_id, visibility 'owner'|'org', add_policy 'owner_only'|'nobody'|'anyone', lifecycle 'active'|'suspended'|'retired', revision, registered_by)` with checks (`agent-` id pattern, `visibility='owner'` needs an owner, `anyone` only for org-visible), unique `agent_subject_id`; `agent_subject_access(... principal_type='user', role 'manager'|'collaborator')`; `space_agent_admissions(space_ref, agent_subject_id PK, state 'admitted'|'withdrawn'|'suspended', revision)`; append-only `space_agent_admission_events`; backfill admits every existing `agent-*` service member as org-visible, `anyone`, no owner (no behaviour change, D-6). 045: `space_effect_policies` gains `personal_agent_admit_entitled`, `memory_declassify_entitled` (default FALSE), one `entitlement_catalog.go` row each (WS03-S1).
  - Pure `AdmitDenial(AgentAdmitFacts) string`, order and codes: `space_not_active`, `personal_space_not_supported`, `room_role_insufficient`, `agent_suspended`, `agent_not_visible` (mapped to 404), `add_policy_nobody`, `add_policy_owner_only`, `personal_agents_not_entitled`, `owner_not_in_room`. `ReplaceMemberships` skips unadmitted `agent-*` members (`SPACE_AGENT_ADMISSION` = `off` | `observe` | `enforce`; first release `observe`); withdrawal and cascade suspend admission and deactivate the service membership in one transaction; the sweeper suspends agents of owners no longer active in the org every 60 s; no auto-resume.
  - Control routes (gateway principal with verified delegation, actor and org from the delegation only; scopes `agents:manage`, `spaces:agents:manage`, table test pins every new path): `POST /api/v1/internal/agents/subjects` (201/200, 409 `agent_subject_conflict`, 422 `agent_policy_invalid`); `GET .../agents/subjects?mine=1` and `/:agent_subject_id` (404 `agent_not_found`); `PUT .../agents/subjects/:id/access` `{visibility, add_policy, entries[{principal_id, role}], expected_revision}` (403 `agent_access_forbidden`, 409 `agent_state_changed {current_revision}`, 422 `principal_not_in_org`); `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/:space_ref/agent-candidates` (<=200 ids, per id `{visible, can_add, reason}`); `POST .../agent-admissions` `{agent_subject_id, idempotency_key}` (201, 403 with a reason code, 409); `DELETE .../agent-admissions/:agent_subject_id` (403 `agent_withdraw_forbidden`). Registration order: Convex creates the definition `draft`, the gateway registers at Control (owner = verified actor), Convex activates; a Control failure leaves an unlisted draft and 503 `agent_registry_unavailable`.
  - Decisions (Ed25519, 2 minutes, issued only to an active editor, manager or owner who is a current recipient, entitled, non-ZDR): `model.memory.declassify` (schema `sha256:memory-declassify-v1`, permission `memory:declassify`, digest binds org, subject, space_ref, `source_memory_id`, `content_digest` of the reviewed text, audience ref, privacy ref, idempotency key); `model.memory.personal_context` (schema `sha256:memory-personal-context-v1`, permission `memory:personal_context`, binds thread id, one decision per turn). Routes `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/memory-declassify-decision` and `.../memory-personal-context-decision` (scope `spaces:issue`). Go and Rust assert one shared golden digest per schema.
  - Proto (additive, `memory.proto`): `MemoryEntry` 9 `origin_space_ref`, 10 `withheld_reason` (one closed vocabulary with (b)'s `hidden_reason`); `SearchMemoryRequest` 8 `personal_context_decision_token`, 9 `personal_context_decision_ref`; `rpc DeclassifyMemory({org_id, source_memory_id, space_id, reviewed_content <=1000, space_decision_token, space_decision_ref, idempotency_key}) -> {memory_id, deduplicated}` (source row must be `scope='user'`, owner = caller, `origin_kind='personal'`, no `space_membership_revocations` row for the Space (`0032`); one transaction inserts the `declassified` room row and the ledger row; the source row is untouched; event `MEMORY_DECLASSIFIED` ids only).
  - Gateway (typed envelopes, forged authority fields rejected, ZDR typed 412 before any Control call): `POST /api/v1/me/agents` `{name, instructions?, avatar_color?, client_request_id}` -> 201 (400 `invalid_agent_name`, 403 `active_membership_required`, 409 `agent_request_conflict`, 503 `agent_registry_unavailable`); `GET /api/v1/me/agents`; `GET` and `PUT /api/v1/agents/{agent_ref}/access` (403 `agent_access_forbidden`, 409 `agent_state_changed` with `details.current_revision`, 422); `PUT /api/v1/me/primary-agent`; `GET /api/v1/spaces/{ref}/agents/available` gains `add_state`, `reason`, `owner_label`; `POST .../agents/bind` runs Control admission first (403 `agent_not_addable`, 502 `agent_membership_unconfirmed`); `DELETE /api/v1/agents/{agent_ref}/rooms/{space_ref}`; `GET`/`POST /api/v1/spaces/{ref}/private-panel`; `POST /api/v1/spaces/{ref}/memory/declassify` `{memory_id, reviewed_content, client_request_id}` -> 201 (403 `memory_declassify_not_authorized`, 412 ZDR, 503 `zdr_decision_unavailable`, `space_decision_unavailable`); chat stream body flag `use_personal_memory:true` (S8).
  - Action registry (human-only, absent from `MODEL_EXECUTABLE_ACTION_IDS`, negative assertion in `catalog-manifest.test.ts`): `agents.create_personal`, `agents.update_access`, `agents.set_primary`, `spaces.withdraw_agent`, `spaces.open_private_panel`, `memory.declassify_to_space`; `spaces.bind_space_agent` (`action-registry.ts:2035`) extended. Private panel v1 is an owner thread with `sourceScope:'conversation'` (no memory in or out); share-to-room is a human post through WS01's thread route.

- **Definition of done and evidence**: the repo rule (rebuilt local images, a running stack, a verified end-to-end flow), run by someone who did not write the slice, scenarios `06` M1-S9 (containment, M1), M3-S1 (labels, admission), M3-S2 (admission and cascade), M3-S3 (declassify and revoke), M3-S8 (ZDR). Provision: `scripts/space-e2e-seed.sh` users A (owner), B (editor), plus a dev policy with `--thread-create-entitled --thread-read-entitled` and the new bits (script flags added in S7). Rebuild: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core`; `cd "apps/Model Plane" && ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway letta-bridge`; `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway`; `docker restart convex-gateway` and wait for "Convex functions ready!"; session-core `/healthz` is constant and proves nothing, so confirm migrations with `psql` (`\d threads` shows `space_kind`, `\d agent_memory` shows the labels).
  - Flow A (S1): in a room A says "I live in Bergen and prefer short answers", wait one `DREAMING_INTERVAL_SECS`: `agent_memory` unchanged, no Letta call in the bridge log, `dream_runs` `skipped_space_scope`, A's personal chat does not recall Bergen; "save this: WORKSPACE budget is 5M" is refused `memory_scope_contained`; a seeded personal memory never appears in a room turn (zero `memory_recall` frames).
  - Flow B (S2/S3): seed a leaked row with a `thread:<room>` source link before the migration, run 0081: the row is `room_unverified`, absent from every recall, shown withheld in A's list.
  - Flow C (S4-S6): A creates a personal agent; B (room manager) cannot see it in `agents/available`; A lists B as collaborator; B adds it: 403 `personal_agents_not_entitled` until the bit is set, then 201; admission and ledger rows exist; remove A from the room: admission `suspended` and the agent leaves the roster within the request; deprovision A in dev: the sweeper suspends all A's agents within 60 s; in `enforce` a direct `PUT /memberships` declaring an unadmitted agent returns it in `skipped_unadmitted`.
  - Flow D (S7/S8): A edits and confirms a memory share: room row `origin_kind='declassified'`; B's agent recalls it and no personal row of anyone; revoke B and recall stops; ZDR org: typed 412 and no row.
  - Capture: SQL per step, HAR of the new routes, ids-only log excerpts (bridge, session-core, model-gateway, user-core), screenshots (access dialog, blocked row, panel, share dialog, declassify dialog, withheld badge), Playwright trace, test summaries; a dated note beside `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/docs/SPACE_*`.
- **Risks and mitigations**:

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Containment makes room agents forgetful | thread-scope notes still work; room memory arrives in S3 and S7; withheld state and counters make over-filtering visible |
| `grpc.rs` is hot (817 uncommitted lines plus (b) +1,727) | logic in `space/memory_scope.rs`, call-site edits only; order with WS01, WS02, WS09, WS12 |
| Legacy backfill locks `agent_memory` | `NOT VALID` then `VALIDATE`, batch option, run off peak |
| Personal-agent instructions leak through answers | dialog and card state it; room recall only; open question 2 |
| Admission enforcement breaks existing rooms | backfill admits every existing agent, `observe` first, `would_skip` ledger |
| Personal Space threads lose memory flows (read as contained until stamped) | new threads carry the kind; legacy threads are stamped by the next verified Control decision (self-heal in S1, K4-12); D-2 |

| S8 needs call-site lines in `sse.rs` (listed in 4.4.1 row 16) and `tool_loop.rs` | forwarding helper in `space_sse.rs`; integrator approves the lines after rebasing on (b)'s train |
| Declassify or opt-in fooled by a model | human-only actions, reviewed text digest-bound, no model-eligible id |

- **Cross-session touchpoints**: memory containment (b F-t3-060 step 1, F-t3-020): one implementation, owned here (C13), (b) adds user controls on top and no second gate; label schema (C12): owned here, one migration; Letta mirror (C23, a F-t2-045 taint): session-core suppresses mirrors, taint is a second withhold reason through the same resolver hook; ZDR typed refusals (WS06, a, b): `Refusal::DURABLE_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`; agent registry vs (b) named agents: Control registry is the authority, no second registry; WS09 keeps raw `memory_recall` frames owner-private; telemetry counters by op and id only; `(a)` B13 memory promotion: declassify is the room-origin path.

#### WS18 Agent self-API on Space actions

- **Resolves**: F-t1-019 agent self-API on Space actions, run-bound grants (Priority, Partial, L (verification raised M to L), W3, High). Delivered: one registry of run-bound agent actions replacing the one-action hard-coding in Control, Capability Core and execution-core; Control `model-action-view-v2`; Phase 1 Session Core-owned tools on the run's own thread (`space.thread.rename`, `space.thread.pin`, `space.thread.post_card`); a `space_self_api` tool profile and a per-binding switch; Phase 2 `space.agent.pause_self` (conditional); Phase 3 `space.schedule.follow_up` (conditional, contract only). Left out: per-agent allow/ask/block editor and approval resume (WS10); canvas, directory and history-search tools register rows in this registry (WS19, WS04, WS13); membership, role, deletion, credential and policy actions are never registry rows. **Owner plane and service**: Model (session-core owner path, execution-core adapter, capability-core rows), Control (user-core registry and decisions), Application (Convex binding switch), Frontend (gateway, SPA). **Lane and milestone**: S1, S4a, S2, S4, S10 L3; S3, S7 L2; S5 L7; S6 L8; S8, S9 L4 (conditional); M3.1 (S8, S9 are M3, outside every exit gate). **Depends on**: S1 none (golden is design-and-fixture only; keep names compatible with (b)'s mp-WS24); S4a S1; S2 S1 and S4a (c); S3 S1; S4 S4a, S2, S3; S5 P-GW1, S4 (c); S6 P-SPA1, S5 (c); S7 S3, WS01-S1, S6 (c), WS15-S9 (c); S10 S4, S5 (c); S8 S4, WS08-S2 (c); S9 S4, WS10-S9. Conflict C6 (SD-15): the registry shape is Space's, but `spaces.*` rows are entries in (b)'s mp-WS24 S5-S8 framework (capability-core admission rows, per-run scoped tokens) and `runActionTarget` is extended once as a joint edit; if that framework has not landed at M3.1 entry, S2 and S4 land as designed and migrate rows later (open question 1). ADR 5 (SD-15 ratified) is assumed: the run owner is the delegating human; `tickets.create` stays byte-identical.

Reservations are tickets-only: migration `025_owner_effect_reservations.up.sql:13` has `CHECK (action_id = 'tickets.create')` [C]. The audit's `:340-347` "reservation" is the allowlist.
  - The model-facing catalogue is one fixed action end to end: Control view v1 (`model_action_view.go:19,109-110,142-143`), Capability Core `internal/api/model_action_view.go`, execution-core `capability_policy.rs:318,328-337` and `ticket_tools.rs:43-49`; the pinned hash `sha256:c3aa12ec...` lives in four places [C].

A run's owner equals its thread owner; the projection (`run_service_grpc.rs:302-345`) carries no agent identity; session-core has no `run-action-v1` verifier [M].
  - A Space assistant row is accepted only directly after a user row (`assistant_reply_slot_is_open` `grpc.rs:2131`): a mid-run card stored as an assistant row would make the final reply fail, so cards need a run-keyed slot rule.

  - `RunAgentRequest` ends at field 17 in the live tree (`execution.proto`); (b) takes 18-24, so Space uses 25. Application cannot receive a model-owned effect (no Ed25519 verification in convex-core). Prerequisite tree: the implementation base must contain the Model Plane Z-series (`model-plane` branch).

- **Risks and mitigations**:

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| The template pipeline is not live-proven; generalising hides defects | S1 pins `tickets.create` bytes with golden tests; S10 proves the generalised path live; promotion is a separate ledger step |
| Prompt injection steers rename, pin or post | plain, bounded, per-run capped text; never overrides a human title or pin; never touches membership, role, deletion, credentials; toggle and entitlement default off |
| A mid-run card breaks the final reply | `card_run_id` column plus slot rule with a named DB test |
| `agentic` exposes shell, browser and web tools | `tool_profile` offers only server-resolved tools; broadening waits for WS10 ceilings |
| Cross-language digest or hash drift | one Rust implementation; Go and TypeScript use golden vectors; no JSON in the digest |
| `deny_unknown_fields` breaks old executors | S4a first; response versioned additively |
| Hot files (`grpc.rs`, `agent.rs`, `mod.rs`, `sse.rs`) and 4.4.1 row 16 | new logic in `space/self_api.rs`, `space_self_api.rs`, `space_sse.rs`; `sse.rs` limited to one call-site line, integrator approves |
| (b)'s mp-WS24 framework lands differently | rows are data in the golden; adapt at M3.1 entry; `tickets.create` byte-identical |
| Convex Ed25519 unavailable in the default runtime | spike in S8 (`"use node"` fallback); Phase 2 is separable |

#### WS19 Room canvas

- **Resolves**: F-t1-015 room canvas, a shared revisioned Space document that humans and agents co-author (Priority, Absent, L raised to XL by the designer, W3, High). Delivered: one Markdown canvas per Space in Data Plane (new Space-owned tables in wiki-store, not `wiki_pages`); append-only versions stamped with a typed principal (user or agent) plus on-behalf-of and run id; head compare-and-swap inside the write transaction with a typed conflict; history, diff, restore; a Control `data.canvas.*` decision family with its own entitlement; gateway routes and two registered actions; a Canvas tab (view, edit, save, conflict banner, history, diff, restore); Space-deletion and org-erasure purge; agent `space.canvas.read` and `space.canvas.write` through the per-run Control decision (WS18 registry); ZDR refusal at every hop. Left out: live co-editing, comments, several canvases per Space, search or embedding of canvas text, promote-to-canvas from an artifact, pointer and unread projection (S10, conditional behind WS02 and WS11). **Owner plane and service**: Data (wiki-store-go, new tables), Control (user-core decision), Frontend (gateway BFF, SPA), Model (execution-core tools, S9). **Lane and milestone**: S1, S3, S8 L10; S2 L4; S4 L7; S5-S7 L8; S9 L3; all M3.1 (S10 conditional, M3). Canvas stays pilot-only until SD-08 (retention and erasure, ADR 8) is answered. **Depends on**: S1 none (can start in week 1; the Data migration needs no Control artifact); S2 P-UC1, WS03-S1 (ordering rule D4); S3 S1 and the S2 golden digest (c); S4 P-GW1, S3 (c), soft WS01-S5; S5 P-SPA1, S4 (c); S6 S5; S7 S6; S8 S1, S3; S9 S3 (c), S4 (c), WS18-S1 (c), and before default-on WS10-S5a and WS17-S1; S10 S3, WS02-S3 (c), WS11-S6 (c). Can start without: SD-08 (pilot only), D-1 option A assumed (C7: Data owns the canvas, thread artifacts stay Model-owned, promotion copies text).

Hence separate tables, no outbox, no event with content (audit correction 2).

- **API, proto, data model and migrations**:
  - Data tables (RLS `org_id = current_setting('app.current_org', true)` on both; app role has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on `space_canvases` and SELECT, INSERT only on versions, purge runs on the owner pool; no outbox, no NATS subject): `space_canvases(canvas_id PK, org_id, space_ref, state 'active'|'archived', head_version_id, head_version_no, created_by, created_at, updated_at)` with unique partial index `uq_space_canvases_active (org_id, space_ref) WHERE state='active'` (dropping it is the whole multi-canvas migration); `space_canvas_versions(version_id PK, canvas_id REFERENCES ON DELETE CASCADE, org_id, version_no, parent_version_id, content, content_sha256, content_bytes CHECK 0..65536, author_kind 'user'|'agent', author_id (user: subject; agent: `'run:'||run_id`), on_behalf_of, run_id, change_kind 'create'|'edit'|'restore', restored_from_version_id, summary <=200, decision_ref, authority_revision, audience_revision, idempotency_hash, created_at)` with `scv_agent_chk` (agent versions need `run_id` and `on_behalf_of`), `UNIQUE (canvas_id, version_no)`, `UNIQUE (canvas_id, idempotency_hash)`.
  - Limits (`internal/canvas/limits.go`): content 1-65,536 bytes valid UTF-8 without NUL; body 128 KiB via `http.MaxBytesReader`; list page max 50; 60 writes per hour per author per canvas (429 `canvas_rate_limited`) and 20 per agent run (429 `canvas_run_write_limit`).
  - `Save` (one transaction): lock the canvas row `FOR UPDATE` (per-room serialisation); no row with non-null expected id returns `head_moved` with `head:null`, else `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING`; idempotency lookup (same digest returns `deduplicated`, different digest `idempotency_key_conflict`); CAS `head_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_version_id` rolls back with head metadata only and stores nothing; equal `content_sha256` returns `unchanged`; rate limits; insert version then update head. `Restore` is the same transaction copying a version of this canvas with `change_kind='restore'`. Reads filter by `org_id`, `space_ref` and `canvas_id`, so a guessed foreign id is not found.
  - wiki-store routes (`mountCanvasRoutes`, behind `authctx.Middleware`, scopes `wiki.read` or `wiki.write`, D-7): `GET /v1/space-canvas/spaces/{space_ref}?known_version_id=` (200 head, or `{unchanged:true}` for the 15 s poll; 404 `canvas_not_found`); `GET .../versions?limit=&cursor=` (newest first, no content; 400 `invalid_cursor`); `GET .../versions/{version_id}` (404 `canvas_version_not_found`); `POST .../versions` `{expected_version_id|null, content, summary?, idempotency_key}` (201, 200 unchanged; 409 `canvas_head_moved` with `details.head`, 409 `idempotency_key_conflict`, 413 `canvas_too_large` with `details.max_bytes`, 400 `invalid_canvas_request`, 429); `POST .../versions/{version_id}/restore` `{expected_version_id, idempotency_key}`; `POST /v1/internal/space-canvas/purge` `{deletion_request_id, space_ref, idempotency_key}` (principal pin copied from `retrieval-engine-rs/src/api/mod.rs:1071-1100`, value UNVERIFIED until the Control bearer's mint site is found, first task of S8). Per-request checks in order: flag (404 `space_canvas_disabled`); bearer; token `zdr` true -> 403 `zdr_persistence_forbidden` on every canvas route (D-5); `X-Space-Decision` present and <=16 KiB (400 `space_decision_required`), envelope `v2.<kid>.<payload>.<sig>` or `run-action-v1.<...>`, Ed25519 over the key set (403 `space_decision_invalid`); claims: org, `space_ref` equals the path, `subject_id == claims.UserID`, `service_audience == "data-plane-canvas"` for human decisions, action and schema hash equal the route's, permission `canvas:read` or `canvas:write`, `zero_data_retention` false, audience and privacy refs and revisions non-empty (403 `space_decision_mismatch`); digest recomputed from the request (op, canvas id, expected version, restore source, `content_digest = sha256(content)` computed server-side, idempotency key) and claims, `sha256("data.space_canvas\x00v1\x00")` plus length-prefixed fields `org_id, user_id, space_id, space_decision_ref, recipient_audience_ref, recipient_audience_hash, privacy_policy_ref, resource_authorization_ref, action_schema_hash, idempotency_key, op, canvas_id, expected_version_id, restore_from_version_id, content_digest` and the two revisions as 8-byte big-endian (403 `space_decision_digest_mismatch`), the same function in Control and wiki-store with one golden hex; author stamping from the envelope type, never from the body. Responses use `{data}` and `{error:{code,message,details}}`.
  - Control: constants `canvasAudience = "data-plane-canvas"`, actions `data.canvas.read`, `data.canvas.write`, schemas `sha256:space-canvas-read-v1`, `sha256:space-canvas-write-v1`, permissions `canvas:read`, `canvas:write`; `Op` closed set `read|create|save|restore`; floor viewer to read, editor, manager, owner to write; kind allowlist `personal, room, project, case` (new kinds such as WS12 DMs default to no canvas, D-8); recipient audience required for shared kinds; `CanvasEntitled`; ZDR refused; WS04's archived-room rule (read variant accepts `active|archived`, write stays `active`). Route `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/canvas-decision` body `{space_ref, op, canvas_id?, expected_version_id?, restore_from_version_id?, content_digest?, idempotency_key}` (no actor, org, role, audience or privacy field) -> 200 `{data:{decision, token, space_kind}}`; 400 `canvas_decision_invalid`; 403 `Space canvas is not authorized` (WS03 adds `canvas_not_entitled`, `canvas_requires_editor`, `zdr_inert`); 503. Agent operations use `run-action-v1` with the same digest formula; effect-time authority check and reservations are not used (2-minute life, idempotency key and CAS give the same bounds for a reversible write).
  - Gateway (flag `SPACE_CANVAS_API`, 404 `space_canvas_disabled`; flow: `authorized_org_id`, `space_lifecycle_by_ref`, typed ZDR 412 `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden` before any Control call via `org_zdr_lookup` ([N] from `P-GW1`; 503 `zdr_decision_unavailable`), content hashed, Control decision with `idempotency_key = canvas-save-{client_save_id}` or `canvas-read-{nanos}`, `proxy_data_plane_json_with_space_decision` (`knowledge/shared.rs:118`) to `{wiki_store_url}/v1/space-canvas/spaces/{ref}...`; the decision token never reaches the browser; body structs `deny_unknown_fields`): `GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/canvas?known_version_id=` -> `{data:{canvas, head, can_write}}`, `{data:{canvas:null,head:null,can_write}}` when none (an empty room is a state), or `{unchanged:true,head_version_id}` (403 `active_membership_required`, `canvas_read_not_authorized`; 404; 412 ZDR; 503 `canvas_unavailable`, `space_decision_unavailable`, `delegated_auth_unavailable`); `POST .../canvas/versions` `{expected_version_id|null, content, summary?, client_save_id ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$}` -> 201 or 200 unchanged (400 `invalid_canvas_request`, 413 `canvas_too_large`, 403 `canvas_write_not_authorized`, 409 `canvas_head_moved` with `details.head` and `idempotency_key_conflict`, 412, 429, 503); `GET .../canvas/versions?limit=&cursor=`, `GET .../canvas/versions/{version_id}`, `POST .../canvas/versions/{version_id}/restore`. Actions `spaces.save_canvas` (inputs `{spaceRef, expectedVersionId, content, summary?, clientSaveId}`) and `spaces.restore_canvas_version` (`{spaceRef, versionId, expectedVersionId, clientSaveId}`): owner plane `data`, risk medium, reversible, `requiresApproval:false`, neither model-executable.
  - Agent tools (S9, execution-core): `space.canvas.read` `{}` (the room comes from the run) returns `{canvas:{canvas_id, head_version_id, head_version_no, updated_at, last_author_kind}, content, truncated:false}` or `{canvas:null}`; `space.canvas.write` `{expected_version_id|null, content <=65536, summary? <=200}` returns `{status:"saved",version_id,version_no}`, `{status:"unchanged"}` or `{status:"conflict",head:{version_id,version_no,author_kind,created_at}}` (no content: read, merge, retry once). Every read result is `TrustClass::RoomCanvas` (label `room-canvas`, framed as untrusted and screened); the canvas is never added to a prompt implicitly; write default posture `ask` until a Space tool policy (WS10-S5) allows it; tool results fall under WS17's memory label.
  - SPA: `lerret` tab (Lerret / Canvas, owner Data Plane, "Rommets delte dokument." / "The room's shared document."), states loading, unavailable with a named reason from the error code, empty (editor: Create canvas), view (`ChatMarkdown`, meta line "Version 12, saved by Ola, 14:02", agent versions as "Agent run, asked by Ola"), edit (plain `<textarea>`, byte counter, 64 KiB guard, `beforeunload` dirty guard, no localStorage draft), conflict banner (Load latest, Review differences, Save mine as the new version; a 409 makes the panel refetch the head because `ApiError` has no `details`, `src/shared/api/http.ts:19`); history with cursor pages of 50 and any-two-version diff; conditional poll every 15 s while the tab is active and the document visible; all strings via `i18n.tr(no, en)`.

ZDR: gateway refuses first (typed 412), Control refuses issuance (read and write), wiki-store refuses a ZDR token (403) and a ZDR claim in the decision, execution-core offers no tools; logs carry ids, sizes, version numbers, outcome codes only.

- **Risks and mitigations**:

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Room text reaches the org corpus or search | separate tables, no event, no index; a test asserts no `wiki_event_outbox` or `wiki_pages` row from any canvas call |
| Forged or replayed authority | signed decision verified in Data, bound to org, space, subject, op, expected head and content hash; 2-minute life; idempotency key |
| Agent overwrites a human edit | CAS, read-then-write tool contract, conflict result without content, every agent version restorable |
| Prompt injection through canvas text | `RoomCanvas` trust class, explicit reads only, no implicit context, write default `ask` |
| Version bloat | rate limits, 64 KiB cap, paginated history; thinning deferred to ADR 8 |
| Two version stores (C7) | D-1 ruling: Data owns the room canvas; promotion copies text through the normal save |
| wiki-store has no Control public key in compose | S3 adds the env and a startup refusal; the dev export exists in `build-verevon-services.sh` |
| DB tests never run in CI | new Postgres job in S1; the route auth matrix also runs in the unit gate |
| Pre-existing: any member can write generic wiki pages | out of scope, canvases unaffected by construction; reported to WS05 |
| Space deletion leaves canvases | S8 before production entitlement; pilot-only until the purge hop is verified |

- **Cross-session touchpoints**: run-action registry and per-run decision (C6, WS18, (b)): WS19 adds `space.canvas.read` and `space.canvas.write`, the `run-action-v1` envelope and `runClaimsMatchEvidence` unchanged; version store ruling (C7, (b) F-t3-031 artifact versions): Data owns the canvas, thread artifacts stay in model-gateway, promotion is a normal canvas save naming the artifact; untrusted trust class (sibling (b) Model Plane): new `TrustClass::RoomCanvas`, execution-core and `model-gateway/src/moderation.rs` copies kept in sync by hand; ZDR (WS06, (a), (b)): reuse `zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden` and `zdr_persistence_forbidden`, no new catalogue key; agent memory (WS17, (b) F-t3-060): `space.canvas.read` results are labelled with Space and audience and never extracted into user memory; Space deletion saga and realtime (WS04, WS02): Data purge leg now, a content-free `canvas` change kind in WS02's registry later; viewer registry (WS07-S10): canvas renders through `ChatMarkdown`, no new viewer.
- **Open questions** (blocking only): (1) SD-08 (ADR 8): retention and user-erasure of author ids; canvases stay pilot-only until answered; (2) D-3 agent write mode: direct CAS write with `ask` default (assumed) versus proposal queue versus read-only, decides S9; (3) where `DATA_SPACE_DELETION_URL` and its bearer are configured and which service identity Control uses to mint the Data deletion bearer (first task of S8); (4) who sets `canvas_entitled` in dev and pilot orgs before WS03-S1 (operator script, SD-18); (5) how documents-api receives the Control public key in compose (S3 copies the pattern).

#### WS20 Room-scoped agent browser

- **Resolves**: F-t1-020 room-scoped agent browser (Priority, Absent per audit but baseline wrong: takeover, per-action HITL and a challenge signal exist, L raised to XL by the designer, W3). Delivered: a person in a room starts a governed browser run bound to the room by a Control decision; the room gets a browser card (steps, hosts, evidence screenshots, control indicator), a typed hand-off request produced from Quarry's challenge signal, Take control and I'm done for the run starter, and a durable result turn; a manager and owner takeover and stop path (S9, dark). Left out: agent-initiated browsing from a room turn (needs WS10 tool policy and (b) F-t3-008, D-WS20-5), teach by demonstration, production broker grants and delegated bearer ((a) F-t2-001), Quarry-side takeover enforcement ((a) F-t2-013 phase 1), bot-block taxonomy ((a) F-t2-027). **Owner plane and service**: Model (model-gateway start and relay, execution-core steps, session-core read RPCs), Control (user-core decision), Ingestion (Quarry delegation and room-view routes, owned by sibling (a)), Frontend (gateway, SPA). **Lane and milestone**: S1 L4, S2 L3, S3 L3, S4 L2, S5 L8, S6 L3, S7 L2, S8 L8, S9 L4; all M3.2 (the longest chain of the plan: M0-BASE > P-UC1 > S1 > S2 > S3 > S4 > S5 > S8 > S9, 15.6/19.1/22.5 ew). **Depends on**: S1 P-UC1, WS03-S1 (ordering rule D4); S2 S1 (c); S3 S2, WS01-S1, WS09-S1; S4 S3, WS09-S4 (authority function, or built here and handed over); S5 WS01-S7a, P-SPA1, S3 (c), S4 (c), WS01-S5 (c); S6 S3, external gate E7; S7 S3, S4, S6, soft WS10-S1; S8 S5, S6, P-SPA1; S9 S6, S8, WS09-S7, WS09-S8, SD-23. External gates: E6 (sibling (a) F-t2-001 real grants: S2 and S3 build and test against a test-double broker, no real stack without it), E7 (Quarry room-view routes and `delegation`, nobody owns it today, 05 X16). Can start without: S1 (dark by entitlement default), S2 and S3 against the double.
- **Rulings that reshape the design (05 C1, SD-23, 04 4.6)**: (1) The client never sends a Space reference; `space_ref` comes from the route path, is checked against membership and lifecycle, and authority is a Control decision verified in model-gateway; the grant stays Space-free (C1): the design's `AcquireGrantRequest.space_authority`, `ValidateGrantResponse` 10-15 and the `space_ref` check on the grant are deleted, and the broker proto gets no Space field (`browser.proto` untouched, X15). (2) Execution-core's `space_id` check is against the durable run's `space_id`, not a grant field. (3) SD-23 v1: the room sees receipts-based evidence (host-only steps and evidence thumbnails); live frames go to the starter only; any editor may start once `browser_entitled`; limits 10 minutes, 2 runs per Space, 8 hosts; ship behind a dev flag until (a)'s grants exist. Observer frames and manager takeover (S6 observer branch, S9) are built dark behind `SPACE_BROWSER_VIEW_ROOM` and wait for the user to reverse Quarry's approved owner-only default. (4) Hand-off: the `HUMAN_ASSIST` kind (value 6) is the one kind shared with (b) mp-WS21.S9; if (b) lands it first S7 consumes it and adds only Space addressee routing and card copy.
- **Verified starting point**:
  - `BrowserRunStartRequest` has no Space field; `model-gateway/src/browser_run.rs` builds the step with `space_id: String::new()` (`:441`), calls `prepare_managed_run_authenticated` (`session_flow.rs:362`) with no Space context, and the terminal path writes no thread message (`terminalize_browser_agent_run_authenticated` `session_flow.rs:1203`), so a browser run leaves no durable result in any thread [M].
  - The grant is validation only: `resolve_browser_grant` (`browser_run.rs:138`) calls the broker `ValidateGrant`; the gateway still sends `grant_id: "session:{session_id}"` (`gateway domains/browser.rs:1235`), a string nothing accepts, so an AI run cannot pass validation in a real stack; broker store is in memory with a 15-minute TTL (`browser-broker/internal/server/server.go`, `internal/grant/grant.go`). Code reading only, not run live.
  - `ExecuteStepRequest.space_id` (field 11) exists and presence grants nothing; execution-core demands the delegated bearer for `browser_agent`, authorizes the run owner (`authorize_run` `grpc.rs:223`, `authorize_durable_run_owner` `:543`), blocks ZDR (`enforce_persistence_free_execution` defined `:664`, applied `:899`) and builds `ValidatedBrowserGrant` (`tool_bridge/mod.rs:36`, only `grant_id` and `allowed_domains`). The Quarry run is started under execution-core's service principal (`quarry_agent.rs:182` `StartRunRequest`), so its owner is the service id and its owner routes (`agent_routes.rs:484` `caller_owns_live_run`) reject the starter and every member [C].
  - Quarry's `/step` validates the broker grant on every action (`agent_routes.rs:314` `validate_run_grant`) and never reads `control_mode` (`RunEntry` `:79`); takeover is enforced only in the gateway. `classify_challenge` runs on every live observation (`quarry-runtime/src/observation.rs:158`, call `:903`) and is serialized, but execution-core's `WireObservation` (`quarry_agent.rs:219`) has no `challenge` field so serde drops it; the classifier matches substrings, flags `Login` on any page with a nav link, uses a constant confidence and never produces `Waf` or `Unknown`.
  - Per-action HITL is live: `gate_risky_action` (`browser_agent.rs:908`) and `require_approval` (`browser_events.rs:238`: approval `kind=DESTRUCTIVE`, polls every 500 ms, 1800 s budget, aborts on denial). `approvals.kind` is free `TEXT` (`0003_orchestration_tables.sql`), `ApprovalKind` has values 1-5 only (`orchestration.proto`). Browser events are durable in Session Core but readable only through an owner-gated replay that returns full URLs, rationale and selectors; the room has no safe read.
  - Control has no browser decision; `space_capability_decision.go` is a personal-Space sandbox-lease decision (pattern for signing and digests, not a shared-room template); `issueThreadAppendDecision` (`http/spaces.go:571`) is the shared-room pattern. model-gateway and browser-broker have no `CONTROL_SPACE_DECISION_*` env in compose today (it exists for session-core, orchestrator-core, capability-core, sandbox-manager and an execution-core scheduled-step key): the verifier needs that env added. Room agents are tool-less (`allowedTools: []`, `agentic` stripped), so v1 start is human-initiated.
  - SPA: the dashboard browser is the only UI (`features/dashboard/home/BrowserChrome.tsx`, `compact` prop, session view-model with `liveFrameWsUrl`, Norwegian chip text hard-coded); `features/spaces` has no browser code; `AuxPane` is created by WS01-S7a; actions `browser_run.start` (risk high, approval) and `browser_run.control` exist (`action-registry.ts:2981`, `:2992`). Typed ZDR refusals `feature_not_supported("browser_run")` and `("browser_run_control")` already exist (`browser_run.rs:311`, `:667`; `zdr_posture.rs` [U], `zdr_refusal.rs` [U]).

- **API, proto, data model and migrations**:
  - Control decision: action `model.space.browser_run`, schema `sha256:space-browser-run-v1`, permissions `["space:browser:run"]` plus `"space:browser:view_room"` only when `view_scope=room`; audience: the design's `model-plane-browser-broker` no longer fits (the broker no longer verifies), so the S1 golden sets the model-gateway audience string (suggested `model-plane-model-gateway`, UNVERIFIED naming). Role floor editor, manager, owner; requires `browser_entitled`; refused when `Privacy.ZeroDataRetention`; shared evidence via `ResolveSharedThreadDecisionEvidence` and `ValidateForSharedThread`; personal Space allowed with `view_scope` forced `owner`. Digest (length-prefixed, header `model.space.browser_run\0v1\0`): org, user, space, thread (empty for new), `goal_digest`, canonical `allowed_domains`, `profile_scope`, `view_scope`, `max_steps`, `max_runtime_s`, audience ref and hash, privacy ref, resource authorization ref, schema, idempotency key, five revisions via `writeDigestRevisions`; 2-minute life; one golden digest shared with the Rust verifier. Structural domain validation in Control (fail-fast, Quarry's SSRF guards remain the enforcement): 1-8 hosts, lowercase, no scheme or path, no IP literal, no `localhost`, no single-label host, no wildcard on a public suffix. Route `POST /api/v1/internal/spaces/browser-run-decision` `{space_ref, thread_id?, goal_digest, allowed_domains[], view_scope, max_steps, max_runtime_s, idempotency_key}` (no actor, org, role or audience) -> `{data:{decision, token, claims}}`; 400 `valid browser run intent required`, 403 `{"error":"Space browser run is not authorized"}` (legacy untyped body, mapped by the gateway). WS03 catalogue key `browser` (ZDR `zdr_inert`, preset `agent_computer`). S9: `model.browser.control` decision with `browser:control` permission and the run id in the digest.
  - R1 `POST /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/browser-runs` `{thread_id?, goal 1..2000, allowed_domains 1..8, start_url?, max_steps? 5..40 (default 20), max_runtime_s? 30..600 (default 300), max_cost_usd? <=1.00 (default 0.25), share_view (default false; true accepted only when `SPACE_BROWSER_VIEW_ROOM` is on, else 400 `browser_share_view_unavailable`), client_send_id}` -> 202 `{data:{run_id, thread_id, plan_id, view:{scope}, grant_expires_at}}`. Body `deny_unknown_fields`; any authority field (`FORGED_SPACE_AUTHORITY_FIELDS` plus `space_browser_authority`, `grant_id`, `profile_id`, `require_approval`) is a 400. Flow: ZDR lookup first (typed 412, 503 `zdr_decision_unavailable`), session, `authorized_org_id`, `space_lifecycle_by_ref`, Control decisions (thread create if needed, thread-append for the goal, browser-run) via `inject_personal_thread_context`, then model-gateway `POST /v1/browser/runs`. Errors: 400 `invalid_browser_run`, `browser_domain_policy_invalid`, `invalid_client_send_id`; 403 `active_membership_required`, `space_browser_not_authorized`; 404 `space_not_found`, `feature_unavailable`; 409 `thread_run_active`, `space_authority_stale` (re-minted once), `idempotency_key_conflict`; 412; 429 `browser_capacity`; 502 `browser_grant_unavailable`; 503 `space_decision_unavailable`, `delegated_auth_unavailable`. Idempotency: `client_send_id` -> Control key `space-browser-{id}`, model-gateway start key `browser-{id}` (a retry returns the existing run).
  - model-gateway handler order: `browser_run_zdr_blocked` (`browser_run.rs:631`), flag (404 `feature_unavailable`), verify the browser decision and compare the two decisions' `recipient_audience_revision` (409 `space_authority_stale`), per-Space cap of 2 active browser runs (Session Core count, 429 `browser_capacity`), obtain the run grant by calling the broker's gRPC `DeriveRunGrant {parent_grant_id (the user's session grant), session_key = run id, org_id, purpose = ai_run, allowed_domains (subset of the parent's), ttl_seconds = min(max_runtime_s + 60, 600), budget fields}` on `quarryv2-next` (`browser.proto:25`, `ttl_seconds = 6` at `:222`; `deriveTTL` clamps to `MaxGrantTTL`; `ErrDeriveWidensParent`; K4-28, the HTTP route `POST /v1/browser/grants` at `browser_grants.rs:49` takes `allowed_domains` only and cannot narrow or set a TTL), ephemeral profile (`profile_id`, `require_approval`, `zdr` rejected with `room_browser_profile_forbidden`); if (a) does not merge that branch the broker default of 15 minutes is the stated removal bound; the test double implements `DeriveRunGrant`, not the HTTP route; `prepare_managed_run_authenticated` with the Space context, execution step with `space_id`. Terminal: for Space runs append one assistant turn (plain text <=2,000 characters from `resp.output`, `metadata.browser_run={v:1, run_id, outcome, steps, hosts[<=8], evidence_ids[<=6], duration_s, handoffs}`, `provenance:"web"`, rendered as plain text without links), then revoke the grant.
  - Reads R2-R4 (Session Core projector, allowlist, field by field): R2 `GET .../browser-runs?thread_id=&limit=` -> `{data:[RoomBrowserRun{run_id, thread_id, started_by:{subject_id}, phase, started_at, finished_at?, hosts[<=8], step_count, control:{mode, holder_subject_id?}, handoff:{open, kind?, approval_id?, expires_at?}, view:{scope}}], meta:{next_cursor}}`; R3 `GET .../browser-runs/{run_id}/timeline?after=&limit<=200` -> events of kind `action|observation|paused|resumed|approval_required|approval_decided|handoff_requested|handoff_resolved|result` carrying host, action type, status, risk category, `evidence_id` only (model rationale, page titles, selectors, full URLs, `decided_by` dropped; unknown event types dropped); R4 `GET .../evidence/{evidence_id}` -> image bytes with `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox`, id must appear in this run's persisted observations (404 `evidence_not_found`, 413 above 4 MB). Authority: Control `model.thread.read` (needs `thread_read_entitled`), audience ceiling, revocation table, run is a browser run in this Space (identified by the managed source `gateway_browser`; the stored string is UNVERIFIED, first task of S4); foreign runs return 404 `run_not_found`; refused for ZDR.
  - R5 frames `GET .../browser-runs/{run_id}/frames/stream` (SSE) and `/frames/ws` through the model-gateway relay (heartbeat re-authorization every 15 s then `reauth_required` and close; 5 viewers per run, 1 controller; 2 fps card poll, 5 fps expanded, 1280x800 JPEG q55): v1 serves the starter only, observers get 403 `space_browser_view_not_shared`; with `SPACE_BROWSER_VIEW_ROOM` on (after SD-23), frames are withheld from observers while `control_mode = human_takeover` (`event: withheld {reason:"human_control"}`) unless the holder opts in per take-over. R6 `POST .../control` `{action: pause|resume|stop|take_control|give_back, idempotency_key}` -> `{data:{control:{mode, holder_subject_id, epoch}, phase}}` (v1 caller must be the starter; 403 `space_browser_control_not_authorized`, 409 `browser_human_takeover_active`, `browser_not_controlling`, 410 `run_finished`); pause, resume, stop use the existing `/v1/browser/runs/:id/control`, take and give use Quarry `POST /v1/agent/room-views/{run_ref}/control`. R7 `POST .../handoff/{approval_id}/resolve` `{outcome: done|cannot}` (lease back to the agent first, then `DecideApproval` GRANTED `handoff:done` or DENIED `handoff:cannot`; retry-safe; 404, 409 `handoff_closed`, 410 `handoff_expired`).
  - Quarry (sibling (a)): `POST /v1/agent/runs` accepts `delegation{run_ref (Session Core run id), initiator_subject, view_scope: owner|room}` only from a service principal holding `browser:execute` (user token: 400 `delegation_not_allowed`); `RunEntry` stores `initiator_subject`, `run_ref`, `view_scope`, `control_holder`, `control_epoch`; room-view routes `GET /v1/agent/room-views/{run_ref}` (projection), `/frame`, `/frames/stream`, `/frames/ws`, `POST .../control` require scope `browser:view` and header `x-verevon-acting-subject` (recorded in receipts); `step` rejects agent actions while `human_takeover` (`USER_TOOK_OVER`, (a) F-t2-013 phase 1); frames never persisted.
  - execution-core: hand-off policy (`browser_agent/handoff.rs`, room runs only): `captcha` always hands off; `login` only when the URL path or title is itself a sign-in page or the last action failed on it; `consent` never; `access_denied`, `rate_limit`, `waf`, `unknown` end the run `blocked_by_site` and are never retried (no bypass); at most 3 hand-offs per run; the constant confidence is ignored. `request_handoff` publishes `BrowserHandoffRequested{run_id, plan_id, approval_id, kind, host, expires_at}` and `CreateApproval{kind=HUMAN_ASSIST, reason=<closed code>, expires_in_seconds=900 (max 1800), idempotency_key="{run_id}:handoff:{n}"}`, then polls as today; the card text is a localized closed `kind` (never model-written). GRANTED re-observes with a fresh snapshot (no replay of human input to the model); DENIED or timeout ends the run `handoff_declined` or `handoff_timeout`; while `control_mode` is human the agent waits (up to `takeover_idle_s = 300`) then pauses. Per-action HITL is unchanged (its card is WS10's).
  - Proto and wire ids (04 4.6.C): `ApprovalKind HUMAN_ASSIST = 6`; `OrchestrationEvent` oneof `BrowserHandoffRequested = 30`, `BrowserHandoffResolved = 31`; `events.proto` EventType 180, 181, no `Event` field; S4 RPCs in `space_run.proto` (service `SpaceBrowserRead`); `browser.proto` and broker unchanged. No Session Core migration (S4 may need one partial index, next free number after the reservations through the sequencing owner). Action registry entries (human-only, absent from `MODEL_EXECUTABLE_ACTION_IDS`, negative assertion in `catalog-manifest.test.ts`): `spaces.browser_run.start` (owner plane Model, risk high, `requiresApproval:true`, not reversible), `spaces.browser_run.control` (medium), `spaces.browser_handoff.resolve` (low).
  - SPA: `SpaceBrowserStartPanel` (goal prefilled from the composer, required domain chips showing exactly what the room will see, duration cap, share toggle visible only when the flag is on, disabled with a stated reason for viewers and when policy is off); `SpaceBrowserCard` (typed timeline row `browser_card`: agent chip, started by, phase, last three steps with host and verbs, evidence thumbnail, "control: agent | name", open-in-pane, result text; polls R3 at 2.5 s only while visible and live, else the 6 s thread poll); `SpaceBrowserView` (pane view `{kind:'browser', runId}` in WS01-S7a's `SpaceAuxPane`, reuses `BrowserChrome` compact via the adapter, viewers get no action callbacks); `SpaceHandoffCard` (closed-kind copy, host, countdown to `expires_at`, Take control, I'm done, I can't do this; non-starters see "waiting for {name}"; live-region announcements). All strings via `i18n.tr`; existing Norwegian-only chip text in `BrowserChrome` is wrapped, not rewritten (WS16 owns the i18n baseline).

| Flag | Owner, default | Controls and kill switch |
|---|---|---|
| `browser_entitled` | Control effect policy column, FALSE | any decision, hence any room browser; policy PUT FALSE, existing runs end at grant expiry or stop |
| `SPACE_BROWSER_RUN_API` | model-gateway env (`mp-contracts` `switch_value_is_on`) and gateway `space_features.browser_run`, off in production | start and read routes; 0 gives 404 `feature_unavailable`, existing runs finish |
| `SPACE_BROWSER_VIEW_RELAY` | model-gateway env and `browser_live`, off | starter frame relay and control; 0 keeps the card working from events |
| `SPACE_BROWSER_VIEW_ROOM` | model-gateway env, off | observer frames and `share_view` (needs SD-23 reversal) |
| `QUARRY_ROOM_VIEW_ENABLED` | Quarry env ((a)), off | room-view routes and `delegation`; 0 returns 404 |
| `SPACE_BROWSER_HANDOFF` | execution-core env, off | challenge consumer; 0 ignores challenges as today |
| `features.browser_card`, `browser_live`, `browser_handoff` | gateway env into `space_context.features`, off in production | UI; flip without SPA rebuild |
| `space_browser_manager_control` | gateway and Control (S9), off | manager takeover and stop |

  Rollout: S1 and S2 (flags off) to dev; S3 in dev with the broker test double; the real broker once (a)'s F-t2-001 lands; S4-S5 behind flags; staging with two members and one entitled org; S6 after Quarry phase 1; S7; S8; production per org by entitlement. ZDR: refused at six layers with existing typed codes (gateway org lookup, model-gateway `browser_run_zdr_blocked`, Session Core read RPCs, execution-core `enforce_persistence_free_execution`, Control `zdr_inert`, no grant), no new catalogue key (`zdr_refusal_inventory.rs` stays green); room viewers in a ZDR org never see the card. Removal latency stated: a removed viewer loses the stream within 15 s; a removed starter's run ends at the next Quarry step after grant expiry (at most 10 minutes) or earlier on stop.

SQL: one `runs` row owned by A with the thread's `space_id`, one goal turn, no browser content in `events` beyond hosts and ids. B sees the card within 6 s, steps advance with host only (capture the JSON: no URL, title or rationale), the evidence thumbnail loads through R4 and a guessed evidence id from another run returns 404; B's live view request returns 403 `space_browser_view_not_shared`. A presses Take control: Quarry's timeline shows the control event with acting subject A and a new epoch, and an agent step attempted meanwhile is refused. Navigate the fixture to the CAPTCHA page: the hand-off card appears for both; A takes control, solves it, presses I'm done; the run resumes with a fresh observation. The run finishes: one assistant turn with `metadata.browser_run`, grant revoked (broker `ValidateGrant` inactive), Quarry run closed.

- **Risks and mitigations**:

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| No production grants today, so nothing is provable end to end | (a)'s F-t2-001 is a hard gate for sign-off; S2 and S3 are built against the broker test double |
| Frames expose sign-in state to the room | v1 frames go to the starter only; ephemeral profile only; human input bound to the grant domains; if observers are enabled later, withheld-by-default during human control |
| Page-derived text reaches the room (injection) | result bounded, plain text, no links, `provenance:"web"`; hand-off instruction is a closed code; projector drops rationale, titles, selectors |
| Challenge false positives start spurious hand-offs | rule keyed on page identity not substring; cap 3; classifier tightening is (a) F-t2-027 |
| Quarry's shared Chromium: one viewport change kills every session ((a) F-t2-007) | per-Space cap 2, fixed room viewport, no viewer-driven viewport change |
| Removed member keeps a live view or run | 15 s re-authorization for the viewer; for the starter the grant TTL (at most 10 minutes) or manager stop (S9); S3 revokes the grant when `space_membership_revocations` fires for the starter (the membership event is already consumed by WS02, K4-15); stated bound |
| Two sources for run state | events and approvals stay in Session Core; Quarry holds only the lease |
| Verifier needs the Control public key in model-gateway (no env today) | S2 adds the env pair and a startup refusal when the flag is on without it |
| Per-Space cap has no broker home after C1 | counted in Session Core at start (`CountActiveRoomBrowserRuns`), a plan-added RPC to confirm with the integrator |
| Hot files (`browser_run.rs`, `session_flow.rs`, `http_routes.rs`, `execution-core/grpc.rs`) | new logic in `space_routes/browser.rs`, `space/browser_read.rs`, `space_browser.rs`; edits are call sites rebased on (a) and (b) |
| Cost attribution by `space_id` unverified | `max_cost_usd` cap 1.00; whether cost-core attributes by `space_id` is UNVERIFIED |

- **Cross-session touchpoints**: production broker grants, durable store, issuance, `x-browser-authorization` in the proxy set ((a) F-t2-001, (b) F-t3-008): (a) owns, WS20 owns no broker field after C1; takeover enforced in Quarry `/step`, control epoch, typed `USER_TOOK_OVER` ((a) F-t2-013 phase 1): (a) owns, S8 cannot be signed off before it; delegation, acting subject, `browser:view`, room-view routes ((a) F-t2-013 phase 2, E7): WS20 specifies, (a) implements, if (a) picks a signed claim only the carrier changes; challenge taxonomy and no-bypass ((a) F-t2-027, (b) F-t3-026): (a) owns the classifier, WS20 consumes kind plus evidence, (b) F-t3-026 reuses `HUMAN_ASSIST`; hand-off representation (D-WS20-4, (b) F-t3-015): one durable object; org web policy of record ((a) F-t2-022, conflict C5): WS20 reserves `domain_ceiling` in the decision payload; approvals and resume (WS10, (b)): one approval kind added, per-action HITL unchanged, no grants issued; agent-work visibility (WS09, (a)): WS09 reserves a `browser` step class, WS20 owns the card and read path, one typed row union (WS15); ZDR (WS06): existing typed codes only; viewer registry ((b) F-t3-035, (a) F-t2-012): `BrowserChrome` is reused, not forked; run trace envelope ((a) F-t2-014): WS20 adds two event messages only; Control PR train (X29): the `browser:view` principal row rides `P-CFG`.
- **Open questions** (blocking only): (1) SD-23: are observer frames and manager takeover wanted (reverses Quarry's approved owner-only default); until answered S6 observer branch and S9 stay dark; (2) who implements the Quarry room-view routes and `delegation` (E7, 05 X16, nobody owns it today); (3) confirm the audience string for `model.space.browser_run` now that model-gateway, not the broker, verifies it, and the `CountActiveRoomBrowserRuns` RPC for the per-Space cap; (4) is a room browser run allowed in a personal Space with owner-only view (default yes, `view_scope` forced `owner`); (5) does the broker accept a TTL on issuance? Answered: yes, `ttl_seconds` on `DeriveRunGrant` (`quarryv2-next`, K4-28); the 15-minute default applies only if (a) does not merge that branch; (6) does (b) land `HUMAN_ASSIST = 6` first (mp-WS21.S9), so that S7 consumes it.

### 3.Z: Later waves as epics (E01 to E12)

Scope: the 56 audit items with no detailed design (audit Wave 3 and 4 non-priority items, all of Wave 5, plus items 036 and 047 which belong to no workstream) grouped into 12 epics E01 to E12. Residual halves of workstream items (F-t1-006 phases 2-3, F-t1-021 egress, F-t1-023 linked identities, F-t1-031 exports) are claimed by an epic and flagged in the index. Effort is engineer-weeks, converted from the audit's S/M/L/XL (about 1 / 3 / 6 / 12) and corrected by the verified state; all ranges are low-confidence (plus or minus 40 to 50 percent) because no epic has been sliced below its first slice.

Evidence base and limits. Designs existed only for WS01, WS02, WS03, WS04, WS09 and WS10 when this was written; prerequisites on WS05 to WS08 and WS11 to WS20 are cited at workstream level from `workstreams.md`, not at slice level. Code spot-checks were done in the live tree `C:/dev/CoresSystem` (states below: C = COMMITTED, M = MODIFIED-UNCOMMITTED, N = UNCOMMITTED-NEW).

Decisions taken here where sources disagree:
- The haiku live-tree delta says "the S4.3 watch primitive has no code in the live tree" (`haiku/live-tree-delta.md:338`). Wrong: `apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core/internal/watch/` has 14 tracked files (C), commits 690f91ae, 6316becb, d45e0269 (S4.3 steps 1 to 3); it stops at `recorded` (`watch.go:8`) and delivery waits for S4.4. E03 and E08 build on it.
- Audit puts F-t1-025 in W4 and F-t1-027 in W3; this plan keeps that order and makes cost attribution (E01-S1) the first thing any unattended or multi-agent epic needs.
- Audit cards cite `spaces.rs` lines that drifted: `apply_mention_binding_policy` is at `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/apps/gateway/src/domains/spaces.rs:4500` (audit 4399-4482), `inject_authored_instructions` at `:4291` (audit 4225-4300), `watches_not_built` at `:1627` (matches).

#### E01 Agent operations and multi-agent rooms

- Goal: make per-room and per-agent spend visible and capped, screen member text, then let several agents cooperate, with a task tracker that shows what waits on a human.
- Items: F-t1-027, 045, 025, 056. Residual claimed: F-t1-006 phases 2-3 (agent/model allowlist, locked switches, autonomy posture, rollout flags; WS03 decisions D1, D5).
- Planes: Model (cost-core Go, model-gateway `budget.rs`, session-core, execution-core), Control (allow/block decision), Application (task projection), Frontend.
- Prerequisites: WS03-S1/S3 (effect-policy admin) for the allowlist; WS08 (addressed multi-agent wake-up); WS09-S1 (run guard); WS10-S3 and S8 (gate, quarantine); WS11 (read state for task unread); decisions ADR 5, conflicts C4 (one origin enum), C5 (policy registry), sibling F-t3-023 (Control owns `allowed_models`).
- First slice E01-S1 (M): carry `space_ref` and binding ref through the usage envelope into cost-core entries and fix the zero token totals, then a read-only room spend panel. Today cost-core dimensions are tenant, actor, run, request, model, producer (`apps/Model Plane/go/services/cost-core/internal/ledger/ledger.go:44`, C) and the room prints no tokens (`apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/src/features/spaces/lib/activity-grammar.ts:696-709`, C).
- Then: E01-S2 RoomMember trust class and reply redaction (F-t1-045 a, e; M); E01-S3 allowance enforcement, token based; E01-S4 one-hop `delegate_to_agent` re-entering the gateway under the original human's bearer (generic subagent delegation is depth 1 with the same identity today, `apps/Model Plane/rust/services/execution-core/src/subagent/mod.rs:29`; L); coordinator with nonce, deadline and shadow loop detector last (XL).
- Must not break: ZDR (aggregate usage only; ZDR refuses `max_cost_usd`), owner-bound runs, the org `budget_exceeded` refusal, Space access never widening an owner-plane ACL; every hop records the initiating human.
- Effort: 26 to 42 (cost 8 to 14, guardrails 2 to 4, multi-agent 10 to 16, tracker 4 to 7, allowlist residual 2 to 4).
- Exit: room spend and per-agent attribution visible; allowance warns and hard-stops; a two-agent task completes with hop cap and no loop in a scripted eval (eval-lab-py case); task state `needs_input` visible in the Work tab.
- Trigger: E01-S1 now (independent); E01-S4 only when WS08 and WS10-S3 are live and E01-S3 enforces caps.

- Goal: a per-(Space, agent) computer with room stop/kill and lifecycle, an authorising egress path, and a secrets broker with draft-first outward actions.
- Items: F-t1-028, 044, 096 (096 parked). Residual claimed: F-t1-021 egress slice (WS06 owns resource caps).
- Planes: Model (sandbox-manager, execution-core), Ingestion (integration-corev2 broker, Quarry dns_guard reuse), Control (effect decisions, grants), Endpoint Plane only for 096.

- First slice E02-S1 (S to M): room stop/kill route for processes under a Control effect decision, through the process registry (`apps/Model Plane/go/services/sandbox-manager/internal/process/store.go`), plus surfacing watches through capability-core `/api/v1/watches` (the gateway still answers `watches_not_built`, `spaces.rs:1627`). Caution from a past finding: signalling the bwrap monitor does not reach the command, so the kill must go through the registry host-report path.
- Then: E02-S2 lifecycle states beyond SCRATCH, ACTIVE, SNAPSHOTTING, DESTROYED (`sandboxes.proto`, C) with per-agent home and an explicit ephemeral rule for ZDR (L); E02-S3 broker with host, method and path pinning on `egress.SafeClient` (L); E02-S4 authorising egress proxy (L); E02-S5 connector cockpit, draft-first sends, bounded cross-room posts (M each).
- Must not break: network off by default, Model proposes and Quarry executes, no credentials visible to the model, ZDR rooms get no durable home.

- Exit: manager can stop a runaway process from the room; an agent reaches only intersected-allowlist hosts; a secret is used without appearing in transcript or logs (scrub test); receipts written.

- Goal: members create, pause and test schedules, watches and webhook endpoints from the room; each fire is re-authorised and shows an outcome.

#### 4.0.2 Conventions

- **Slice ids**: `WSnn-Sk` as in the designs (`WS18-S4a` is a new split, see 4.2). `M0-*` = baseline slices, `P-*` = prep refactors (new, 4.4.2). `[cond]` = conditional slice (decision-, sibling- or trigger-gated, outline only, or optional): sized, scheduled last, excluded from firm totals.
- **Dependency types**: **H** hard = the dependency's code, data or migration must be merged before this slice can merge (same lane or runtime need). **(c)** contract-first = the slice may start and be tested against the dependency's contract (proto, golden, OpenAPI, fixture, wiremock) once that contract is published, but cannot merge or be enabled before the dependency merges. **soft** = functional nicety or advice only. Orderings that exist only to avoid a merge conflict are not dependencies; they live in 4.4.
- **Milestones** use the numbering of `06-verification.md` (M1 = W1, M2 = W2, M3 = W3) and add M0 (baseline) and M4 (production enablement). Gates G0-G6 are those of `02-decisions.md`.
- **Lanes** `L0..L10` are worktree and file-ownership groups (4.3). **Skills**: MS Model session-core and model-gateway (Rust); MX execution-core, capability-core, sandbox-manager, browser-broker, letta-bridge (Rust and Go); GW gateway BFF (Rust); SP SPA (Solid, TS); CT Control (Go and NestJS); AP Application (Convex TS, notification-core Go); DT Data and Ingestion (Go, Rust).

#### 4.1.3 Gates map (from `02-decisions.md` 2.4)

| Gate | Meaning | Closes at | Who |
|---|---|---|---|
| G0 | before the first Space code PR that is not a List-A slice | M0 exit | owner (SD-11, SD-01, SD-00) |
| G1 | before the first merge of a slice that edits `grpc.rs`, `auth.rs`, a `.proto` or adds a migration; exempt: migrations in services no sibling touches (user-core 033 for PR-2, integration-corev2 0014, imports-core 005, Data timestamps), provided the ledger lists them first (K4-19) | M0 exit | integrator (ledger entry), SD-15 |
| G2 | before WS01-S3 (member append) and WS02-S3 (stream frames) | mid-M1 | owner (SD-01, SD-02) |
| G3 | W1 exit and first staging enablement; before any enforcement flag flip | M1 exit | owner (SD-12); mp-WS01 S2 outbox fix deployed for WS02-S7 and WS11-S5 only |
| G4 | W2 start (WS08-WS15 main slices) | M1 exit, per slice group (SD-05, SD-15..SD-21); SD-13 and SD-14 close at G2 because WS04-S6/S7 are M1 (K4-18) | owner |
| G5 | W2 flag-on in an org | M2.1..M2.3 exits | owner (SD-18 entitlements) |
| G6 | W3 start | M3 entry (SD-03, SD-04, SD-22, SD-23) | owner |

#### 4.2.2 Critical path

Computed on the firm slices with H and (c) edges counted as serial (strict) and with (c) edges overlapping by half (overlap):

| Basis | Length (ew) | Path |
|---|---|---|
| strict, low / mid / high | 15.6 / 19.1 / 22.5 | M0-BASE > P-UC1 > WS20-S1 > WS20-S2 > WS20-S3 > WS20-S4 > WS20-S5 > WS20-S8 > WS20-S9 |
| overlap, low / mid / high | 13.9 / 17.1 / 20.1 | same path |

At 0.8 productivity this is about 24 calendar weeks at mid with unlimited engineers (4.7.3). WS20 is the longest chain by a margin and is also the most externally gated (E6, E7); WS20-S2..S3 may run against a test-double broker, S6/S8/S9 cannot be signed off without (a).

Near-critical chains (mid, strict), each ending in a different workstream:

| ew | Chain | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 16.4 | M0-BASE > P-SC1 > WS01-S1 > S2 > S3 > S4 > WS08-S3 > S4 > S6 > S8 | addressed wake rides the member-post spine |
| 15.2 | spine > WS01-S5 > S6 > S7b > WS12-S7 > S8 | DMs and lifecycle UI wait for the post composer |
| 14.2 | M0-BASE > WS05-S6 > S7 > S8 > S9 | SSO and SCIM; independent lane (L5), 16.5 ew high |
| 14.2 | P-SC1 > WS15-S5 > WS11-S2 > S3 > S6 > S7 > S11 | attention waits for the thread activity summary (decision 9 of `02` 2.3.5) |
| 13.8 | P-UC1 > WS10-S2 > S3 > S6 > S8 | approvals: grants, gate, member decide, quarantine |
| 13.7 | spine > WS01-S5 > WS17-S5 > S6 | personal agents UI |
| 13.2 | spine > WS01-S5 > WS16-S8 > S9 > S10 | sidebar organiser |
| 11.7 | M0-BASE > WS18-S1 > S3 > S4 > S5 > S6 > S7 | self-API |
| 11.4 | P-SC1 > WS01-S1 > WS15-S6 > S7 > S8 > S11 > S12 | scalable timeline and system rows |
| 10.6 | P-UC1 > WS14-S2 > S5 > S7 > S9 | files |

Reading of the graph:

1. **The plan is capacity-bound, not path-bound.** Total firm effort is 308.0 ew at mid against a 19.1 ew critical path (ratio about 16), so no realistic team (3 to 8) is limited by the path; staffing, skill mix and lane order set the calendar (4.7.3).
2. **The member-post spine WS01-S1 > S2 > S3 > S4 > S5 (about 8 ew strict, 6.5 with overlap, after P-SC1) sits on five of the ten chains** and gates WS08, WS12, WS13-S10/S11, WS16-S8, WS17-S5/S6 and WS20-S5. Shorten it first: publish the `sessions.proto` tags and the thread-append v2 golden in the first two days of WS01-S1 so that WS01-S2 and the gateway and SPA halves start against contracts, and start WS01-S7a on day one (it has no dependency).
3. **Independent chains that can start in week 1 with no coordination**: WS05 (S1, S2, S3, then S6), WS03-S1/S2, WS07-S1/S4/S5/S7/S13, WS16-S1/S2, WS19-S1, WS14-S1, WS14-S8, WS13-S6, WS18-S1, WS06-S3/S5/S7.
4. **Prep slices are on the path only by their own length**: `P-UC1` (0.5-0.8 ew) heads the WS20 chain and `P-SC1` (0.8-1.2 ew) heads the spine; both are 1 to 2 days of pure moves.

### 4.3 Parallel lanes

A lane is one git worktree on a branch `space/<lane>` cut from `space`, owned by one engineer (or one pair), with a file-ownership rule. Lanes follow planes because the hotspots are plane files; features cross lanes through published contracts. The slice order inside each lane is the recommended priority order (it matches the schedule simulation of 4.7.3, adjusted by hand for the M1 gate). Effort is firm ew low-high.

#### 4.3.2 Lane rules

1. A lane edits only the paths it owns. Any other path is touched through the seam of 4.4 (one registration line) or through a contract PR to the owning lane first.
2. A slice that spans planes (WS04-S2, WS04-S3, WS04-S6, WS09-S4, WS09-S8, WS10-S1, WS10-S4, WS14-S7, WS20-S4, WS20-S5 and others the designs call "spans planes") is delivered as one PR per lane, ids suffixed `-a`, `-b`, merged contract-first; effort splits as the design's file list does. The designs keep them as one slice only because the flow must be proven end to end; the DoD is run once all legs are merged.
3. Contracts are published in the first PR of a chain, before the implementation: the artifact table below.
4. A lane never merges a PR that turns a flag on; flag changes are L0 rollout PRs (4.9).
5. A lane rebases daily on `space`, and on any train the integrator merges from `model-plane` or `quarryv2-next` (4.5).

### 4.5 Merge order, rebase rules and CI gates

#### 4.5.1 Branches

- `space` = long-lived integration branch, cut in `M0-BASE` from the then-current `model-plane` tip (it must contain `22090c3b` and the Z-series; record the SHA in the ledger entry). Never force-pushed. Space PRs target `space`. If SD-11 prefers waiting for `model-plane` to reach `main`, the same flow runs on a branch cut from `main` after that merge; nothing below changes.
- Lane worktrees `space/<lane>` branch from `space`; slice branches follow the repo's Conventional Commit types (`feat/ws01-s7a-thread-pane`, `fix/ws05-s1-audit-read-role-gate`).
- Upstream sync: the integrator merges `model-plane` into `space` weekly (merge commit, never a rebase of merged history), and `quarryv2-next` every second week or when a Space slice needs a file (a) changed (`browser_run.rs`, gateway `browser.rs` for WS20). When either sibling reaches `main`, `space` merges `main`. The 26 files both siblings changed will conflict at that point regardless of Space; the rules of 4.4 keep Space's share to one-line registrations.
- Stacked PRs: do not delete a merged base branch before retargeting its child (deleting a base auto-closes the child PR; memory note). Use `gh pr edit --base`.

#### 4.5.2 Merge trains (coarse order; inside a train lanes merge in parallel unless a row says otherwise)

|---|---|---|
| T0 | `M0-BASE` ledger; `P-SC1`, `P-GW1`, `P-UC1`, `P-CX1` (parallel pure moves); `M0-CI`, `M0-T0` | SD-11, SD-01 answered; ADR-0011 and ADR-0012 filed (or explicitly waived by the integrator in the ledger entry) |
| T1 | independent and unblocking: WS05-S1, S3, S2; WS03-S1, S2; WS01-S7a then `P-SPA1`, `P-SPA2`; WS07-S1, S5, S7, S13, WS16-S1; WS06-S1, S2, S3, S4, S7; WS09-S1 (0 migrations); WS01-S1 (0071 + proto, alone in the proto slot) | T0 merged (the first three PRs of 4.8 may merge before) |

#### 4.5.3 Ordering rules that hold in every train

| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| R1 | Provider before consumer along every edge of 4.2; a consumer's flag stays dark until its provider is deployed. |
| R2 | One proto-bearing PR at a time, in tag order of 4.6.C, with regenerated bindings; one migration per PR; a migration merges before the code that reads its table. |
| R3 | `P-*` seams merge before any slice touching their files; WS03-S1 merges before any entitlement-column migration (user-core 038 onward). |
| R4 | WS09-S1 is ON in every environment before `SPACE_HUMAN_POSTS_CORE` is ON anywhere; WS17-S1 is ON before (b) enables `GATEWAY_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED`; WS05-S1 `enforce` is proven in production before (b) replays audit rows (mp-WS01.S2, O13). |
| R5 | WS04-S4 deploys dark before WS04-S6's flag is on anywhere; WS04-S5 is on before any member added by WS04-S6, WS04-S8 or a DM can read or post through a shared decision; WS04-S3 or S9 before the DM picker. |
| R6 | WS14-S4: re-point the actions first, then flip `CONTROL_OWNER_ASSERTED_GRANTS`, never the reverse. |
| R7 | WS15-S5 before WS11-S2; WS11-S2 before WS11-S3; WS02-S1 before WS11-S5; WS11-S5 before WS11-S6. |
| R8 | WS10-S1 before S3; S3 before S6; S6 before S8. WS10-S5a and WS17-S1 are on before WS19-S9 is default-on. |
| R9 | Deploy order inside a feature: Control decision, then Session Core or Data, then model-gateway, then gateway, then SPA; every flag off at each step; Control images through `scripts/run-control-plane.sh` (bare compose build exits 0 and builds nothing). |
| R10 | Control principals, `nats.conf` and compose edits only through the weekly `P-CFG` train (E9). |
| R11 | `WS05-S2` merges only after the integration-corev2 owner has committed the dirty `internal/auth/middleware.go` hunks, or rebases on them. |

#### 4.5.4 Rebase rules

1. Rebase the slice branch on `space` at least daily and immediately before merge; the lane branch likewise. No merge commits inside slice branches.
2. Generated files are never hand-merged: `go/gen/**`, `*.pb.*`, Convex `_generated/**`, `Cargo.lock`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Take either side, then regenerate (L0 for proto and Convex; the author for lockfiles).
3. Append-only registries (`action-registry.ts` fragments, `errors.ts`, `zdr-contract-sync.test.sh` rows, `DURABLE_MUTATIONS`, principal JSON, `nats.conf`): keep both sides, sort, re-run the registry's parity test.
4. A migration or proto-tag collision found at rebase is resolved by taking the next number from the spare range of 4.6 and updating the ledger row in the same PR; a number that has merged or deployed is never changed.
5. After a `model-plane` sync, re-run the session-core and model-gateway suites before the next Space merge; a failing sibling test is reported to its owner, not patched in Space.
6. Re-check every line number a PR cites; the designs cite live-tree lines that drift.

#### 4.5.5 CI gates a merge must pass (and what only a flag flip needs)

Origin has only `dev` and `fix/ui-premium-restore`, and the Control, gateway and SPA workflows trigger only for PRs based on `main`/`develop` (`build-test-gates.md` findings 1 and 2), so `M0-CI` adds a base-agnostic, path-filtered `space-gate.yml` that runs the rows below. Pre-existing failures are compared as sets against the stored baseline (new failure = fail); they are not fixed in Space PRs.

| Touched area | Gate (run from repo root) |
|---|---|
| user-core, audit-core, org-core | `cd "apps/Control Plane/<svc>" && go vet ./... && go test ./...` (user-core live tests need Postgres 16); principal or token change: `bash scripts/tests/principal-registry-parity.test.sh` |
| auth-core | `cd "apps/Control Plane/auth-core" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && REQUIRE_CONTRACT=1 pnpm test`; the full suite has 15 pre-existing failures in 3 suites: diff the failing set against HEAD |
| Model Plane Rust | `cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace --all-targets && cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast`; DB tests: `cargo test -p session-core -- --ignored` on a scratch Postgres whose name contains "test"; two cargo targets fail pre-existing on Windows (use `--lib` locally) |
| Model Plane Go | `cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/<svc>" && go test ./...` (new dependency: `GOWORK=off`); no CI today, `space-gate.yml` adds one job per touched service |
| Proto and contracts | `buf lint` and `buf breaking` in `apps/Model Plane/proto` against `baseline.binpb`; `REQUIRE_CONTRACT=1 bash scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh`; every new durable RPC adds a row to the ZDR inventory and posture matrix in the same PR (O18) |
| Gateway | `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/gateway/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/gateway/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path apps/gateway/Cargo.toml --all-targets && node --test apps/gateway/scripts/action-surface-contract.test.mjs` |
| SPA | `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build`, failing sets against baseline; Playwright at milestone gates only: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/<spec>.spec.ts` on a second Vite server (not `:5173`) with `E2E_REQUIRE_SPACE=1` |
| Convex | `cd "apps/Application Plane/convex-core" && pnpm test` (no CI today; `convex-core.yml` adds it) |
| notification-core, imports-core, Data services | `go test ./...` per service; Data Postgres contracts `bash "apps/Data Plane v2/tests/scripts/run-postgres-contract-tests.sh"` with `REQUIRE_CONTRACT=1`; retrieval-engine-rs `cargo test` |
| Always | `secret-scan` (gitleaks 8.24.3; `.gitleaks.toml` uses the singular `[allowlist]`), Conventional Commit title, evidence of "no new failing test" |
| Flag flip (not a merge gate) | the slice's DoD flow on images rebuilt from the commit under test, flag on then off, evidence bundle per `06` 6.4; a person who did not write the slice runs it at each milestone gate |
