### 4.7 Effort roll-up

#### 4.7.1 Assumptions

1. **ew** = one engineer-week of focused work by an engineer who knows the plane, as the designers estimated it (tests, live proof and review included). Low-high are the designers' ranges summed, not a statistical interval; mid = (low + high) / 2.
2. **Firm scope** = 196 slices: 186 design slices plus 10 baseline and prep rows. Conditional slices (14: 27.0-42.5 ew) are listed in 4.1.1 and excluded. Not sized and not included: WS08-S9..S11, WS11-S12, WS14 E1 and E2, the epics E01-E12, audit items outside WS01-WS20, the Support Plane. `WS06-S0` (1.5-3 ew in its design) is dropped (D5).
3. **Planning figure** = mid plus 15 percent for integration, rebases on two moving sibling branches and live-proof environment contention: 308.0 x 1.15 = **354 ew**. The high column (369.9 ew) is the pessimistic bound, not a probability.
4. **Calendar model** (script, list scheduling): one slice per engineer at a time; priority = milestone, then longest remaining path; a (c) edge lets the consumer start when its provider is half done and finish no earlier than the provider; duration in weeks = ew / 0.8 (review, rebase, queueing for live proof, sibling coordination); no holidays; decisions answered at their gates; external gates E1-E10 assumed available except where 4.1.1 says otherwise (WS20-S6/S8/S9 are not delayed for (a) in the numbers, so M3.2 is optimistic). A multi-plane slice is assigned wholly to its primary skill, which flatters the simulation slightly.
5. **Team shapes**: 3 = Model (session-core, model-gateway, execution, Data) / Control + Application + gateway / SPA. 5 = two Model engineers (session-core and runtime) / Control + Application + Data / gateway + SPA flexible / SPA. 8 = two session-core, one runtime + Data, one Control, one Control + Data, one Application + SPA, one gateway + SPA, one SPA. Anyone outside these skill sets cannot take a slice (no cross-training assumed).

#### 4.7.3 Critical path and calendar time

- **Critical path**: 15.6 / 19.1 / 22.5 ew (low / mid / high, strict); 13.9 / 17.1 / 20.1 with contract-first overlap. At 0.8 productivity that is about 24 calendar weeks at mid with unlimited engineers (21 with overlap). It is the WS20 chain of 4.2.2.
- **Capacity floor** (total mid / (N x 0.8)): 3 engineers 128 weeks, 5 engineers 77, 8 engineers 48. The simulated times are higher because skills are not interchangeable and each milestone gate leaves some skills idle.
- **M1 is the only path-bound milestone**: its own critical path is about 11 ew strict (spine WS01-S1..S5, then S6 and S7b), about 14 weeks at 0.8; more than 8 engineers do not shorten M1 below roughly 13 weeks.

### 4.8 The first three PRs

Chosen because each is independent of the others and of every open decision, high in value, low in risk, unblocks other lanes, and can start the day the plan is approved, in parallel with M0. Their paths were checked: unchanged on `model-plane`, `quarryv2` and `quarryv2-next` against `afb83928`, and clean in the live tree (4.0.1), so they can start on any base and be cherry-picked onto `space`. None carries a proto tag; one carries a migration (user-core 033). Commit trailers follow the repo's attribution rule.

| | PR-1 | PR-2 | PR-3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Title** | `fix(audit): role-gate org audit and usage reads (WS05-S1)` | `feat(control): catalogue-driven space effect policy writes with audit events (WS03-S1)` | `feat(spaces): thread side pane with ?thread_id deep link, read-only (WS01-S7a)` |
| **Branch** | `fix/space-audit-read-role-gate` | `feat/space-effect-policy-catalogue` | `feat/space-thread-pane-readonly` |
| **Lane, size** | L5 (with L9 for one SPA file), S, 0.5-1 ew | L4, M, 1.0-1.5 ew | L8, M, 1.0-1.5 ew |
| **Closes / unblocks** | the audit read path that lets any member read org audit rows (a security bug); releases (b)'s mp-WS01.S2 audit replay of 5,000 rows once `enforce` is proven in production (O13, section 5 X21) | the "dev policy admin": `UpsertEffectPolicy` becomes catalogue-driven, so WS09-S7, WS10-S2, WS12-S5, WS17-S4, WS19-S2, WS20-S1 each add one catalogue row instead of editing SQL (rule R3); gives `M0-T0` and every live proof a safe way to set policy rows | the right-hand pane and the `?thread_id=` reader that Activity already emits and nothing reads; unblocks `P-SPA1`, WS13-S4a, WS12-S7, WS09-S6 click-through, WS17-S6, WS20-S5 |

#### PR-1 `fix(audit): role-gate org audit and usage reads (WS05-S1)`

- **Scope**: audit-core reads (`listAudit` `api.go:197`, `listUsage` `:224`, `summariseUsage` `:250`, line numbers re-verified) return the org's rows only to owner or admin (role from the signed v3 delegation, canonical check); any other member gets their own rows, with a redacted `tool_action` projection so the Trust Center still aggregates; 403 `audit_scope_denied` for a cross-user filter and for usage routes; a signed non-admin or unknown role gets self scope; an unsigned delegation keeps audit-core's existing 403 (section 7.2.1 "Corrections"); gateway rewrites a member's query to self scope and clamps `limit`; SPA gates `RecentSecurityEvents` (`WorkspaceSettingsPage.tsx:1256`, render `:1557`) and adds `listOwnAuditEvents`. Switch `AUDIT_READ_ROLE_ENFORCEMENT` (`enforce` default, `report`, `off`).
- **Files**: `apps/Control Plane/audit-core/internal/api/api.go`, `service_auth.go` (`IsOrgAdmin()`), `api_test.go`, `service_auth_test.go`, `apps/Control Plane/audit-core/.env.example`, `apps/Control Plane/docker-compose.yml` (about `:829`), `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/apps/gateway/src/domains/audit.rs` (105 lines, no tests today), `.../src/features/settings/components/WorkspaceSettingsPage.tsx`, `TrustCenterSection.tsx` (test only), `.../src/shared/api/audit-client.ts` and `audit-client.test.ts`.
- **Tests**: `cd "apps/Control Plane/audit-core" && go vet ./... && go test ./...` (role matrix with the signed delegation helper of `service_auth_test.go:61-136`: owner, admin, member, viewer, forged header, missing claim, plan flag); `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && cargo test --manifest-path apps/gateway/Cargo.toml --all-targets` (new `audit.rs` tests: admin detection, self-scope rewrite, 403, clamp); `pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/api/audit-client.test.ts src/features/settings && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint`.
- **Definition of done**: (1) the role matrix above passes; (2) rebuilt images: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build audit-core` and `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway`, SPA on a second Vite server (not `:5173`); (3) live flow: org owner `GET /api/v1/audit` returns org rows; a plain member returns only their own rows with `meta.scope` set; a member's `?user_id=<other>` gets 403 `audit_scope_denied`, and a request with a forged role header (unsigned delegation) keeps audit-core's existing 403; the Trust Center page still renders its aggregate for a member; (4) `AUDIT_READ_ROLE_ENFORCEMENT` is `enforce` on merge in every environment (`report`/`off` exist only in dev, at most 3 days, boot warning; production refuses them); (5) evidence bundle with the commands, HARs and test summaries; a note to sibling (b) that O13 is released. If a second org member cannot be seeded before `M0-T0`, the member path is proven by the Go test and the live member proof is recorded as pending, not skipped.
- **Risk**: an unknown consumer of the unscoped read breaks under `enforce`; mitigated by `report` mode and the redacted Trust Center view.

#### PR-2 `feat(control): catalogue-driven space effect policy writes with audit events (WS03-S1)`

- **Scope**: `UpsertEffectPolicy` (`repository.go:1229`) takes an actor and a catalogue of entitlement columns; an entitlement omitted from the request keeps its stored value (today the PUT replaces the whole policy, `06` T0); every write inserts an immutable event and a `user_audit_outbox` row in one transaction; `fenceActiveSpaces` stays; `set-space-effect-policy.sh` gains the two missing flags and sends only the flags passed.
- **Files**: `apps/Control Plane/user-core/migrations/033_space_effect_policy_events.up.sql` (the design's 032 renumbered by 4.6.B; events table, indexes, immutability trigger), `.../internal/spaces/entitlement_catalog.go` (+ `_test.go`: catalogue, drift and ZDR-binding tests), `.../internal/spaces/policy_audit.go`, `.../internal/spaces/repository.go`, `.../internal/http/spaces.go` (`upsertSpaceEffectPolicy` `:1359`, pointer entitlements, actor), `.../internal/http/thread_read_decision_live_test.go` (call site `:121`), `.../internal/spaces/effect_policy_audit_live_test.go` (new), `apps/Control Plane/scripts/set-space-effect-policy.sh`.
- **Tests**: `cd "apps/Control Plane/user-core" && go vet ./... && go test ./internal/spaces/... ./internal/http/...` (live tests need Postgres 16; they are the same ones `user-service.yml` runs); a drift test fails when a column exists without a catalogue row or the reverse.
- **Definition of done**: (1) tests above green; (2) rebuilt image: `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core` (a bare compose build exits 0 and builds nothing); (3) `psql` shows `schema_migrations` row 033 and `\d space_effect_policy_events`; an `UPDATE` and a `DELETE` on the events table are rejected; (4) live flow on the dev org: run the script with one entitlement flag, then again with a different one, and the first stays set; each write leaves one event row and one outbox row whose `published_at` fills; health `wget --spider http://127.0.0.1:3012/health` (database round trip); (5) evidence bundle; (6) ledger row for user-core 033 appended by L0.
- **Risk**: wire addition breaks a strict decoder in a service caller; WS03-S2 audits callers; S1 keeps statuses and error strings byte-stable (test). A raw `PUT /effect-policy` keeps working meanwhile.

#### PR-3 `feat(spaces): thread side pane with ?thread_id deep link, read-only (WS01-S7a)`

- **Scope**: a generalised right pane (`SpaceAuxPane`) bound to `?thread_id=`; read-only thread panel over today's transcript route; honest restricted state (the swallowed 403 at `SpaceRoomTimeline.tsx:201` becomes a named state); `SpaceTurnList` extracted from the timeline so rows render in both places; the link builder in `activity-grammar.ts` (`:200` and `:326`, both re-verified, already emit `?thread_id=`) and the sidebar thread link in `CoreSidebarSpacesPanel.tsx` (`:298`, which links to the Space without `thread_id` today) stay inside `features/spaces` (a test forbids the literal `/chat?thread_id=` elsewhere). `reply_count` is optional (absent until WS01-S1). ### 4.9 Rollout order of flags across dev, staging and production

Principles: (1) flags are rollout controls, never authorization inputs (Control decisions and Session Core gates decide); (2) a flag turns on first where the next plane's contract is deployed (R9); (3) ZDR orgs are refused by design at every step, with typed refusals; (4) each flip is gated by the slice's DoD flow with the flag on and then off (kill-switch drill, `06` 6.4); (5) entitlement bits in `space_effect_policies` default FALSE and are set per org through the audited WS03 path (SD-18), so production exposure is per org: internal org, pilot orgs, then all; (6) observe or shadow precedes enforce wherever a flag has the mode. **Dev** = local stack with the dev compose override (core flags `"1"`; gateway flags on when `APP_ENV` is not production via `dev_flags_allowed`). **Staging** = the pre-production stack with a real second member, a ZDR org Z and a fresh policy row; whether the repo has such a stack beyond local rebuilt images is UNVERIFIED (SD-27). **Production** = `APP_ENV: production`: gateway flags off, core flags off unless stated.

| Wave | Flags in this order | Dev | Staging | Production | Preconditions (gates, siblings) | Kill switch |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Always-on safety (M1) | `space_run_thread_guard` (WS09-S1); `MEMORY_SPACE_CONTAINMENT` (WS17-S1); `AUDIT_READ_ROLE_ENFORCEMENT` (WS05-S1); `EXECUTION_SANDBOX_LIMITS` (WS06-S7); modes `SESSION_CORE_SPACE_ZDR`, `SPACE_AGENT_ADMISSION`, `EXECUTION_CORE_SPACE_SHELL_LEASE`, `CLIENT_VERSION_POLICY` | on; role gate `enforce` on merge in every environment | on | on everywhere on merge (guard before wave 3); role gate `enforce` on merge in every environment (no report release); the four modes start at `observe` or `banner` | WS17-S1 counters one week before (b) sets `GATEWAY_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED`; WS09-S1 before wave 3 | `0` per flag; `report`/`off` for the role gate |
| 2 Governance and room admin (M1) | `SPACE_POLICY_ADMIN_WRITES`, `space_policy_admin_api`, `space_denials_typed` (WS03); `space_org_room_reconcile_sync` and `space_audience_reconcile_sync` (WS04-S1, S5: the first two production flags); `space_room_details_ui`, `space_people_search_api`; `space_membership_writer_api` (after WS04-S4 deployed dark and S5 on); `space_room_archive_api` | on | on | admin writes off until the attestation answer of SD-18; reconcile flags on first; others per org | G2 for membership writer; SD-13 for production writer enablement | gateway flip or Convex env `0` plus `docker restart convex-gateway` |

#### 5.0.2 Id prefixes used in this section

`WSnn` = Space workstream (this plan). `mp-WSnn` = sibling (b) workstream. `qb-WSn.x` = sibling (a) workstream and slice. `F-t1/F-t2/F-t3-nnn` = audit items. `DEC-nn` = (b) decisions. `ADR-n`, `X-n`, `R-n` = (a) decisions and reconciliations. `SP-ADR-n` = the Space audit's ADR 1-10 (renamed so they cannot be confused with (a)'s `ADR-1..10`). `C1-C23`, `O1-O11` = cross-audit overlap ids. `N1-N15` = new conflicts found in this pass. `X01-X36` = rows of the shared-piece table.

#### 5.0.3 Rules applied to every ruling

Control owns authority (decisions, grants, audit, entitlements); Model proposes and Quarry executes; Data owns knowledge; no cross-plane DB; ZDR propagates; a Space only narrows an owner-plane decision (audit section 8, third strength; matrix rule 10 for Application projections). "Consume, not rebuild": where a sibling has built or reserved a piece, Space takes its names and numbers.

## 6. Verification and regression plan

Sources: audit sections 8 and 10.1; the Tests and Definition-of-done sections of WS01-WS20; `.plan-work/haiku/build-test-gates.md` (gate map, 2026-10-14); spot checks in the live tree `C:/dev/CoresSystem` (HEAD afb83928, read-only). Paths are relative to the repo root. `[exists]` = file verified present in the live tree today; `[new]` = to be added by the named workstream or by the slice named here; `[UNVERIFIED]` = not re-checked.

### 6.0 Conventions, decisions and prerequisites

**Milestones.** The brief names M1..M3 without defining them. This section defines them from the workstream catalogue: M1 = WS01-WS07 (audit wave 1: human posts, realtime, policy admin, room admin, security fixes, ZDR/sandbox hardening, client resilience); M2 = WS08-WS16 (wave 2: a real multi-human room with agent wake-up, live agent work, approvals, attention, DMs, search, files, timeline, UI baseline); M3 = WS17-WS20 (priority agents-as-colleagues: personal agents and memory, self-API, canvas, room browser). Section 1 of the plan may rename them; the scenario sets below move with the workstreams, not with the labels.

**Run codes** used in the "who and when" columns:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| L | author runs locally before every push (commands in 6.2) |
| PR | CI on the pull request (only if the workflow actually triggers, see 6.2 and 6.6) |
| F | flag-flip gate: the slice owner runs the DoD live flow with the flag on, then once off (kill switch), before the flag default changes |
| G | milestone gate: a person who did not write the slice runs the 6.4 scenario set on rebuilt images |
| N | nightly (proposed, self-hosted runner like `dataplane-v2-eval-nightly.yml`) |

**Decisions where inputs disagree** (the plan adopts the stated side):

| # | Disagreement | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Migration numbers collide across designs. Session Core: 0046 is claimed by WS01 (`0046_message_post_kind_and_dedupe`), WS02 (`0046_space_event_log`) and WS10 (`0046_approval_gate_context`); 0048 by WS08, WS12 and WS13. Control user-core: 030 by WS09 and WS10; 039 by WS17 and WS19. Live tree top is Session Core 0045 (untracked) and Control 029. | Every number in a design is a placeholder. The sequencing owner assigns numbers at merge; suite X6 fails on a duplicate or a gap. |
| D2 | Revocation latency: WS02 says about 10 s after the NATS event and the 2-minute decision lifetime as hard bound; WS09 re-authorizes every 15 s; audit risk 1 asks for a per-heartbeat audience-revision check. | Stated budget for tests: stream closes `membership_revoked` within 15 s p95 after the NATS revocation event reaches session-core; with the event dropped, within 130 s (decision lifetime 120 s plus jitter). "Strict mode" (Control re-check per lease, WS02-S6) is tested but stays off until the owner sets a tighter SLO (WS02 open question 2). |
| D3 | Most designs make their Playwright spec skip when `E2E_SPACE_REF` or a second storage state is absent (pattern of `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/tests/e2e/space-shell.spec.ts`). WS02 states a skipped spec proves nothing. | At gate G a skipped Space spec is a failure. A shared helper `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/tests/e2e/space-fixtures.ts` [new, T0] reads `E2E_REQUIRE_SPACE=1` and converts skip into fail. |
| D4 | Control, gateway and SPA CI only run for PRs whose base is `main`/`develop`; origin has only `dev` and `fix/ui-premium-restore` (gate map items 1-2); every design says "run locally". | Add one base-agnostic path-filtered workflow `.github/workflows/space-gate.yml` [new, T2] that runs the Space subset in 6.2. Fixing the old branch filters is a team decision (gate map section 10) and is not assumed. |
| D5 | Every Convex test is "not in CI" (convex-core has 13 test files, no workflow). | `.github/workflows/convex-core.yml` [new, T2]: `pnpm test` first; `typecheck` and `lint` only after the pnpm ignored-builds block (2026-07-11 audit, current status UNVERIFIED) is cleared. |
| D6 | Memory note says "no go.work"; the gate map found `apps/Model Plane/go/go.work` [exists] listing 19 modules. | Trust the file. Build and test stay per service (`cd <service> && go test ./...`); adding a dependency uses `GOWORK=off` (memory note S3.3). |
| D7 | Playwright invocation varies between designs (`pnpm test:e2e <file>`, `pnpm test:e2e -- <file>`, `pnpm exec playwright test <file>`). `playwright.config.ts` has no `webServer`; the stack must already run. | Standard form: `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/<spec>.spec.ts`. |
| D8 | WS designs prove "up" by `/healthz`; session-core `/healthz` and `/readyz` return a constant "ok" (`apps/Model Plane/rust/services/session-core/src/http_health.rs`). | Evidence must show migration rows with `psql` (`\d` of the changed tables) plus a log line, never `/healthz` alone. |

**Prerequisites that block every live scenario (slice T0, owner WS01 plus WS03-S1, due in week 1 of M1).** Every design lists "second member seeding" as UNVERIFIED (WS01 open question 6) and dev has no `space_effect_policies` rows (audit 9.4 item 10), so shared features are 403 by design until provisioned.

### 6.2 Test pyramid per plane, exact commands and CI coverage

**Layers.** L0 static and contract (seconds, every PR): fmt, clippy, typecheck, golden and pin scripts, ownership lint. L1 pure unit and guard tables (no DB). L2 DB-backed integration (Postgres scratch DB; Rust ignored tests need `DATABASE_URL` with "test" in the name; Go needs `TEST_DATABASE_URL`; Data Plane `WIKI_TEST_DATABASE_URL`). L3 service contract with wiremock or fake upstream. L4 live-stack proofs (`apps/Model Plane/scripts/tests/*-proof.sh` pattern, curl and `psql` against rebuilt images). L5 Playwright with two principals. Rule of proportion per workstream: the bulk of new cases is L1/L2; each wire shape gets one golden (L0); each flag gets one L4 flow; L5 holds at most one spec per workstream.

Windows host notes that change commands: Makefiles of Data Plane and Quarry default `CORE_SYSTEM_CACHE_ROOT` to a macOS path, so export `CORE_SYSTEM_CACHE_ROOT`, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, `GOCACHE`, `GOMODCACHE` first; Go `-race` needs cgo (unavailable); two Model Plane cargo targets fail on Windows (WS19/WS20 use `--lib`).

### 6.3 Cross-cutting suites (shared risks)

Eight suites are mandatory because several workstreams share the risk. Each is built once (owner named) and every workstream registers its surfaces into it. They hang off one machine-readable golden, the **Space surface registry** `apps/Model Plane/api/contracts/space-surface.v1.json` plus `.sha256` [new; owner WS06-S4, which already builds the ZDR class table for the 26 BFF routes and every non-GET model-gateway route]. One row per route, event subject, index, cache key family, notification type and preview: `id`, owning plane and service, authority decision type, minimum role, ZDR class, idempotency kind, flag, and the content-free payload key allow-list. It is consumed by the gateway, model-gateway, SPA and the lints below, and pinned like the other goldens (`scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh` CONSUMERS table, `.github/workflows/contract-goldens.yml`).

Risk-to-suite coverage of audit 10.1: risk 1 push bypass -> X1, X3, X8; risk 2 index and copy sprawl -> X2, X3, X4; risk 3 memory leakage -> X1 plus WS17 scenarios (M3-S1/S3); risk 4 audit read path -> X1 (WS05 role-gate rows); risk 5 governance that looks done -> X1, M1-S5, M1-S8; risk 6 runaway cost -> budgets in 6.5 (cost caps themselves are F-t1-027, not in WS01-WS20); risk 7 ZDR degraded room -> X2 and the ZDR tour in 6.4; risk 8 plane drift -> X4; risk 9 membership-writer clobber -> X1 source-scoping rows plus X8 (lost event drill); risk 10 stale docs -> `scripts/tests/ownership-docs-contract.test.mjs` [exists] extended with the Space docs.

#### X1 Authority matrix (a user without the right sees nothing and cannot write)

Goal: one table of principals x operations, executed in three places: Control issuance (L1/L2), BFF and Session Core enforcement (L3), live HTTP and browser (L4/L5).

Expected outcomes (acceptance contract, derived from the designs; the authoritative role floors are WS04's `room-role-matrix.v1.json`, to be reconciled in week 1). Codes: Y = allowed; 403t = typed 403 with a catalogue code; 404 = identical body to an unknown Space (no existence oracle); 412z = typed ZDR refusal.

| Operation (owner WS) | owner | manager | editor | viewer | non-member / other org | removed member | ZDR caller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| read transcript, list rooms (WS01, 15) | Y | Y | Y | Y | 404 | 403t / empty | Y read, poll only |
| subscribe `GET /spaces/{ref}/events` (WS02) | Y | Y | Y | Y | 404 | closes `membership_revoked`; new subscribe 403 | `poll_only` |
| post, reply (WS01) | Y | Y | Y | 403t | 404 | refused | 412z |
| edit or delete own message (WS12) | Y | Y | Y | 403t | 404 | refused | 412z |
| delete another's message (WS12) | Y if moderate | Y if moderate | 403t | 403t | 404 | refused | 412z |
| react (WS12) | Y | Y | Y | 403t | 404 | refused | 412z |
| search (WS13) | Y | Y | Y | Y (own-threads banner without read entitlement) | 404 | refused | Y, nothing persisted |
| upload file (WS14) | Y | Y | Y | 403t | 404 | refused | 412z |
| list or preview files (WS14) | Y | Y | Y | Y | 404 | refused | 412z |
| attach to live run (WS09) | Y | Y | Y | Y | 404 | closes within budget | 412z |
| stop run (WS09) | Y | Y | 403t | 403t | 404 | refused | 412z |
| decide approval (WS10) | Y if run owner or named approver | same | same | 403t | 404 | `authority_changed`, nothing runs | refused |
| write canvas (WS19) | Y | Y | Y | 403t (reads) | 404 | refused | 403 `zdr_persistence_forbidden` |
| start browser run, take control (WS20) | Y | Y | Y start; control starter only | 403t | 404 | refused | 412z |
| change roles, rename, archive (WS04) | Y | Y; cannot grant or demote manager/owner | 403t | 403t | 404 | refused | n/a |
| join from directory (WS04) | org member only if directory policy on and room `org_public`; private rooms 404; zero new `resource_grants` rows | | | | | | |
| write org effect policy (WS03) | org admin or owner only; member or viewer 403 and the store is never called; auth-core down gives 503, no fallback | | | | | | |
| read org audit events (WS05) | admin or owner see org rows; member sees own rows; foreign `user_id` 403 `audit_scope_denied`; forged `X-User-Role` with unsigned delegation 403 | | | | | | |
| agent (service subject) acts as member (WS08, 17, 18) | only within its own binding policy and run-bound grant; owner removed -> admission suspended | | | | | | |

Tests: Control `authority-matrix.v1.json` [new] drives `TestAuthorityMatrix` (user-core live) and a Rust consumer test in session-core (reads the vendored copy); gateway wiremock test per route "member without role gets 403 and the upstream mock receives zero calls" (WS03, WS04, WS09 pattern); `scripts/tests/space-authority-matrix-live.sh` [new] runs the matrix over HTTP with storage-state cookies A..F against the live stack and checks `psql` row counts unchanged for every refused write; `tests/e2e/space-authority-matrix.spec.ts` [new] for the browser-visible rows (no write controls for viewer, restricted states, nothing leaks in the sidebar). "Sees nothing": response bodies for non-member vs non-existent Space are byte-equal (WS04 `membership_ops_live_test.go`, WS03 `denial_live_test.go`, WS13 `resolve_message_not_found_is_identical_...`).
Revocation within the stated time is X8. Who and when: author L; PR (`control-go`, `gateway`); G on rebuilt images; owner WS04 (matrix file), each WS adds its rows in the same PR that adds the route.

#### X2 ZDR matrix (every new route, event, index, notification, preview, cache)

Goal: ZDR orgs get a refusal or a refs-only result for every Space surface, tested against the typed refusal catalogue `apps/Model Plane/api/contracts/zdr-refusals.json` (UNCOMMITTED-NEW today; its Rust mirror `apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/src/zdr_refusal.rs` and SPA mirror `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/src/shared/api/zdr-refusals.ts` are also untracked).
1. Completeness lint (L0): every `/api/v1/spaces/**` route in the gateway and every non-GET model-gateway route must appear in `space-surface.v1.json` with a ZDR class (`refuse`, `refs_only`, `poll_only`, `local_only`, `n/a`); a new unclassified route fails (WS06-S4: `cargo test -p model-gateway zdr_posture`, gateway `tests/space_routes_zdr_classes.rs` [new]).
2. Behaviour (L3): for each `refuse` row a ZDR org/credential call returns the catalogue code, the upstream mock sees zero Control calls (WS01 `zdr_org_gets_typed_412_before_any_control_call`), and DB row counts are unchanged.
3. Refs-only rows: payload key allow-list test (`message_appended_payload_has_ids_and_kinds_only`, `membership_event_payload_test.go`, `attention_*`, `space_event_*`); `space_event_log` has no row for a `zdr` run (CHECK and trigger, WS02).
4. #### X5 Idempotency and replay

One table-driven harness `scripts/tests/space-idempotency-matrix.mjs` [new] over every write row of the registry that declares an idempotency kind; five probes per row: (a) same key, same body: same result and exactly one row (`deduplicated:true`, `REPLAYED`, `replayed:true`, `managed_run_already_started`); (b) same key, different body: 409; (c) response dropped after commit, retry: one row; (d) ten concurrent same-key requests: one row; (e) at-least-once consumers receive each event twice: effect once.

Who and when: owner WS01 (first row), every WS registers; author L (pure cases), PR (DB cases), G.

### 6.4 Live evidence protocol

The repo counts a deployment claim only after rebuilt local images, a running stack and a verified end-to-end flow. A slice is "done" when its DoD flow passes with its flag on and then off (kill switch), on images built from the commit under test, with an evidence bundle.

**Rebuild and bring-up recipes** (from the gate map and memory notes; run from the worktree under test):

| Plane | Rebuild | Up-proof (never `/healthz` alone for session-core) |
|---|---|---|
| Model Plane | `cd "apps/Model Plane" && ./scripts/compose.sh up -d --build session-core model-gateway [execution-core sandbox-manager browser-broker capability-core letta-bridge nats-provisioner]`, with the slice flags in the environment (for example `SPACE_HUMAN_POSTS_CORE=1 SPACE_HUMAN_POSTS_API=1`, `SPACE_REALTIME_STREAM`, `SPACE_REALTIME_EMIT`) | `psql \d <table>` for the new migration, migration log line, `docker compose ps`; model-gateway `/readyz`; capability-core `curl -f http://localhost:8085/healthz` |
| Control Plane | `cd "apps/Control Plane" && scripts/run-control-plane.sh up -d --build user-core [org-core audit-core auth-core]` (a bare `docker compose build` exits 0 and builds nothing); update `USER_CORE_SERVICE_CREDENTIALS` for new scopes first | `wget --spider http://127.0.0.1:3012/health` (DB round trip), `schema_migrations` rows. Never repoint the bootstrap script at `.env.generated-secrets`; never re-add Control tokens to `apps/Ingestion Plane/integration-corev2/.env` (an ingest bridge 401 means token mismatch) |
| Application Plane | `cd "apps/Application Plane" && docker compose up -d --build notification-core convex-backend convex-subscriber jetstream-provisioner`; Convex functions: edits reach `convex-gateway` through the bind mount, then `docker restart convex-gateway` and wait for the log line "Convex functions ready!" (never `pnpm run deploy`) | `curl -f http://127.0.0.1:3210/version`; `nats stream info`/`consumer info` when WS11 streams are involved |
| Data Plane | `cd "apps/Data Plane v2" && make up` (export `CORE_SYSTEM_CACHE_ROOT`, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, `GOCACHE`, `GOMODCACHE` on Windows) and `make cross-plane-up` (the base compose uses a private bus; without the overlay documents-api crash-loops and GDPR erasure fails silently); single service `docker compose build wiki-store && docker compose up -d wiki-store` | `docker compose exec <svc> curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:<port>/readyz` |
| Ingestion / Quarry (sibling a) | `cd "apps/Ingestion Plane" && make up` (quarry-control on host port 28081) | `make test-endpoints` |
| Frontend | `cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && docker compose up -d --build gateway`; the SPA is verified on a **second Vite dev server** (port other than 5173; `:5173` is the main checkout's container over a Windows bind mount that never sees worktree edits); restart that Vite process and hard-reload because the browser caches `global.css` across restarts | `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3185/health`; `bash "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/build-verevon-services.sh" --status` |

**Evidence bundle** `docs/plans/evidence/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<WSnn or Mn>/` containing `manifest.json` (git sha of the tree under test, `docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}} {{.Created}}'` for each rebuilt service with Created later than the last touching commit, `docker compose ps` per plane, flag values on and off), `commands.txt` (verbatim), SQL outputs, HAR per flow (tokens redacted), screenshots, Playwright trace, log excerpts (field names and ids only, never content), test summaries (`cargo test`, `go test`, `vitest`, Convex), the X3 canary result, and the watch-list diff (6.6). No end-to-end trace id exists today (a grep found only user-core honouring `X-Correlation-Id`, in `apps/Control Plane/user-core/internal/http/server.go`); the "trace ids" captured are therefore the ids the system already mints: `thread_id`, `message_id`, `run_id`, `space_event_log.seq`, Control decision idempotency keys and `X-Correlation-Id` from user-core responses. Propagating one id across hops is an observability item (F-t1-078), not a precondition.

**Pass rule for every scenario:** positive path green; each listed negative path refused with the typed code and no side effect (row counts unchanged); canary scan clean; the flag flipped off once returns the legacy behaviour with no data change; the baseline diff shows no new failing test; the bundle is attached to the PR and a dated note is added beside `apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/docs/SPACE_*`.

**ZDR tour (every milestone):** a ZDR org Z user performs the milestone's headline actions; each is refused with the catalogue copy or is refs-only; zero rows created in `messages`, `space_event_log`, notification tables, Convex; the SPA shows the honest state; X2 and X3 pass.

### 6.5 Performance, load and observability

Budgets below are acceptance targets. Items taken from a design are marked (WSnn); the rest are proposals to be calibrated on the baseline run in M1 week 1 and then frozen (budget = measured baseline x 2 unless noted). The baseline run uses `scripts/load_smoke.sh` [exists] for the platform and the Node harnesses named here.

| Check | Method | Budget |
|---|---|---|
| Post-to-visible, sender | optimistic row in the composer (WS01, 33) | row appears before the POST returns (under 100 ms, proposal); server acceptance p95 under 400 ms including Control mint (proposal) |
| Post-to-visible, other member (live) | B's refetch time minus `space_event_log.created_at` (WS02 evidence step 4) | p50 under 500 ms (proposal), p95 under 1.5 s (WS02) |
| Post-to-visible, degraded | stream down, poll fallback | within 6 s plus jitter (existing poll) |
| Revocation to stream close | X8 | p95 15 s after NATS event; 130 s hard (D2) |
| Reconnect storm | `space-stream-storm.mjs`: 500 simulated users x 3 tabs reconnect together after a gateway restart, jittered | all resumed by `Last-Event-ID` within 60 s; Control mints per tab per lease about 1 (lease 85-100 s jittered, WS02) and never above the Control rate limit; at most 3 attaches per browser and per-user cap (WS09); `SPACE_STREAM_MAX_STREAMS` 5000 per replica not exceeded; stream pool (8) does not raise main-pool (20) p95 query latency by more than 10% |
| Decision-minting load | k6 or Node at 50 and 200 rps on `thread-decision`, `thread-read-decisions` bulk (60 items, WS11) and the batch of 25 Spaces (WS13) | Control p95 single under 100 ms, bulk-60 under 400 ms (proposal); zero 5xx; no decision reused past 120 s (assert exp) |
| Fan-out cost | one room of 200 members with 200 open streams, 5 posts per second for 5 minutes | rows read per event at most 1 per stream (cursor), session-core CPU under 1 core (proposal), NOTIFY wake count equals commit count, `space_event_log` lag (head minus slowest cursor) under 2 s p95, trigger overhead on `messages` insert at most +10% p95 and FTS index at most +20% p95 on the 50,000-row copy (WS13 measures write latency) |
| Search | 50,000 seeded messages (WS13) | p95 under 300 ms at `limit=20`; plan names `idx_messages_space_fts`; else trigger D-10 |
| Timeline and scroll | Playwright trace, 2,000 posts (WS15) | DOM under 450 posts; p95 scripting per scroll frame under 8 ms; window query over 20,000 threads uses `idx_threads_space_activity`, p95 under 100 ms (proposal) |
| Attention aggregate | 60 rooms, one poller per browser (WS11) | p95 under 500 ms (proposal); uses `idx_messages_space_created`; stale label after 90 s; notification budget 30 per hour per user (WS11) |
| Canvas contention | 20 concurrent saves (WS19) | exactly one winner |
| Sandbox caps | fork, memory, CPU, file and output floods (WS06) | `/healthz` stays 200; execution-core RSS flat |

**Observability list (content-free; labels never carry space, org, user or thread ids; route labels are templates, WS06 `route_label_is_the_template_not_the_path`).** Existing in designs: `mp_session_space_stream_active`, stream opened/closed totals by reason, frames by kind, emit errors (WS02); `mp_room_run_attach_total{outcome}` and an active-attach gauge (WS09); `mp_session_space_zdr_flag_total{enforced}` (WS06); `mp_session_memory_contained_total` (WS17); `verevon_client_failures_total`, `verevon_csp_reports_total{directive,disposition}` (WS07). Proposed additions: `space_post_total{result}` and post latency histogram; `space_decision_mint_total{decision_type,result}` and mint latency histogram (gateway and user-core); `space_revocation_close_seconds` histogram (feeds the 15 s budget); `space_event_log_lag_seconds`; outbox depth and oldest unpublished age for the audience outbox, `session_audit_outbox` and the WS04 membership ledger (alert above 60 s); `space_search_latency_seconds` and hit-count buckets (no query text); `space_notification_requests_total{kind,result}`; `space_zdr_refusals_total{code}` using the catalogue codes; `space_stream_degraded_ratio`; `space_idempotent_replay_total{route}`. Alerts: revocation p95 above 15 s, outbox age above 60 s, stream degraded ratio above 5%, any non-zero count from the X3 canary script (run at each milestone gate; in nightly only once the self-hosted runner of E8 exists).

## 7. Open questions for the user, and the first three pull requests

State of the facts: 2026-10-20, read-only checks of the live tree `C:/dev/CoresSystem` (`main`, `afb83928`, 326 uncommitted entries). Ids: SD-nn decisions, C1-C23 sibling conflicts, WSnn-Sk slices, G0-G6 gates, M0-M4 milestones are defined in Appendix B. Path tags: [C] committed and clean, [M] modified-uncommitted, [U] untracked, [N] new (this plan proposes it).

### 7.0 How to answer

- Reply "ok" to a row to accept its recommended default; reply with the row id and the alternative otherwise. Nothing in 7.1 changes code; each answer unlocks slices listed in the row.
- **Safe default = Y** means the slices named can start now with the recommended default and the answer only confirms or vetoes it; **N** means the named slices cannot merge (or cannot start) before the answer; **partial** means a stated subset proceeds.
- **The first three pull requests (7.2) need no answer in 7.1.** They sit on paths no decision gates and can start the day the plan is approved.
- Minimum answers to leave M0 (sequencing 4.1.1): A1 (SD-00), B1 (SD-01), B4 (SD-15), E1 (SD-11). Everything else is needed later (7.1.8).
- 18 items are USER decisions in section 2.6; this section also carries the designs' product questions, the sibling flags of section 5.4 and the operator questions of sections 4.10 and 6.7, merged where they ask the same thing. Rows with decider PLAN are in 7.1.6 as veto-only defaults.

**Repo evidence rule (applies to every DoD below):** a deployment or done claim counts only after images rebuilt from the commit under test (`docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}} {{.Created}}'` with `Created` later than the last touching commit), a running stack, and a verified end-to-end flow with the flag on and then off. The evidence bundle `docs/plans/evidence/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<id>/` holds `manifest.json` (git sha, image ids, `docker compose ps`, flag values), `commands.txt` verbatim, SQL outputs, HARs with tokens redacted, screenshots, Playwright trace, test summaries, and the diff of failing sets against the baseline. A person who did not write the slice runs the flow at milestone gates.

**Parallelism:** the three PRs touch disjoint trees (PR-1 audit-core, gateway `audit.rs`, `features/settings`, `audit-client.ts`; PR-2 user-core and one Control script; PR-3 `features/spaces` and one sidebar file), share no migration, proto tag or flag, and can run in three worktrees at once and merge in any order. Total 2.5-4.0 engineer-weeks, run in parallel about 1.5 weeks.

## Appendix B. Glossary of identifiers

| Identifier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Space**, **room** | Verevon's shared workspace (people and bound agents); `space_ref` is its Control-registered reference |
| **WSnn** | Workstream 01-20 (section 3). WS01 human posts and thread pane; WS02 realtime substrate; WS03 governance admin phase 1; WS04 room administration and membership writer; WS05 security fixes and enterprise identity; WS06 Model Plane safety (ZDR, sandbox caps); WS07 frontend quick wins and room artifacts; WS08 addressed wake-up and mentions; WS09 agent work visible, run guard, steer; WS10 approvals; WS11 attention and read state; WS12 DMs, lifecycle, reactions; WS13 search, permalinks, commands; WS14 attachments, files, sharing grants; WS15 composer, timeline, typed entries; WS16 UI baseline and sidebar; WS17 personal agents and memory; WS18 agent self-API; WS19 room canvas; WS20 room browser. "WS03" in the Model plan is not Space WS03 (that plan's are written `mp-WSnn`) |
| **Sk**, **Ska** | Slice k of a workstream (`WS05-S1`); a lowercase suffix (`S7a`, `S4a`, `S9a`) is a split slice; `-a`, `-b` suffixes mark one PR per lane of a cross-plane slice (4.3.2) |
| **M0-\***, **P-\*** | Baseline slices (`M0-BASE` base cut and ledger, `M0-T0` seed and baseline, `M0-CI` gates) and prep refactors (`P-SC1` session-core `space/` seam, `P-GW1` gateway tree, `P-UC1` user-core routes, `P-CX1` Convex schema split, `P-SPA1` SPA registry, `P-SPA2` composer slots, `P-CFG` Control PR train) |
| **[cond]** | conditional slice: decision-, sibling- or trigger-gated, sized but excluded from firm totals |
| **H**, **(c)**, **soft** | dependency types: hard (merge first), contract-first (start against the contract, cannot merge or enable first), advice only |
| **M0, M1, M2.1-M2.3, M3.1, M3.2, M4** | milestones: baseline and seams; W1 foundations; agents in the room, attention and DMs, search and files and baseline; personal agents and memory, room browser; production enablement |
| **G0-G6** | decision gates: G0 first non-List-A code PR; G1 first merge touching `grpc.rs`, `auth.rs`, a proto or a migration; G2 before WS01-S3 and WS02-S3; G3 W1 exit and first enforcement flip; G4 W2 start; G5 W2 flag-on in an org; G6 W3 start |
| **L0-L10** | lanes (worktree and file ownership): PLAT, SCT, SCR, RUN, CTL, IDN, APP, GW, SPA-R, SPA-S, DAT (4.3.1) |
| **R1-R11**, **O1-O18**, **X1-X36**, **N1-N15** | ordering rules (4.5.3); ordering risks (5.6); cross-session items and new conflicts (section 5); `R-n` in the Quarry plan are its resource reservations, not these |
| **E01-E12** | later-wave epics (3.Z): E01 agent operations and multi-agent rooms; E02 agent computer, egress, credential custody; E03 room automations and webhooks; E04 agent tools, forms, history answers, file knowledge; E05 calls, meetings, voice (needs ADR 7); E06 guests, teams, external surfaces; E07 retention, moderation, compliance, assurance; E08 push, PWA, DND, digest, catch-up; E09 lists, records, templates; E10 skills, plugins, public API, federation; E11 desktop shell, multi-window; E12 client long tail |
| **SD-00 .. SD-30** | Space decisions: SD-00 product stance; SD-01..SD-10 are ADR 1..10 (1 human-message ownership, 2 realtime tier, 3 agent memory, 4 personal agents as service subjects, 5 delegation, 6 agent network boundary, 7 calls, 8 retention and ZDR precedence, 9 search index placement, 10 external surfaces); SD-11 base branch and integrator; SD-12 ZDR behaviour; SD-13 membership writer; SD-14 registration bundle; SD-15 shared vocabularies; SD-16 default Send; SD-17 attention; SD-18 entitlements; SD-19 message lifecycle; SD-20 run visibility; SD-21 approval semantics; SD-22 personal-agent scope; SD-23 room browser; SD-24 enterprise identity; SD-25 realtime parameters; SD-26 wake policy; SD-27 operator facts; SD-28 shared-Space Control decision family; SD-29 shared read skeletons; SD-30 owner-asserted grant writes. Space ADR files `SP-ADR-1..10` are ADR-0014..0023 |
| **ADR n**, **ADR-00nn** | `ADR n` = audit ADR candidate (9.3); `ADR-0001`, `ADR-0011` (approval scope), `ADR-0012` (run origin) are repo ADR files; the Quarry plan's `ADR-n` is its own series |
| **C1-C23** | sibling conflicts and rulings (2.3.2): C1 client `space_ref` on browser runs; C2 queue and steer; C3 grant scope vocabulary; C4 origin vocabulary; C5 policy registry; C6 run-action table; C7 canvas and version store; C8 egress enforcement point (open); C9 schedule and watch; C10 agent recall over room history; C11 message versions vs revisions; C12 memory label schema; C13 containment owner; C14 two composers; C15 audit and SIEM; C16 ZDR matrix; C17 run-state vocabulary; C18 resource taxonomy for sharing; C19 outward actions and connector content; C20 Endpoint Plane; C21 new user-content origin; C22 trajectory capture under ZDR; C23 Letta mirror |
| **F-t1-nnn**, **F-t2-nnn**, **F-t3-nnn** | audit item ids: Space audit (96 items), Quarry and browser audit, Model Plane chat and agents audit |
| **mp-WSnn**, **DEC-nn**; **q-WSn.X**, **ADR-n**, **OQ-n**, **X-n** | sibling (b) workstreams and decisions; sibling (a) workstreams, ADRs, open questions, cross items |
| **PD-WSnn**, **D-WSnn-x**, **D1-D8** | per-workstream default sets and design decisions (PLAN decides, user may veto); in 4.0.3 `D1-D8` are the sequencing section's disagreements with inputs |
| **A1-F16** (this section) | open-question rows of 7.1 |
| **Path tags** | [C] COMMITTED (tracked at `afb83928`, not modified); [M] MODIFIED-UNCOMMITTED (tracked, dirty, line numbers may differ from the audit's); [U] UNCOMMITTED-NEW (untracked); [N] NEW (does not exist anywhere; this plan proposes it). The designs write the same states as COMMITTED, M, NEW and MISSING (not in the live tree) |
| **Z-series** | the ZDR hardening commits `5ae7fe13`..`b67bb7f0` on `model-plane` (session-core migrations 0044, 0045, `zdr_refusal`, retention receipt); dirty duplicates sit in the live tree |
| **ZDR** | zero data retention; propagates through every content-persisting boundary (repo rule); "waived run" counts as ZDR for new stores (DEC-32) |
| **ew** | engineer-week of one engineer who knows the plane |
| **integrator** | the one person who freezes migration and proto numbers and appends the single ledger entry in `apps/Model Plane/docs/decisions/ledger.md` |
| **List A, B, C** | section 2.5: start now and merge when ready; write now and merge after G1; explicitly not now |
| **`space`, `model-plane`, `quarryv2`, `quarryv2-next`** | the proposed Space integration branch (not yet cut); sibling (b) branch; sibling (a) branches. All local and unpushed |
| **Evidence bundle** | `docs/plans/evidence/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<WSnn or Mn>/` as defined in `06-verification.md` 6.4 |
